9d525825.description:

 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

****Job Area:****
 Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group \> Program Management
   

  

****General Summary:****
 The Qualcomm Datacenter team stands at the forefront of innovation, crafting cutting\-edge hardware and software solutions that transform the data center, edge, and infrastructure landscapes. Our advanced Datacenter products are trusted and utilized by some of the world’s most prominent organizations, powering critical operations, at scale. As we embark on an exciting phase of rapid expansion, we are actively seeking talented professionals across diverse disciplines to join us in shaping the future of technology and delivering breakthrough deployments on a global stage.
   

  

****Job Overview:****
 Develops, defines, and executes Application SW plans of record, including schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and risks across multiple large projects. Monitors and drives the program from initiation through delivery, interfacing with internal and external stakeholders across functions. Monitors budget/spending, on\-time delivery, and achievement of program milestones. Represents the program and drives alignment across stakeholders.

* Lead scrums, coordination, triage issues, secure release plan deliverables, establish test exit criteria

* Experience with multiple technology development and end\-to\-end product integration.

909c5585.title: Solutions Engineer
909c5585.description:
**Why you'll love Cisco**
 We change the World, you will become passionate about your employer and the brand you represent. Everything is converging on the Internet, making networked connections more meaningful than ever before in our lives. Our employees' ground breaking ideas impact everything. Here, that means we take creative ideas from the drawing board to dynamic solutions that have real world impact. You'll be part a team that cares about its customers, enjoys having fun, and you'll take part in changing the lives of those in our local communities. Come prepared to be encouraged and inspired.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Solutions Engineer you will orchestrate involvement of all technical activities and resources, holding accountabilities for all opportunities within assigned account(s) and provide architectural perspective across the Cisco product portfolio, including software and services.
   

  

* Technical sales professional serving as a Technology/Product/Solution consultant.
* Technical orchestrator for an array of Cisco resources, primary responsibility for ensuring successful completion of each pitstop from a technical perspective in the lifecycle selling motion.
* Provides technical information and design/implementation guidance in concert with Cisco Architecture Seller team(s).
* Collaborates with the Account Manager on the customer account plan(s), jointly ensuring customer success.
* Work with internal teams to orchestrate right solutions against customer requirements with competitive positioning
* Educate customer on Cisco differentiation and establish technical leadership of Cisco as a brand.
* Field role that serves as a Technology expert across solutions preferably within a multi\-domain architecture approach.
* Build relationship with Engineering Teams, field teams, architecture team, Business Units (BUs), Partners and customers.


**Who You’ll Work With**
 The India Strategic Enterprise Segment is a truly vibrant sales organization that covers the diverse set of accounts in the Enterprise Space. This position will be based out of Mumbai and will focus on a specific set of Enterprise accounts.
   

  

 As part of the Enterprise System Engineering Team, you will be designing, architecting and empowering the strategy for the next generation of communications and application delivery for India’s leading businesses. You'll collaborate as part of a disruptive Sales engineering team. We offer exhilarating, inspiring, global, high impact, and uniquely broad opportunities for your growth.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor of Engineering degree or equivalent
* Excellent written, oral communication, listening skills.
* Min 12\-15 years of presales experience in a technical capacity.
* Cisco products and technologies knowledge about one or more areas like Enterprise Networking, Security, Data centre or Collaboration.
* Understand the broad aspects of end to end architecture and have knowledge of one or more technology areas
* Should be confident in articulating in a customer conversation
* Technical knowledge in the Networking Solutions/SDN Architecture/Network Security /Datacentre Networking technologies.
* Strong whiteboarding/presentation skills.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Experience working with the Enterprise customers in similar roles.
* Technical certifications in any of the areas like Cloud/Security


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

cdae9168.title: DWS Security Solution Architect
cdae9168.description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
   

  

 Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked \#196 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full\-stack portfolio of AI\-enabled, AI\-ready, and AI\-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world\-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992\) (ADR: LNVGY).
   

  

 This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
   

  

 The Pre\-Sales Security Solution Architect will act as the technical bridge between sales teams and clients, designing tailored security solutions (firewalls, EDR, SIEM, Cloud Security) to meet customer needs. The SA will conduct technical presentations, demos, and Proof of Concepts (PoC) to drive sales,, manage RFPs/RFIs, and assist in achieving revenue targets.
   

  

 They have to be knowledgeable about the regional/in\-country federal security regulations. Have the acumen to perform research for specific requirements of customer. Help customers choose products, suggest the best practices for implementation of the product and prepare a roadmap for the product that is being recommended and future\-proof the selection. The person should act as a trusted advisor to the customer.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Technical Consultation: Engage with prospects to gather requirements, analyze security risks, and design customized security architectures.
* Demos PoCs: Deliver compelling technical product demonstrations and manage Proof of Concepts to showcase value.
* Solution Design: Build comprehensive security solutions including next\-gen firewalls, WAF, DLP, and endpoint security (EDR), MDR, SIEM, NextGen SOC Solutions, VA/PT solutions, AI For Security and Security for AI. Anti\-Ransomware solutions.
* Proposal Development: Collaborate with sales teams to prepare technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and commercial quotations.
* Relationship Management: Act as a trusted technical advisor, building strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Market Intelligence: Stay updated with emerging threats, industry trends, and competitor products to refine technical positioning.
* Federal Security requirements: Knowledgeable about the regional Cyber security compliance requirements, Security Standards in practice in country and in region.
* Translate the solution into deliverables: Knowledgeable about transaling the solution into actual deliverables.
* Train Sales Teams: Train and impart knowledge to sales teams for pitching solutions to customers, having meaningful conversations, providing customers with required information for helping Lenovo business grow.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Suitable candidate will at least have Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering or related field with at least 10\-12 years of experience in similar role
* 7\+ years of IT security technology Pre\-sales, or similar experience, preferably from a GSI
* 5\+ years’ experience in designing and delivering solutions that leverage cyber security technologies.
* Deep understanding of IT outsourcing services, technology industry, digital and cyber security technologies.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Collaborative approach to meeting business objectives and ability to influence at all levels of matrixed organizations
* Experience working with global teams and conducting business internationally, supporting different time zones.


 Have at least one of the certifications like CISSP, CISA, CRISC, CISM.
   

  

 OSCP, CEH, SANS Certifications will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Excellent communication skills
   

  

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

7cc1c65d.title: Solution Architect - VP
7cc1c65d.description:
Join us as a Solution Architect \- VP, Liquidity Management at Barclays, where you will set the strategic direction and architectural vision for our Liquidity Management platform. You will spearhead the evolution of enterprise‑critical financial systems, driving platform modernization, regulatory robustness, and engineering excellence across the organization.You will harness modern architectural paradigms and cloud‑native technologies to design and govern highly resilient, scalable, and auditable solutions, ensuring accurate interest computation, regulatory compliance, and seamless integration across core banking, payments, finance and treasury ecosystems. You will act as a senior technology leader, influencing strategy, mentoring architects, and partnering closely with business, risk, and regulatory stakeholders.
   

  

 To be successful as a Solution Architect \-VP, Liquidity Management, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Deep liquidity management and interest calculation, including cash flow forecasting, intraday liquidity, Single \& Multi\-Currency Pooling and regulatory drivers.
* Enterprise‑scale solution architecture leadership, defining target architectures, design standards, and architectural governance for complex banking platforms.
* Complex integration and data architecture, integrating core banking, payments, APIs, and event‑driven platforms while managing high‑volume, mission‑critical transactional data.
* Cloud and platform transformation, leading large‑scale implementations on Azure, AWS, or GCP with strong focus on resilience, security, performance, and regulatory compliance.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Experience with financial instruments and balance‑sheet products impacting liquidity and interest, including deposits, loans, and derivatives.
* Strong data and database architecture expertise across enterprise relational and NoSQL platforms.
* Proven leadership in regulatory‑driven design, ensuring auditability, traceability, model transparency, and compliance (e.g., Basel III).
* Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps, and driving cross‑functional alignment.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To lead the portfolio management team in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that portfolio management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Leading of portfolio management team, including setting of portfolio vision, management of portfolio performance, and provision of guidance and support to portfolio analysts.
* Monitoring of portfolio performance, including tracking of project progress, managing budgets, identification of thematic risks and issues, and reporting on portfolio status to senior management.
* Management of portfolio documentation, including aggregation of portfolio book of work, schedules, and budgets, and ensuring that portfolio documentation is up\-to\-date and accurate.
* Facilitation of portfolio governance, including ensuring that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives, aligned with the controls and governance standards and that portfolio thematic risks and issues are managed effectively.
* Managing the portfolio Book of Work outlining the sequence and dependencies of change initiatives, considering factors like resource availability, stakeholder buy\-in, and potential risks.
* Facilitation of change management activities, to ensure that change initiatives are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.
* Continuous improvement of portfolio management practices, including identification of areas for improvement and implementation of changes to improve portfolio performance.
* Collaboration with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that portfolio management practices are aligned with their needs and expectations.
* Development of portfolio management processes that are aligned with controls and governance standards and that support the delivery of successful projects.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

33fe7bd4.title: Partner Solution Architect
33fe7bd4.description:
**About Zuora**
 At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage\-based pricing to AI\-driven and outcome\-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
   

  

 We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI\-ready foundation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Partner Solution Architect is a key member of the Partner Delivery Success organization, responsible for helping partners successfully architect, plan, and deliver Zuora solutions. This role is the technical lead and trusted advisor to partners during partner\-led implementations, improving delivery quality, partner readiness, and technical adoption across the ecosystem.
   

  

 This person will work closely with Partners, Global Services, Sales, Customer, Product, and Support to guide solution design, validate technical approaches, mitigate delivery risk, and strengthen partner capability. The role is centered on the technical aspects of partner delivery and implementation success rather than account management.
   

  

**What You’ll Achieve**
* Enable partners to design and deliver scalable, high\-quality Zuora implementations.
* Improve partner implementation health, go\-live outcomes, and overall delivery quality.
* Increase partner technical capability through certification, enablement, and ongoing architecture guidance.
* Support technical governance across partner\-led projects by identifying risks early, guiding mitigation plans, and ensuring alignment to Zuora best practices.


**In This Role, You Will**
**Partner Solution Architecture \& Technical Guidance**
* Provide technical leadership to partners during scoping, discovery, solution design, and implementation planning.
* Design and validate solution architectures that meet stated and implied business requirements while aligning to Zuora best practices.
* Review partner technical deliverables to ensure compliance with architecture standards, integration patterns, and delivery guidelines.
* Produce and review architecture artifacts such as ecosystem and integration diagrams, process flows, swim lanes, ERDs, and related design documentation.


**Partner Implementation Oversight**
* Serve as a key technical point of contact for partner\-led implementations — supporting partner requirements, internal GS coordination, escalations, product and support alignment, and hypercare activities as needed.
* Help identify technical delivery risks and issues early, and work with partners and internal teams to define mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Support Areas of Complexity assessment and validation to ensure the right level of technical oversight is applied throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Provide technical guidance across design, build, test, deployment, UAT, and handoff stages of delivery.


**Partner Enablement \& Practice Development**
* Drive partner technical enablement by identifying capability gaps and supporting technical training, certification, and readiness programs.
* Conduct architecture reviews, office hours, and technical guidance sessions to support partner success on active and upcoming projects.
* Help partners strengthen their Zuora delivery practice through repeatable methods, best practices, and ongoing knowledge sharing.
* Share field feedback from partners and implementations with relevant Zuora teams to improve product adoption and delivery effectiveness.


**Opportunity \& Cross\-Functional Support**
* Partner with Sales, Partner Account Managers, and Global Services to assess partner fit for opportunities and support the right technical delivery model.
* Contribute technical insight during pre\-sales or early project phases to align partner capability with solution complexity and customer expectations.
* Support co\-delivery strategies that balance partner value, delivery quality, and successful customer outcomes.


**About You**
 You may be a great fit if you:
   

  

* Have enterprise\-level experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Technical Consultant, or Business Consultant in a professional services, partner delivery, or product\-led consulting environment.
* Have demonstrated experience delivering moderate to complex ERP, billing, revenue, procurement, CRM, or adjacent enterprise transformation solutions.
* Are strong in requirements gathering, business analysis, systems design, integration, implementation, and technical solution documentation.
* Have experience with data migration, interfaces, reporting, testing, and support across end\-to\-end implementations.
* Can simplify complex technical concepts and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Bring strong executive presence, with the ability to influence partners and internal stakeholders from project teams through senior leadership.
* Are comfortable working across distributed teams and managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Are comfortable working with Finance and business stakeholders, translating business goals into scalable technical solutions.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working with System Integrators, consulting partners, or partner\-led delivery models.
* Familiarity with partner enablement, technical certification programs, or practice development.
* Experience in both Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Experience presenting architecture recommendations, trade\-offs, and implementation approaches to internal and external audiences.


**About The Team**
*Draft below — please review and edit, Sujith; I wrote this from context in the role details but you know the team's day\-to\-day best.*
 The Partner Delivery Success team sits within Global Services and is responsible for ensuring Zuora’s partner ecosystem can consistently plan, architect, and deliver high\-quality implementations. The team partners closely with Global Services, Sales, Product, Support, and Customer teams to guide solution design, reduce delivery risk, and raise partner technical capability across the ecosystem.
   

  

 Team members work across a distributed, global partner base, balancing hands\-on architecture guidance with enablement and governance. 3bcbc985.description:
**Company Description** 
 Indian Institute Of Commerce, Lakshya is an education organization committed to empowering learners to turn their ambitions into tangible achievements. Since 2011, the institute has focused on delivering high\-quality commerce education and professional training that supports long\-term career growth. The culture emphasizes excellence, student success, and continuous improvement in teaching and guidance. Team members join a mission\-driven environment where they can contribute directly to shaping futures and supporting learners in reaching their goals.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Team Lead Presales will oversee and guide the presales function, supporting admissions and business development efforts through effective consultation and solution\-oriented communication. This full\-time, on\-site role in Bengaluru South includes leading a team of presales executives, setting daily and weekly targets, and monitoring performance to ensure high conversion rates. Responsibilities include managing inbound and outbound inquiries, qualifying leads, conducting needs assessments, and presenting appropriate course and program options to prospective students and guardians. The person in this role will collaborate with marketing and sales teams to align messaging, refine pitches, and optimize the admissions funnel, while maintaining accurate records in CRM tools and preparing regular reports for management. The Team Lead Presales will also mentor team members, conduct training sessions to improve product knowledge and communication skills, and ensure a professional, student\-centric experience at every touchpoint.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong presales and admissions support skills, including lead qualification, counseling, and converting inquiries into enrollments.
* Candidates should have team leadership and people management skills, such as mentoring, performance monitoring, and coaching for continuous improvement.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust, handle objections, and present programs clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Candidates should have basic analytical and reporting skills, including experience using CRM or admissions management tools and preparing performance summaries.
* Candidates should demonstrate strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple inquiries, follow\-ups, and priorities efficiently.
* Candidates with experience in education, training, or academic counseling, particularly in commerce or professional courses, will be highly preferred.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, marketing, or a related field is desirable, along with prior experience in presales, inside sales, or admissions roles.
* Candidates should be comfortable working on\-site in Bengaluru South and be willing to follow institute schedules, including peak admission periods.

Overview
 



  





 AtkinsRéalis is one of the world’s leading engineering design and programme management consultancies operating at the forefront of the infrastructure, transportation, and construction industry sectors. We’re recruiting for an experienced proposal lead, to be responsible for managing different phases of the company’s proposal process and oversee all required activities to develop RFP\-compliant, competitive, and quality marketing materials, proposals, statements of qualification, and presentations.
 



 You will be working closely with regional win work/technical leads and business development \& the engagement team across AtkinsRéalis and the wider organisation to produce compelling bids. As a member of the central Bid Management team, you will also be responsible for contributing to the continuous improvement of the win\-work capability (people, processes, tools, information, and governance).
 



  





 Your role
 



  




* Lead the development and application of proposal/bid themes. Develop organization chart with the pursuit team. Coordinate communication between SMEs and proposal writers. Lead teams through strategic reviews as per internal schedule.
* Exercise considerable initiative and independent judgment about content, wording, completeness, correctness, and appropriateness of proposal contents and graphics materials, making recommendations directly to pursuit team. Makes sound decisions.
* Supervise marketing assistants and/or less experienced proposal coordinators. Give work directions to graphic artists and marketing assistants involved in proposal production.
* Have experience leading pursuit responses – the larger and complex ones. Experience managing teams to deliver by established deadlines.
* Understanding of Architectural\-Engineering and project and construction management industry standards and disciplines. Can translate abstract ideas or narrative text into graphical concepts to illustrate concepts more effectively. Works independently yet functions effectively as a member of a team.
* Ensuring that the proposal is run in accordance with best practice and the win work capture plan and pursuit process, and in compliance with the Service Delivery Process.
* Provide client service, commitment, communication, innovation \& continuous improvement, professionalism, quality and teamwork. (Note that "Clients" may be internal managers and staff.)
* Added advantage if you have experience in capture planning
* Implement and facilitate capture planning process
* Facilitate kick off workshops and Go/No Go call
* Facilitate win theme sessions and supporting strategies
* Initiate and drive Go No Go calls and risk cat tool
* Portal Management (CRM tools) and Review procurement documents and attachments.
* Create and maintain a Proposal Management Plan.
* Develop compliance matrix, Storyboard templates and allocate bid deliverables.
* Review / approve response for standard prequalification questions.
* Check PQQ responses from JV partners (if applicable).
* Graphics co\-ordination, (colour schemes; word templates; document covers and dividers; images / photos; graphics / charts / graphs (where applicable) and Graphics approval in accordance with company’s Branding Guidelines.
* Work involves knowledgeable application of quality control as well as standard procedures and criteria to the coordination of proposals which are of critical importance to the firm.
* Assist in the development of preparation for Stage\-gate reviews – and facilitate bid go/no\-go decision.
* Support development of CVs.
* Work with the Business Development team to schedule \& co\-ordinate communications activities necessary to identify customer issues, hot buttons and the associated win themes and win strategy statements. Occasionally contact upper management for required signatures.
* Support the production of case studies / evidence scenarios.
* Coordinate with support services (legal, accounting, HR) on administrative sections of the pursuits (e.g., forms, statistics).
* Take constructive feedback and apply it to enhance the delivery.



  





*Submission* 




  




* Final quality review of documents, post\-formatting and after Bid Coordinator proofread / sense check.
* Final proofread / compliance check of tender documents.
* Close\-out actions with JV partners (if required).
* Client Presentation, Negotiate \& Contract, Feedback, Handover
* Lead, review, approve and disseminate Lessons Learnt feedback – Proposal Lead to lead the session with support from the Bid Co\-ordinator.
* Support response to Client Queries.
* Support preparation for client interviews / presentations.



  





 About you
 



  




* Promote and demonstrate team values and behaviours in line with the win work team practices
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Relationship building
* Ability to multi\-task and manage several projects at once
* Attention to detail
* Collaborative approach
* Time management skills
* Enthusiastic, initiative and the confidence to start things from scratch
* Confident using digital tools and learning new ones
* Promote the use of AtkinsRéalis work winning processes and tools
* In\-still a culture where others share knowledge, insights and learning



  





*Specific skills required* 




  




* A strong communicator with strong grammar, spelling, composition, and proofreading abilities.
* Able to evaluate, monitor and present ideas and data.
* Analytical with solid organisational skills, scheduling and prioritising activities.
* A flexible but methodical approach to supporting bids.
* Computer skills required and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Creative Suite, CRM, and other software programmes including LLMs.
* Comfortable and effective when working across all levels of an organisation.
* Makes sound decisions, but also works with other stakeholders (e.g., sales lead, capture lead, PM) to gain buy\-in.



  





 Rewards \& benefits
 



  





 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
 



 This includes:
 



 • Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
 



 • Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
 



 • Generous annual leave balance.
 



 • Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
 



 • Remote work opportunities outside of country.
 



 • Company gratuity scheme.
 



 • Discretionary bonus program.
 



 • Relocation assistance.
 



 • Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
 



 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
 



  





 About AtkinsRéalis
 



  





 We're AtkinsRéalis, a world\-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
 



 Find out more.

**This role is for one of the Weekday's clients**
**Salary range: Rs 2200000 \- Rs 2500000 (ie INR 22 \- 25 LPA)**
 Min Experience: 4\+ years
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 This is a hands\-on pre\-sales role for someone who opens the product and builds the thing rather than talking around it. You'll be the technical voice in the room on the most important deals—sitting across from CFOs, finance leaders, and engineering teams; understanding how a prospect's business actually works; and proving we solve problems most vendors can't crack. You'll write SQL, poke at REST APIs, map data flows, and configure real customer scenarios to own the technical win alongside the AE.
   

  

**Requirements**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Understand customer billing models and configure contracts, pricing, metering, and invoicing accurately
* Translate complex business requirements into clear, structured product workflows and setups for B2B SaaS products, focused on outcomes rather than features
* Run technical discovery with finance, RevOps, and engineering stakeholders — billing model, usage data, source systems, and rev rec requirements before anyone talks about features
* Partner with Sales on live demos, sandbox setups, and RFP responses, building demos tied to the prospect's real scenario: metered plans, usage ingestion, rated invoices, and revenue recognition
* Design the integration — map how usage flows from Postgres, Snowflake, or a warehouse into the platform, flagging idempotency, late\-arriving events, and reconciliation risks before they become implementation problems
* Own the technical win: qualify the deal, separate champion from economic buyer, multi\-thread to the CFO, and de\-risk the build so nothing falls apart post\-sale
* Prepare business case documents and fill RFPs, tying capability to a dollar saved or a risk removed
* Create customer\-specific solution documentation and clean handoff references when transitioning deals
* Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding structured patterns from discovery back to Product and Engineering


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years total experience with meaningful time in a hands\-on technical role — solutions or sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, data engineering, or backend and integrations work. Actual building, not support tickets
* Comfortable writing real SQL (group by, window functions, date logic) and building or debugging REST API integrations; knows the difference between an API and a webhook without thinking about it
* Vendor\-side B2B SaaS product experience, ideally billing, payments, fintech, ERP, or data\-infrastructure adjacent
* Client\-facing in a technical capacity: discovery, PoCs, demos, or implementation calls with real customers
* Comfortable supporting enterprise\-grade deal cycles and multi\-stakeholder buying processes with US or international customers
* Can hold a credible conversation with a CFO and with an engineer on the same day
* CS or engineering degree, or demonstrable equivalent shipped work
* Willing to work US\-overlap hours, roughly 6:00 PM \- 2:00 AM IST on weekdays
* Bonus: Experience at a small company (under 100 people, seed to Series A)
* Bonus: A sense of humor and the ability to not take yourself too seriously


**Required Skills**
 SQL, REST API integrations, Webhooks, Usage\-based billing, Metering \& rating, Revenue recognition, Solution design, Technical discovery, Demo building, RFP responses, Data pipeline mapping, Enterprise sales cycles, Stakeholder management, Business case development, Technical documentation
   

  

**Benefits \& Perks**
* Own the technical win on the company's most important enterprise deals
* Meaningful ESOPs in a fast\-growing startup
* Hands\-on ownership — configure and build in the product, not just present slides
* Direct exposure to CFOs and senior finance leaders at US and international companies
* Direct line into Product and Engineering as the voice of the customer
* Hybrid setup with only 2 fixed office days per week

Are you passionate about helping organizations transform the way people work through modern workplace, collaboration, and AI solutions?
 





 Do you enjoy engaging with business leaders to design innovative Microsoft and Google workplace experiences that drive productivity and business outcomes?
 





 Are you excited by the opportunity to shape digital workplace strategies, accelerate AI adoption, and work alongside leading technology partners?
 




  
 




 At SoftwareOne, we help organizations unlock the full value of cloud, workplace, and AI technologies. We are looking for a Solution Specialist – Digital Workplace to drive business growth, solution consulting, and presales engagements across Microsoft Modern Workplace, Google Workspace, Security \& Compliance, Employee Experience, and AI\-powered productivity solutions.
 




  
 




 As a Solution Specialist, you will act as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them modernize collaboration, strengthen security, and accelerate workplace transformation. Working closely with Sales, Delivery, Customer Success, Microsoft, and Google teams, you will design and position innovative solutions that solve business challenges while driving customer adoption and long\-term success.
 




  
 




**Key Responsibilities**




* Driving pipeline growth and customer engagement for Digital Workplace solutions across Enterprise, Mid\-Market, and Commercial customers.
* Leading customer discovery sessions, workshops, solution demonstrations, and presales engagements to identify business needs and define solution strategies.
* Designing and positioning Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Security \& Compliance, Employee Experience, and AI\-powered workplace solutions.
* Developing solution proposals, business cases, and supporting RFP, RFI, and RFQ responses to help customers achieve their transformation objectives.
* Building trusted relationships with business and technology stakeholders, including CIOs, CISOs, HR leaders, and Digital Transformation teams.
* Collaborating with Microsoft, Google, Sales, Customer Success, and Delivery teams to drive successful solution adoption and business outcomes.


**Job Requirements** 
* Experience working with Digital Workplace technologies, solution consulting, presales, architecture, or customer\-facing technology roles.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Modern Workplace, Google Workspace, Security \& Compliance, and AI productivity solutions.
* Experience engaging enterprise customers and translating business requirements into practical technology solutions.
* Excellent presentation, communication, stakeholder management, and consultative selling skills.
* Understanding of modern workplace security, identity, governance, compliance, and collaboration technologies.
* Ability to work collaboratively across partner ecosystems, sales teams, and technical delivery organizations.


**Company description** 








 SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.
   

  



 Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast\-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.
   

  



 Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

5990a27a.title: Solution Architect Pre-Sales
5990a27a.description:
**Description**
 We are looking for a seasoned Solution Architect (Pre\-Sales) to be a key contributor in our Pre\-Sales team. This role will work closely with customers and internal domain experts to understand business requirements, design end\-to\-end IT solutions, and prepare high\-quality pre\-sales and bid documents while ensuring that delivery teams remain focused on project execution. The role demands strong hands\-on technical experience, architectural thinking, analytical skills, and excellent communication in English and Hindi.
   

  

**Experience**
* 8\+ Years


**Qualification:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in in Engineering / Computer Science / IT (or equivalent).


**Location:**
* Trivandrum


**Skills/Requirements**
 Technical \& Architecture Skills:
   

  

* Strong understanding of enterprise IT concepts, including:
* DBMS (RDBMS and NoSQL)
* Web Servers and Application Servers
* Hands\-on development experience in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, .NET or equivalent)
* Application design patterns and coding best practices
* APIs and system integrations (REST / SOAP / event\-based integrations, etc.)
* Microservices and monolithic architecture concepts
* Cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP – architectural and deployment understanding)
* Containerization and orchestration concepts (Docker, Kubernetes – conceptual)
* Data migration strategies and ETL concepts
* Analytics, reporting, and dashboards
* AI / ML fundamentals and use cases
* Blockchain and IoT concepts
* Data Centre (DC) and Disaster Recovery (DR) architecture
* Security fundamentals (authentication, authorization, encryption, compliance etc.)


**Project, Process \& Quality Understanding**
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies: Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, Hybrid.
* Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies (manual and automated).
* Familiarity with tools used across development, testing, DevOps, and project management.
* Ability to design solutions aligned with realistic delivery models and quality standards.


 Analytics \& Problem Solving:
   

  

* Strong analytical skills to evaluate requirements, constraints, and trade\-offs.
* Ability to perform feasibility analysis, impact assessment, and risk identification.
* Data\-driven approach to solution design and decision\-making.


 Communication \& Stakeholder Skills:
   

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical solutions to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.


**Responsibilities:** 
 Customer Engagement \& Business Analysis:
   

  

* Engage with customers to understand business goals, functional needs, and non\-functional requirements.
* Conduct workshops, requirement discovery sessions, and technical discussions with stakeholders.
* Analyse existing systems and processes to prepare AS\-IS / TO\-BE documentation.
* Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for business process improvement and digital transformation


 Solution Architecture \& Design:
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures covering application, integration, data, infrastructure, security, and analytics layers.
* Define solution approaches aligned with customer constraints, scalability, performance, security, and cost considerations.
* Evaluate multiple solution options and recommend the most suitable architecture


 Pre\-Sales \& Bid Support:
   

  

* Lead or contribute to preparation of:
* AS\-IS / TO\-BE documents
* BPR documents
* Detailed Project Reports (DPR)
* Technical proposals and solution write\-ups
* RFP / RFI responses, including assumptions, risks, dependencies, and exclusions
* Support high\-level effort estimation, timelines, and resource planning for proposals.


 Transition \& Internal Coordination:
   

  

* Work closely with domain experts, product teams, and management to finalize solutions.
* Ensure minimal dependency on delivery teams during pre\-sales.
* Support smooth transition from pre\-sales to delivery through structured knowledge transfer and documentation.


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Computer Science / IT (or equivalent).
* 9\+ years of overall IT experience.
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in solution architecture and/or pre\-sales roles.
* Prior hands\-on development experience is mandatory.
* Experience in RFP\-based bidding and proposal preparation is highly desirable.
* Exposure to government or large enterprise IT projects is an added advantage.


 Preferred / Added Advantages:
   

  

* Experience in proposal estimations and costing models.
* Knowledge of compliance standards, security frameworks, or government IT guidelines.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to mentor junior architects or business analysts in pre\-sales activities

fd02a24d.title: Solutions Engineer
fd02a24d.description:
You will be part of Cisco's Technical Sales organization, serving as a trusted advisor to customers and partners while representing Cisco’s industry\-leading portfolio across Networking, Security, Cloud, Collaboration, AI, and emerging technologies. The team works closely with account managers, business entities, partners, and customers to deliver innovative solutions that address complex business challenges and drive customer success.
   

  

 As a technical sales professional, you will own the technical relationship with customers and partners, helping them achieve their business outcomes through Cisco’s technology portfolio. You will collaborate across sales teams, technical experts, and stakeholders to identify opportunities, design solutions, and expand Cisco's footprint within strategic accounts.
   

  

**Your Impact**
**Role**
 As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving customer success and business growth by aligning technology solutions with customer objectives. You will:
   

  

* Collaborate with account teams to develop and execute customer account strategies, identifying opportunities for growth, cross\-selling, and upselling.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Translate customer business requirements into technical solutions leveraging Cisco’s full portfolio.
* Design, present, and demonstrate solutions that showcase the business value and technical capabilities of Cisco technologies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with technical and business decision\-makers across customer organizations.
* Lead customer engagements and strategic discussions with IT leaders and line\-of\-business stakeholders.
* Identify customer challenges and tailor solutions that address specific business and technical requirements.
* Drive technical aspects of the sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through solution design and deal closure.
* Manage and coordinate virtual teams of technical resources to support customer opportunities.
* Participate in demand generation, enablement programs, and customer\-facing campaigns.
* Proactively monitor market trends and competitive activity to position Cisco effectively and increase market share.
* Collaborate with internal business entities and sales teams to provide customer feedback, market insights, and strategic recommendations.
* Lead educational and enablement initiatives to increase awareness and adoption of Cisco solutions among customers, partners, and stakeholders.
* Adapt and prioritize effectively within a dynamic and evolving sales environment.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 10\+ years of experience in technical pre\-sales, solution engineering, or customer\-facing technical sales roles.
* Proven experience leading customer engagements and technical sales cycles.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology domains including Networking, Security, Cloud, Collaboration, and AI.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience delivering technical presentations, demonstrations, and solution workshops to customers and partners.
* Strong customer engagement, communication, and relationship management skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams and influence stakeholders.
* Commercial awareness with a strong focus on customer success and business outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCNP, or equivalent vendor certifications.
* Solution design and architecture experience across Networking, Security, Cloud, AI, Collaboration, and related technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise and strategic accounts.
* Strong competitive positioning and market analysis capabilities.
* Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, market share expansion, and customer acquisition.
* Self\-motivated professional capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced and highly collaborative environment.
* Experience leading virtual technical teams and mentoring peers.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic planning skills.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Growth in revenue through successful conversion of opportunities into closed deals.
* Increased penetration within existing accounts through cross\-selling and upselling.
* Expansion of Cisco market share through competitive displacement.
* Acquisition of new customers and development of long\-term strategic relationships.
* Customer satisfaction and successful achievement of customer business outcomes.
* Effective collaboration across sales, technical, and partner ecosystems.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

fc0789ae.title: Solutions Engineer
fc0789ae.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Solution Engineer, you will serve as the customer\-facing advocate for Razorpay suite of products, supporting prospects with technical implementation for large enterprises. This role reports to the Head of Integrations within the Business Engineering team at Razorpay. The individual will play a key role in ensuring the successful integration of Curlec’s platform with merchants, enabling seamless payment solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* This Individual should have a deep understanding of the entire product suite.
* Should be up\-to\-date in the technical knowledge and in\-depth understanding of any coding language is a must.
* Responsible to represent Razorpay from platform integration perspective with prospective merchants.
* Accountable to ensure successful implementation of platform integration between Curlec by Razorpay and merchants.
* Support the reactive queries and requests being raised by Merchants within an agreed turnaround time and quality standards.
* Read and respond to integration and platform documents shared by prospective customers.
* The individual will act as a key feedback channel for customer's product requirements/ expectations and will close the loop with the Product team on the same.
* In the case of product customisation requests from the clients, he/she would help validate the requirements.


**Requirements**
* 2\+ years of experience in product\-based payments or SaaS platform integrations, implementation, or solutions in a customer\-facing role.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
* Hands\-on experience with Java, .NET, PHP, Python, and JavaScript.
* Strong expertise in REST APIs.
* Strong ability to understand technical requirements and ensure seamless platform integration for enterprise clients.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong presentation abilities.
* Preferably from a Fintech background.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn \& Twitter

68c4af5a.title: Cloud Architect
68c4af5a.description:
Join our cloud engineering team and play a pivotal role in designing, building, and evolving enterprise\-scale cloud platforms. As a
 **Cloud Architect** 
 , you will drive cloud transformation initiatives, define architecture standards, develop scalable cloud solutions, and partner with product teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high\-performing cloud\-native applications. This role combines technical leadership, innovation, and hands\-on cloud engineering expertise to enable business success through modern cloud technologies.
 



  





**Your Role** 




  





 You will be responsible for architecting and governing cloud solutions, enhancing cloud platforms, and enabling product teams to adopt cloud technologies effectively. Working closely with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders, you will ensure cloud environments are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards. \[Job Positing \| Word]
 



  





**In this role, you will:** 




  




* Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure and enterprise cloud solutions.
* Collaborate with product teams to develop, deploy, and support cloud\-native applications and services.
* Define, develop, and maintain cloud integration guardrails, governance standards, and architectural guidelines.
* Drive cloud transformation and adoption initiatives across business and technology teams.
* Contribute to cloud engineering capability building through coaching, training, and technical enablement programs.
* Develop, enhance, and continuously improve cloud platforms and implement architectural changes to support evolving business needs.
* Manage cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and decommissioning activities.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and point of contact for cloud architecture, transformation, and adoption\-related initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, conduct proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs), and recommend innovative solutions.
* Develop reference architectures and reusable design patterns to promote consistency, scalability, and quality across cloud implementations.
* Troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement corrective actions, and establish preventive measures.
* Review solutions throughout key development milestones to ensure compliance with architecture, security, and quality standards.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define operating procedures, design objectives, and implementation strategies.
* Plan and execute delivery activities using Agile methodologies and industry\-standard engineering practices.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Agile teams to deliver high\-quality solutions within committed timelines.
* Ensure operational excellence, platform reliability, and continuous service improvement across cloud environments



  





**Your Profile** 




  





**Mandatory Skills** 




  




* 12\+ years of experience in automotive architecture with strong focus on ADAS system design, development, and integration.
* Strong expertise in Cloud Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in Cloud Infrastructure Design, Build, Maintenance, and Operations.
* Proven experience in Cloud Platform Engineering and Cloud\-Native Technologies.
* Strong understanding of Cloud Governance, Guardrails, Security, and Compliance frameworks.

 Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. **Job Title: Solution Architect**

 12–15 Years

 Hyderabad
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Solution Architect** 
 to lead the design and delivery of enterprise\-scale technology solutions for mission\-critical banking applications. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in designing highly available, cloud\-native, API\-first, and microservices\-based architectures that support large\-scale, customer\-facing applications.
 



 As a Solution Architect, you will work closely with engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, security, product, and business stakeholders to define technology roadmaps, modernize legacy applications, and deliver scalable, resilient, and secure enterprise solutions. This role requires strong technical leadership, strategic thinking, and hands\-on architectural expertise within a highly regulated banking environment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Enterprise Solution Architecture** 



* Design end\-to\-end architecture for complex, enterprise\-grade, multi\-tier applications from requirements gathering through implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Define scalable architecture patterns for cloud\-native, distributed, and API\-driven applications.
* Develop architecture blueprints, reference architectures, solution diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, security policies, and business objectives.



**Application Modernization** 



* Lead modernization initiatives by transforming monolithic applications into loosely coupled, microservices\-based architectures.
* Define migration strategies for legacy applications to cloud\-native platforms.
* Establish best practices for service decomposition, domain\-driven design (DDD), and event\-driven architectures.
* Drive adoption of modern software engineering principles and reusable architectural patterns.



**Cloud Architecture \& API Strategy** 



* Architect cloud\-native solutions using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Design secure, scalable, and resilient RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
* Define cloud architecture patterns supporting high availability, disaster recovery, elasticity, and fault tolerance.
* Collaborate with cloud engineering teams to implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation.



**Scalability, Performance \& Reliability** 



* Design highly available, fault\-tolerant, and resilient customer\-facing applications capable of operating at enterprise banking scale.
* Define strategies for:
* Performance optimization
* Load balancing
* Auto\-scaling
* Caching
* High availability
* Disaster recovery
* Business continuity
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency improvements.



**Architecture Governance** 



* Participate in architecture governance forums, design reviews, and technology evaluation committees.
* Establish reusable design standards, architecture principles, and governance frameworks.
* Review solution designs to ensure adherence to enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Promote engineering best practices across development teams.



**Data Architecture** 



* Design enterprise data solutions leveraging both relational and NoSQL databases.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate data storage technologies based on business requirements.
* Define data integration, data governance, and data security strategies.
* Work with database teams to optimize performance and scalability.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Partner with:
* Engineering Teams
* Infrastructure Teams
* Security Teams
* DevOps Teams
* Product Owners
* Business Stakeholders
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Clearly communicate architecture decisions, trade\-offs, and implementation strategies to both technical and non\-technical audiences.



**Risk, Security \& Compliance** 



* Ensure architecture complies with banking and financial services regulations including:
* PCI\-DSS
* SOX
* GLBA
* Enterprise Security Standards
* Apply secure\-by\-design principles across solution architecture.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to address risks and compliance requirements.
* Support audit, governance, and regulatory reviews.



**Leadership \& Mentorship** 



* Provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams.
* Mentor software engineers, technical leads, and junior architects.
* Drive architectural excellence and foster innovation across the organization.
* Influence strategic technology decisions and long\-term platform roadmaps.



**Required Qualifications** 




**Experience** 



* 12–15 years of experience in software engineering, application development, or enterprise architecture.
* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale, customer\-facing applications.

**Architecture Expertise** 




 Strong understanding of:

* Microservices Architecture

* Event\-Driven Architecture
* Domain\-Driven Design (DDD)
* API\-First Design
* Cloud\-Native Architecture



**Cloud Technologies**

* Microsoft Azure
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)



 Experience designing:
 


* Cloud\-native applications
* High Availability architectures
* Disaster Recovery solutions
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Cloud security architectures



**Application Development** 




 Experience designing and supporting:
 


* RESTful APIs
* GraphQL APIs
* Microservices
* Event\-driven systems

**Database Technologies** 




 Strong knowledge of:
 


* Relational Databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
* NoSQL Databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redis, Couchbase)
* Data modeling and database optimization
* Legacy and modern database technologies



**Technical Domains** 




 Working experience in at least two or more of the following:
 


* Infrastructure
* Cloud Computing
* Security
* DevOps
* Application Development

**Banking \& Financial Services**

 Frontend exposure:

e3d0b607.title: AWS Solutions Architect
e3d0b607.description:
**Job Summary:**




  





 As an AWS Solution Architect, your primary responsibility will be to design and deploy secure, scalable, and highly available AWS cloud\-based solutions for clients. You will work closely with clients, understanding their business requirements, and architecting cost\-effective and efficient solutions that align with their goals. You will also collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including developers, engineers, and project managers, to ensure successful implementation and delivery of AWS solutions.
 



  





**Responsibilities:**




  





 · Design and architect AWS cloud\-based solutions that meet client requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
 



 · Collaborate with clients to understand their business needs and translate them into technical requirements and solution designs.
 



 · Assess existing infrastructure and systems, identify opportunities for migration or adoption of AWS services, and create migration plans.
 



 · Develop highly available and fault\-tolerant architecture patterns using AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others.
 



 · Create technical documentation including solution architecture diagrams, design documents, and deployment guides.
 



 · Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to development teams to ensure adherence to AWS best practices and standards.
 



 · Implement and configure AWS services, infrastructure automation, and orchestration using tools like AWS Cloud Formation, Terraform, or Ansible.
 



 · Monitor and optimize AWS resources and services, identifying opportunities for cost optimization and performance improvements.
 



 · Collaborate with operations teams to ensure smooth deployment and ongoing management of AWS solutions.
 



 · Stay up\-to\-date with the latest AWS technologies, services, and best practices, sharing knowledge and insights with the team and clients.
 



  





**Requirements:**




  





 · Proven experience as an AWS Solution Architect or similar role, designing and implementing AWS cloud\-based solutions.
 



 · Strong understanding of AWS services and experience with core services like EC2, S3, VPC, RDS, Route 53, Lambda, and CloudFront.
 



 · Hands\-on experience with infrastructure automation and provisioning tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible.
 



 · Proficient in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
 



 · Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestrators like Kubernetes.
 



 · Strong knowledge of network and security concepts within AWS, including IAM, Security Groups, VPC peering, and VPN.
 



 · Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
 



 · Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



  





 · AWS certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Associate or Professional.
