c9e9d6fa.description:
**About WSO2:** 




 Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open\-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next\-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI\-enabled digital services and applications. Our open\-source, AI\-driven, API\-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock\-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit
 
 https://wso2\.com
 
 to learn more.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 Enterprise Architects are highly visible, enterprise\-grade technical consultants who engage directly with WSO2 prospects and customers. This role is fundamental to establishing definitive thought leadership by providing high\-level consultation and strategic guidance on addressing complex enterprise application challenges using the WSO2 platform.
 



 As an Enterprise Architect, you will be responsible for translating ambitious business goals into technically precise, implementable solutions, directly supporting high\-stakes sales and customer success initiatives.
 



  





**Responsibilities and Duties:** 



* Design custom demos and proof of concepts (POCs) that align with customer business needs. Evaluate RFP technical feasibility. Contribute to RFP responses by outlining technical and business capabilities.
* Map potential technologies to customer business and integration requirements.
* Clearly communicate technical and business benefits in presentations.
* Create high\-quality solution designs that meet customer expectations.
* Develop subject matter expertise in WSO2 products, architecture, industry verticals, and competitive offerings. Apply this knowledge to enhance your personal brand, advise customers, and share expertise with the team.
* Provide feedback to teams on customer feature usage and alignment with design, implementation, and integration. Share architect expectations based on industry standards and developer/DevOps best practices. Raise and follow up on critical product issues and features.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of technology usage, including but not limited to WSO2 products, evolution, and future predictions within relevant domains and areas of specialization. Actively participate in discussions regarding technology, product features, direction, company vision, and process improvements.
* Lead technical aspects of project deliveries, collaborating closely with the delivery manager/PM. Take technical ownership, manage expectations, and communicate effectively with customers, the product team, service delivery personnel, and the internal team.
* Develop estimates and detailed schedules for complex projects, collaborating with product specialists.
* Communicate schedules clearly to customers and stakeholders, addressing assumptions, dependencies, and responsibilities.
* Conduct paid deployment reviews for customers, reviewing the solution and deployment architecture. Recommend best practices for using WSO2 products, aligning with customer requirements and use cases. Produce architectural review (AR) documents. Follow up on pending/future items with the customer and account manager (AM).
* Conduct technical workshops for customers, partners, and public users. Design workshop content tailored to diverse audiences, including CXOs, architects, developers, and DevOps engineers. Align content (slides, demos) with customer business problems and use cases.
* Assume primary or secondary technical ownership. Lead post\-sales expansions, architectural reviews, and customer engagements. Participate in account planning with AMs. Conduct workshops, webinars, and customer events. Follow up on all post\-sales activities. Build strong customer relationships and become a trusted advisor. Manage multiple accounts and prospects of varying size and complexity.
* Drive business and technical discussions with strategic accounts.
* Lead customer escalations. Collaborate with the support team to resolve critical production issues and conduct root cause analysis. Ensure issue resolution and customer satisfaction. Identify and address underlying problems, developing and implementing solutions.
* Lead and manage team members. Mentor new team members, ensuring role clarity and supporting their professional development.
* Write high\-quality articles, blogs, and content that position you as an expert and drive traffic to WSO2\. Focus on enterprise and business architecture content for CXOs and enterprise architects. Propose innovative concepts and patterns.
* Collaborate with marketing to deliver webinars, events, and public workshops. Design and lead sessions, ensuring market relevance.
* Leverage past experience to enhance team processes, individual skills (through knowledge sharing), and company vision. Adapt and implement successful strategies from previous roles within the WSO2 culture.
* Become an SME in a specific area, leveraging past experiences to improve WSO2\. If no prior experience, develop expertise in a domain, subject matter, or industry vertical.
* Lead technical discussions within the team, demonstrating strong WSO2 product knowledge and a broad understanding of related technologies. Continuously expand technical breadth and share knowledge with the team, WSO2, and the wider community through talks, blogs, and articles.
* Lead and implement practices to enhance team productivity and quality. Initiate, collaborate, and lead tasks to improve team functions across the team, WSO2, and your specific pod/region. Measure the impact of initiatives and ensure their adoption and implementation into business\-as\-usual (BAU) operations.
* Continuously learn and share new ideas, concepts, and technologies with WSO2 and the team. Expand learning beyond technology to encompass areas like architecture, leadership, and management.



  





**Requirements:** 



* BSc in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent.
* At least 8 to 10 years of solid industry experience, with at least 3 years as a Solution Architect or a similar role in Sales Engineering.
* Experience in business, system architecture principles, architecture patterns, processes, and frameworks.
* Exceptional client management and communication skills, ability to mentor team members, and negotiate technical decisions.
* Ability to travel on short notice for short\-term assignments.



  





**In addition, you should:** 



* Be willing to learn MSA, SOA, EDA, enterprise middleware, and cloud computing, while actively participating in the entire process, from design to implementation.
* Exhibit natural curiosity, an analytical mind, and a willingness to explore the unknown.
* Have an affinity for new challenges, a self\-starting attitude, and a willingness to work with a global team.
* Be able to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution individually as well as work effectively through escalations with the engineering team.
* Possess an amicable personality and excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including sensitivity to the local cultures of WSO2’s global customer and employee base.
* Have the ability (e.g., passport) to travel overseas.



  





**Benefits:** 




 We want every team member to feel happy, cared for, and energized at WSO2\. That's why, in addition to our performance\-driven commission structure, we offer benefits and facilities designed to support your life and work.
 


* Flexible Leave Policy: We trust you to manage your time and performance. Enjoy a flexible vacation policy as long as you continue to demonstrate your commitment to shared goals.
* Comprehensive Healthcare: Your health is a priority. You are entitled to Health Benefits as detailed in the Company Healthcare plan.
* Essential Equipment: Start strong with a laptop provided as per standard company specifications. You can also request additional equipment like a mouse, keyboard, or monitor to build your ideal workspace.



  





**Diversity Drives Innovation:** 




 We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

c88d1fea.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
c88d1fea.description:
Yext is the leading global enterprise agentic marketing platform. For over 15 years, the world's most recognized brands in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food have relied on us to keep their brand visible, accurate, and ahead of the competition across every search and AI surface that matters.
   

  

 We drive customer value through our technology, competitive intelligence, and agentic capabilities to win in an AI\-first world. Our partners count on us for strategic, proactive guidance and capabilities, and that distinction shapes everything we build.
   

  

 Our team takes ownership, challenges each other's thinking, and turns ideas into results without waiting for a playbook. Those who perform at Yext are rewarded with increased scope, opportunities to tackle complex challenges, broader responsibilities, and meaningful development that enables them to grow alongside a company expanding through both product innovation and strategic acquisitions. The market is racing to adapt to AI, and Yext is at the forefront of that shift. Our ambitions are big, our innovation is accelerating, and the opportunity in front of us is enormous. If you want to do the most important work of your career, come join us!
   

  

 Yext is actively seeking a
 **Senior Cloud Security Engineer** 
 reporting to the Manager of Product Security within the Cyber Security Office. This role will serve as a core pillar of our Product and Infrastructure Security program, shifting our focus toward robust Cloud Security automation, container security, and Security as Code. The role will enable product, engineering, IT, and security teams to make the right architectural decisions by implementing automated security controls, managing advanced cloud security tools, and leading security incident response efforts. In this role, you will also assist other Cyber Security leaders in driving a culture of security awareness within Yext, promote DevSecOps best practices, and champion cloud compliance initiatives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive Cloud Security Maturity: Lead the maturity of our Cloud and Enterprise Security programs by proactively identifying architectural infrastructure gaps and developing optimized, automated solutions.
* Security as Code \& Guardrails: Design, deploy, and maintain immutable cloud security controls across AWS and GCP environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform.
* Container \& Orchestration Security: Define, implement, and monitor security baselines for containerized workloads and orchestration platforms, focusing on Docker and Kubernetes runtime security.
* CI/CD \& DevSecOps Automation: Integrate automated security testing tools (SAST, DAST, dependency, and secret scanning) directly into engineering deployment pipelines.
* Vulnerability \& Patch Management: Oversee the cloud vulnerability scanning program, prioritizing vulnerabilities based on runtime risk and coordinating comprehensive remediation processes across engineering teams.
* Threat Modeling \& Architecture Reviews: Lead comprehensive security architecture reviews and threat modeling sessions for cloud\-native applications, providing actionable technical recommendations to Product and Engineering partners.
* Policy \& Compliance: Author and contribute to cloud security policies, procedures, and standards while mapping technical controls to compliance frameworks like SOC2 and ISO 27001\.


**What You Have**
* Experience: 6\+ years of relevant work experience in Cloud Security Engineering or Product Security
* Cloud Infrastructure Expertise: Deep technical knowledge and hands\-on implementation experience managing security controls within AWS and/or GCP environments.
* Infrastructure as Code: Proven experience utilizing Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi to deploy and manage secure infrastructure.
* Container Security Proficiency: Practical experience securing Kubernetes environments, managing network policies, and scanning container images.
* Security Automation: High proficiency in security automation using Python, Go, PowerShell, or Bash scripting to eliminate manual tasks.
* Framework Familiarity: Strong alignment with security frameworks and standards such as NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS benchmarks.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Strong communication skills and a proven history of collaborating effectively with Engineering, IT, and Product stakeholders to build high\-trust partnerships.


**Nice To Have But Not Required**
* SIEM \& Log Analysis: Strong understanding of centralized logging architectures, SIEM platforms, and data analysis for identifying anomalies.
* DFIR \& Frameworks: Practical knowledge of cloud DFIR methodologies and advanced application of the MITRE ATT\&CK framework to detect and remediate modern threat vectors.
* Certifications: CCSP, AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or equivalent cloud security certifications.


 In today's dynamic threat environment, software firms are increasingly acknowledged as a highly\-targeted industry for cyberattacks due to the confidentiality and sensitivity of customer data, as well as the immediacy in which that data is needed to perform their operational duties. Given Yext’s vital role within the software ecosystem, protection of data is paramount in ensuring high\-trust relationships with customers, partners, and vendors.
   

  

 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

HCLTech’ Digital Business Services is looking for experienced transition leaders for its Transition Centre of Excellence (CoE). The Transition CoE is a global team of high performing transition experts who are responsible for the full lifecycle of a customer journey from RFPs to Transition executions. Senior Transition Managers should have deep knowledge, expertise, and experience of leading global application transition programs in complex and challenging environments. They should be willing to work in an individual contributor capacity as well as leading a team of transition experts for executing transition programs. Senior Transition Managers are responsible for creating and defending the end\-to\-end transition solutions and subsequently leading the transition execution programs. Additional responsibility includes working on various initiatives with respect to enhancing the framework, automation, CoE libraries and participate in analyst/ advisor briefings.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**A. Transition Solution:**  

Overall responsibility for creating customized and ‘fit for purpose’ transition solution and sizing for large and medium sized RFPs
  
Review and provide guidance to team members for small sized RFPs
  
Ensure HCLTech’s transition framework, tools \& accelerators are followed
  
Create week\-on\-week transition ramp\-up and provide complete inputs for transition budgets based on CoE’s cost and effort models
  
Participate in internal leadership reviews to get the transition solution and budgets approved
  
Own the transition related content and presentations to clients bid defense and deep\-dive workshops
  
Participate in due\-diligence exercises
  
  

**B. Transition Executions:**  

Overall responsible for the management, performance, and execution of the Transition Program
  
Ensure all planning is coordinated, consolidated and in line with HCL's contractual obligations
  
Ensure standard CoE methodology, deliverables and approach is followed for transition execution
  
Monitor progress of transition plan and the associated tasks and responsibilities (with respect to responsibility of HCL or client or incumbent supplier) against the transition schedule, timelines and milestones
  
Conduct transition cadence meetings
  
Identify, monitor and manage any risks or issues via an updated Transition Risk Register and take appropriate preventive and corrective measures
  
Review transition deliverables and ensure effective knowledge transfer
  
Conduct toll\-gate checkpoint reviews and go/no\-go meetings with client stakeholders
  
Conduct the Transition to Delivery handover meetings
  
Ensure Critical Milestones and deliverables are identified and completed on time
  
Monitor, track and report against the transition resource ramp\-up plan
  
Interface with steady state delivery managers for handover
  
Provide leadership and guidance to transition team (TM's, TMO)
  
Responsible for managing all the support tracks to ensure it aligns with the overall transition objectives along with the cost and timelines.
  
Address program level issues with delivery team leadership and client leadership
  
Conduct transition closure activities as per the CoE framework
  
  

**C. Transition CoE Initiatives:**  

Participate/ lead the CoE initiatives to enhance transition framework, accelerators, libraries, tools and templates
  
Prepare content for analyst meets and other CoE initiatives aimed at increasing the internal and external visibility
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
Demonstrate strong program management skills and experience of leading more than one medium to large (150\+ FTE) Application Transitions
  
Must have a strong solution mindset and ability to create differentiated and risk\-mitigated transition solutions to address client requirements
  
Exhibit client centricity and experience of managing senior client stakeholders on a global scale
  
Must have a collaborative mindset and develop amicable working relationships with cross\-functional teams
  
Must be good at problem solving and managing challenges with a positive and calm approach
  
Demonstrate leadership skills required to manage large cross\-functional teams during program executions
  
Possess effective written, oral communication and presentation skills
  
Must be articulative during leadership interactions internally as well as externally
  
  

Other Requirements
  
Over 12 years of experience in the IT industry with a minimum of 8 years of transition experience
  
Educational Qualifications – MBA/ B.E./ B. Tech.
  
Scrum/ Agile/ PMP/ ITIL/ Six Sigma certification
  
Valid USA/ UK/ Schengen/ Australia Business Visa

8fb73727.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
8fb73727.description:
**About Tekion:** 




 Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud\-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting\-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.
 



 Job Introduction
 



 We are seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to own the cross\-team delivery machinery for a 20\-person AI native engineering organization. This is not a project coordination role — it is a technical program ownership role. You will maintain the master delivery plan across two Scrum teams and shared resources, track and resolve cross\-team dependencies (platform teams, ARC backend, OEM integrations), manage risk before it becomes a miss, and create the delivery transparency that allows Engineering, Product, and Executive leadership to make fast, informed decisions. The best TPMs are invisible when things go well and indispensable when they don't.
 



 Key Role \& Responsibilities
 


* Own the master delivery plan: maintain the integrated roadmap across both Scrum teams, shared resources (Architect, ML, SDET), and external platform dependencies — with milestone\-level clarity at all times.
* Track and resolve cross\-team dependencies: Agentic Engine, Core Platform (Temporal, MCP Gateway, Component Framework), ARC backend (Kafka event contracts, API dependencies), Design (component specs), and external vendors (email/SMS providers).
* Run the delivery rhythm: sprint review calendar, cross\-team sync cadence, dependency review meetings, and risk escalation forums — keeping the Director and VP Engineering informed without burying them in status updates.
* Identify, quantify, and manage delivery risks: surface blockers early, drive resolution with urgency, and maintain a live risk register with mitigation owners and timelines.
* Own cross\-team technical communication: translate engineering status into language that Product, Business, and Executive stakeholders can act on — and translate business urgency back into engineering trade\-off decisions.
* Drive the release process: define release criteria, coordinate go/no\-go decisions with Engineering, QA (Staff SDET), and Product, and manage production deployments across services.
* Manage the dependency interface to the T1 Agentic Engine team: track which Intent, Skill, Policy, and MCP tool registrations are ready, which are blocked, and what the critical path impact is.
* Continuously improve the delivery system: identify bottlenecks in the engineering process, drive retrospectives, and implement changes that sustainably increase throughput and quality.



 Basic Qualifications
 


* 12\+ years of technical program management experience, with at least 3 years at Staff level managing multi team programs at SaaS or platform companies.
* Strong technical depth: able to read architecture diagrams, understand Kafka dependency graphs, evaluate API contract blockers, and participate credibly in engineering design discussions.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-team delivery programs with many external dependencies — including platform dependencies outside your direct control.
* Expert facilitation of engineering delivery rituals: sprint planning, dependency reviews, release gates, post mortems, and architecture syncs.
* Deep understanding of AI\-native product delivery: what makes AI system delivery different from traditional software (eval requirements, model versioning, non\-deterministic outputs, golden dataset dependencies).
* Excellent written communication: can produce a crisp, executive\-readable status update that tells the truth clearly and drives decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management across Engineering, Product, Design, and Executive levels — comfortable managing up, across, and down.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience managing delivery programs that involve both Java microservices and Python AI/ML engineering teams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with agentic AI platform concepts: intent registries, MCP tools, skill/policy authoring, and eval frameworks — enough to track technical dependency status accurately.
* Background in automotive retail technology or dealer management systems.
* Prior experience working in a US\-India distributed engineering organization.



 Perks \& Benefits
 


* Opportunity to work with some of the smartest minds to solve complex challenges at scale.
* Impactful role in shaping and securing a global, cloud\-native \& AI driven platform.
* Innovative, collaborative, and fast\-paced culture.

0cf34e08.title: Cloud Application Modernisation Architect (f/m/d)
0cf34e08.description:
Pune (IND)
  
Software Development
  
Fulltime
  
**Published:** 2026\-07\-29
  
What do we do?
  
Introducing Thinkproject Platform
  
  

Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.
  
  

By combining information management expertise and in\-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.
  
What your day will look like
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for two Cloud Application Modernisation \& Agentic Architects (f/m/d) to own the end\-to\-end refactoring of Thinkproject's application portfolio — 10 applications, 3 of which are major, mission\-critical products. You will work as a pair, splitting application ownership between you, and you are expected to move fast: full refactoring across the portfolio within 6–8 months.
  
  

This is not a design\-and\-delegate role. You will roll up your sleeves, conduct the refactoring hands\-on, and manage the project simultaneously. You are both the engineer and the project manager. You will consume the Service Catalog built by the Cloud Infrastructure \& Agentic Architect and the networking foundation laid by the GCP \& Network Agentic Architect — and turn them into modernised, cloud\-native applications that are more reliable, more scalable, fully observable, and cheaper to run.
  
  

**Time allocation (approximate):**  

\~50% hands\-on application refactoring \& migration \| \~25% project management, planning \& stakeholder coordination \| \~15% collaboration with DevOps, SecOps, Compliance \& SRE \| \~10% observability, testing \& validation
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Application Refactoring \& Modernisation
  
  

Own the end\-to\-end refactoring of your assigned applications — from assessment and design through implementation and validation
  
Apply 12\-factor app principles, event\-driven architecture patterns, and cloud\-native design to legacy codebases
  
Migrate workloads from on\-prem and legacy infrastructure to GCP\-native services: Cloud Run, GKE, serverless functions, managed databases, Pub/Sub
  
Design for scalability and on\-demand resource consumption — cost efficiency is a success metric, not an afterthought
  
Use LLM\-assisted tooling (Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent) to accelerate refactoring, code modernisation, and IaC generation
  
  

Project Management \& Delivery
  
  

**Own the migration plan for your applications:** timeline, milestones, dependencies, risks, and rollback strategy
  
Track and report progress with precision \- this is a time\-boxed programme (6–8 months); delays must be surfaced early
  
**Split application ownership with your paired architect:** clear DRI per application, shared standards
  
  

Resilience \& Rollback
  
  

Define and test rollback plans for every application before migration begins \- you have crisis experience and you use it
  
Handle incidents during migration with calm, methodical rollback and root cause analysis
  
Ensure every migrated application meets reliability and observability standards before handover
  
  

Collaboration
  
  

Work closely with DevOps to integrate migrated applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows
  
Collaborate with SecOps and Compliance to ensure every migrated application meets security controls and certification requirements
  
Engage SRE teams to validate observability, SLO definitions, and alerting coverage post\-migration
  
Consume and provide feedback on the Service Catalog — you are one of its primary consumers
  
What you need to fulfill the role
  
  

Required Skills \& Qualifications
  
  

You have migrated complex, production applications from on\-prem to cloud at scale, under time pressure, and lived to tell the story. Specifically:
  
  

Proven on\-prem to cloud migration experience — at scale, under tight time constraints; you have delivered migrations, not just designed them
  
Strong proficiency across both Azure and Google Cloud Platform — networking, infrastructure, and PaaS layers
  
Deep hands\-on experience with Docker, VMs, GKE and AKS node management, and serverless design patterns (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
  
Strong 12\-factor app knowledge — you apply it in code, not just reference it in presentations
  
Strong event\-driven architecture experience — Pub/Sub, event streaming, async decoupling patterns
  
Crisis and rollback experience — you have handled production incidents during migrations, executed rollbacks cleanly, and conducted honest post\-mortems
  
Proven focus on scalability and on\-demand resource design — your migrations reduce cost, not just shift it
  
**Proven hands\-on agentic experience:** must have used Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent LLM\-based coding agents in real engineering workflows
  
Comfortable operating in ambiguity — 10 applications, varying legacy states, evolving requirements; you create clarity
  
  

Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Skills)
  
  

Strong cloud networking experience (VPCs, firewall rules, private connectivity)
  
FinOps awareness — cost attribution and rightsizing post\-migration
  
Experience with SecNumCloud or C5 compliance in a migration context
  
Prior experience as both engineer and delivery lead on the same programme
  
  

Soft Skills
  
  

Extreme ownership — you own the outcome for your applications, not just the tasks
  
**Strong project management discipline:** you track details, surface blockers early, and never let a deadline slip silently
  
Collaborative by default — you pair well with your counterpart architect and with DevOps, SecOps, SRE, and Compliance
  
**Crisis\-calm:** you have been in production incidents during migrations and know how to lead through them
  
Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and bring relevant innovations into the refactoring programme
  
**Fact\-driven communicator:** you report progress with data, not narrative
  
  

What success looks like
  
  

**Month 2:** Application portfolio assessed; ownership split agreed with paired architect; migration plan per application documented with milestones, dependencies, and rollback strategy
  
**Month 4:** First 4 applications refactored and in production (2 major \+ 2 add\-on) — observable, scalable, cost\-attributed
  
**Month 6:** 7–8 applications fully migrated; third major application on confirmed migration path or complete; observability standard adopted across migrated apps
  
**Month 8:** All 10 applications refactored and live on GCP; full observability in place; reliability and scalability improvements measured and reported; FinOps baseline established per application
  
  

**Success is defined as:** more reliability, more scalability, full observability, lower cost — across all 10 applications.
  
  

You're probably NOT a fit if
  
  

You have designed cloud migrations but have not personally executed them in production
  
You need a stable architecture foundation before you start — legacy migration means working with what exists
  
You are a specialist in one cloud (Azure or GCP) but not both
  
You treat project management as someone else's job
  
You have not handled a production rollback under pressure
  
What we offer
  
Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
  
Hybrid\-first working
  
Continuous learning \& certification budget
  
Open, inclusive, and high\-ownership culture
  
Learning programmes \| Career growth \| Leadership access
  
At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership — not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.
  
  

Hybrid working \| Work from abroad \| Flexible working hours \| Thinkproject Academy \| Free English lessons \| Unlimited learning \| Headspace community access \| Women's Network \| Corporate volunteering \| Social events
  
  

We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business.
  
  

**Your contact:**

77d71a7f.title: Tech Lead – Automation Solutions (Power Platform, K2) - Husky (Guindy, Chennai)
77d71a7f.description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.



Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD
* Technical direction for the product area
* Contribute to coordinating cross\-team dependencies and integration points


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Contribute to the feature definition and review
* Generate concepts and facilitate the concept selection
* Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks
* Helping with estimation and sprint planning
* Addressing technical impediments
* Own production readiness (incl. non\-functional requirements)


**Quality, Governance \& Security**


* Ensuring quality
* Conducting meaningful reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e.g. DevSecOps)


**Incident Response**


* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems


**Mentorship \& Team Growth**


* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**


* K2 Five / K2 BlackPearl – Workflows, Smart Objects, Forms and Views, Administration \& Troubleshooting, End\-to\-End testing
* Certifications: PL 600 \- Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement
* Exposure to AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or Power Platform \+ AI scenarios
* Background in enterprise integration


**Why Husky?**


**Regulated Working Hours:** Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work\-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well\-being.


**Visible Impact:** Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.


**Strategic Influence:** Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.


**Empowered Involvement:** Take an active role in decision\-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.


**Valued Contributions:** Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.


**Impactful Role:** Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.


**Cutting\-Edge Projects:** Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer’s business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.


**Supportive Community:** Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.


**Collaborative Environment:** Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

 Solution Architect
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job title:** 
 IT Solution Architect
   

  

**Job Grade:** 
 60
   

  

**You Are Responsible For**
* Defining and governing solution and data platform architecture aligned with enterprise architecture principles, business strategy, and technology standards.
* Translating business, product, and data requirements into scalable end\-to\-end solution designs and target architectures.

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re\-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
   

  

 As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well\-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
   

  

 On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
   

  

 AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
   

  

 Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
   

  

 Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:

* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.

* Provide support for integration and onboarding activities to ensure smooth client transition

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Strong networking fundamentals
* Strong diagnostic skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Qualifications**
**Critical Requirements:**
* CCSA (Check Point Certified Security Associate)

**Additional Information**
 Check Point Software Technologies is a global leader in cyber security solutions, dedicated to protecting corporate enterprises and governments worldwide. b807a7a7.title: Client Engagement Manager
b807a7a7.description:
Join our dynamic Customer Engagement team as a Manager \- Client Engagement, where you'll drive measurable business outcomes, accelerate client adoption of GRAVTY®, and strengthen strategic relationships across our Global Key Accounts.!
 



  





 Loyalty Juggernaut (LJI) is a leading B2B SaaS company redefining how enterprises drive customer engagement and loyalty. Our flagship platform, GRAVTY®, enables global brands to transform loyalty programs into measurable, revenue\-generating growth engines.
 



 Built as an AI\-first, next\-generation solution, GRAVTY® empowers organizations to deliver highly personalized, real\-time experiences at scale—helping them increase customer lifetime value and deepen brand relationships.
 



 Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, LJI partners with leading enterprises across 16 major industries including airlines, retail, hospitality, financial services and telecommunications powering some of the most innovative loyalty ecosystems worldwide.
 



  





**Our Global Impact:** 



* 400\+ Million members connected through our platform.
* 100\+ Global Brands trust us to drive loyalty and brand devotion.
* 3\-Time Winner of “Best Technology Innovation in Loyalty”.
* Global recognitions for Excellence in Loyalty Management under numerous categories.
* Recognized as a ‘Strong performer’ in The Forrester Wave™ Loyalty Platforms, Q4 2025\.



  





 Explore more about us at www.lji.io.
 



  





**The OPPORTUNITY** 




 As the Manager – Client Engagement, you will take end\-to\-end ownership of account strategy, client engagement, relationship continuity, value realization, governance, account health, renewals, and expansion for a portfolio of enterprise customers. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will build long\-term strategic relationships while ensuring customers achieve measurable business outcomes from the GRAVTY® platform.
 



  





 In this role, you will play a pivotal role in driving Net Revenue Retention (NRR), accelerating AI adoption, and maximizing Client Lifetime Value (CLTV). You will ensure that enterprise customers realize the full value of GRAVTY®, proactively identify opportunities for growth and innovation, and partner closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences and sustained business success.
 



  





**What will you DO:** 




  





**Client Leadership \& Strategic Ownership** 



* Own and manage engagement for Global strategic and Key accounts, ensuring program success and maximizing GRAVTY® adoption
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, aligning their business objectives with GRAVTY®’s capabilities.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans, ensuring alignment with LJI’s Client Engagement OKRs
* Drive governance, executive alignment, and client advocacy, ensuring long\-term partnerships



  





**Governance \& Execution Excellence** 



* Oversee governance models to ensure all client requests, program roadmaps, and deliverables remain on track.
* Work cross\-functionally with Client Delivery, Product, and Sales/Presales to ensure seamless execution.
* Monitor client engagement outcomes across the portfolio i.e. product adoption, retention (GRR/NRR), expansion ARR, CSAT, and customer advocacy.
* Drive engagement discipline through account hygiene, account health trends, renewal risk signals, expansion pipeline coverage, QBR and executive connect cadence etc.



  





**Account Ownership and Orchestration** 



* Act as the voice of the client inside Loyalty Juggernaut
* Translate client priorities into internal actions and ensure executive discussions become tracked execution
* Support adoption readiness, success validation, feedback capture, and transition to steady\-state
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, communication, risk visibility, and the value narrative
* Own Partnership plan, Recurrence cadence, Health Baseline, QBRs, Executive connects, Adoption analysis, Renewal readiness, Expansion signals, and Account strategy



  





**Innovation \& Transformation** 



* Drive AI and product expansion, positioning GRAVTY® as an essential platform for client success.
* Identify and address gaps in client engagement strategies, ensuring a proactive approach to risk and opportunity.
* Influence the product roadmap based on client insights and market trends.



  





**You will be a GREAT FIT if you have:** 




**Experience \& Expertise** 



* 5\+ years in Client Engagement, Account Management, or Client Services, ideally within CRM, loyalty, SaaS AI or technology\-driven industries
* A strong track record of managing enterprise accounts, driving growth, and achieving measurable success.








**Strategic \& Commercial Acumen** 



* Proven ability to align client needs with commercial objectives, driving NRR, CLTV growth, and AI adoption.
* Experience managing C\-level and senior stakeholders, with strong influencing skills.








**Operational \& Governance Mastery** 



* Experience or familiarity with project management methodologies such as Agile, SAFe, and SCRUM.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, ensuring focus on strategic objectives.








**Communication \& Relationship Building** 



* A confident and articulate communicator who can build trust and credibility with both mid\-level and senior stakeholders within client organizations.
* Strong ability to manage complex client relationships, ensuring alignment between LJI’s solutions and client business objectives.
* Adept at navigating cross\-functional discussions, collaborating with internal teams such as Client Delivery, Product, and Engineering to ensure seamless execution.
* Proactive in identifying potential risks or concerns, ensuring that issues are addressed before they escalate.
* Skilled at delivering clear, structured client communications, whether through formal presentations, business reviews, or day\-to\-day account management.








**Self\-Starter \& Problem Solver** 



* A highly motivated, independent thinker who takes initiative and ownership of client engagements without needing constant direction.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, high\-growth SaaS environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining strategic focus.
* Ability to assess challenges critically, offering practical, data\-driven solutions that drive results for both the client and LJI.
* Proactively seeks out efficiencies and process improvements, ensuring that account management remains structured and effective.
* Resilient in managing client demands, internal challenges, and operational hurdles, ensuring that momentum is sustained across all client interactions.



  





**Why should you consider US?** 



* Work with top\-tier global brands, shaping their loyalty strategies and driving industry innovation.
* Lead high\-impact client engagements in a fast\-scaling, empowered work environment.
* Collaborate with world\-class teams on cutting\-edge AI and loyalty solutions.
* Make a real impact—this is not just account management; this is strategic leadership.

19616465.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack, Cloud
19616465.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 2 years of experience with full stack development, across back\-end such as Java, Python and front\-end experience including Angular, JavaScript or TypeScript or equivalent.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
* Experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise products, building agentic workflows, orchestrating tools, or leveraging semantic frameworks like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience building scalable data pipelines (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow) and working with semantic data layers.
* Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM), role\-based access control (RBAC), and resolving system vulnerabilities.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



Google Cloud accelerates global digital transformation by delivering enterprise\-grade solutions that help organizations grow and solve their most critical business problems at Google scale. As Google Cloud marches toward becoming a $100B\+ business, our primary objective at the Google Cloud Business Platform (GCBP)—the product and engineering organization that builds the platforms driving Cloud Marketing, Sales, Partners, Support, and Finance—is to enable this massive scale. Because over 70% of enterprise purchasing decisions are influenced or delivered by partners, the Partner Engineering organization is a key contributor to this growth, managing the entire partner journey. This organization ensures partners can securely onboard, map complex corporate hierarchies, and govern sensitive data access, while also building the public discovery and search engines that connect Google's customers with certified partners.  

  

Within this lifecycle, the Partner Program and Platform Team owns the central portals, automated evaluation engines, and performance metrics that drive partner growth. On the external side, we build the unified portal that serves as the single digital front door for all Google Cloud partner interactions. Through this portal, our platforms programmatically evaluate and deliver the tiering levels and technical credentials that serve as our partners' commercial livelihood—credentials that directly dictate their profit margins, financial rebates, market credibility, and eligibility for Google\-led sales leads. We also track their technical solutions and customer deployment plans, serving transparent performance scorecards that allow resellers, service providers, and software builders, as well as internal partner development managers, to easily monitor their business health. On the internal side, we unify disparate data sources to provide a single, consistent version of truth, powering the management dashboards and strategy tools used by Google's own sales and operations leaders. By transforming complex business telemetry into clean, searchable concepts and deploying conversational AI assistants for both external partners and internal Googlers, we empower both audiences to query data safely and make better, faster decisions to accelerate global growth.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us.
 



  





 Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, and slice business are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.
 



  





 We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.
 



  





  





**About the role** 




  





 If you’re a TPM who builds systems, drives decisions at senior levels, and wants real ownership over
 



 something that actually matters in a fast\-scaling regulated fintech \- this role was written for you.
 



  





**You will own two things at once:** 



* Modernize how GRC operates at slice \- replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual workflows with scalable, platform\-grade systems. Drive tooling selection, automation, and integrations across GRC.
* Run our most critical governance programs \- own the operating cadence for ITSC, FMC, board reviews, regulatory submissions, policy lifecycle, and executive reporting.



  





  





**What You will do** 




  





**GRC Platform Modernization** 



* Design the target\-state for how GRC operates at slice \- what gets automated, platformed, and why
* Drive evaluation and onboarding of GRC tooling (policy lifecycle, risk registers, evidence management, audit workflows)
* Build integrations between GRC platforms and engineering systems (Jira, Confluence, SIEM, cloud security) \- single source of truth
* Replace spreadsheets and email threads with automated, auditable, scalable workflows
* Define data models for risk, controls, and policy linkage \- powering real\-time CISO, VPs and board dashboards
* Automate evidence collection, policy review reminders, action tracking, and SLA enforcement



  





**Governance Forums \& Operating Cadence** 



* Own the full cadence for ITSC, FMC, CAB, and board\-level reviews \- agenda, pre\-reads, decision logging, action closure
* Drive decision velocity: surface the right risks, trade\-offs, and dependencies to the right leaders at the right time
* Own program rigor (RAG, RAID, escalation paths) as a system \- not a spreadsheet



  





**Regulatory \& Risk Program Execution** 



* Translate regulatory expectations (RBI, ISO 27001, SOC) into execution plans with clear owners, milestones, and evidence maps
* Build evidence\-readiness infrastructure so the team is never caught off\-guard in an audit
* Coordinate across Tech, InfoSec, Risk, Legal, and Finance to deliver cross\-functional programs at speed



  





**Policy \& Control Lifecycle as a Product** 



* Run the annual policy review workflow like a product: intake, versioning, reviews, approvals, publication \- automated where possible
* Map policies to risk taxonomies and regulatory control frameworks
* Build dashboards showing coverage gaps, aging reviews, and control effectiveness trends



  





  





**What You will need** 




  





**Must Have:** 



* 5\-10 years of Technical Program Management \- owning complex, cross\-functional programs end\-to\- end
* Experience in or adjacent to security, risk, compliance, IT audit, or regulated tech environments
* Track record of process modernization: you’ve identified broken workflows and rebuilt them as scalable systems
* Proven ability to drive decisions across senior engineering and business stakeholders
* Executive communication: crisp decks, clear narratives, complexity translated into decisions
* High ownership mindset \- proactive, follows through, pushes programs to closure



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Hands\-on experience evaluating or implementing GRC tools (ServiceNow GRC, MetricStream, Archer, or similar)
* Experience in fintech, banking, or deeply regulated tech environments
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, or RBI framework alignment
* Experience building dashboards or automation workflows (Power BI, Looker, Python, Jira
* automation)



  





  





**Why this role stands out** 




  




* Most GRC roles hand you a spreadsheet and a compliance calendar. This one hands you a greenfield build problem.
* Real Ownership \- you own programs end\-to\-end, not coordinate tasks for someone else’s agenda
* Greenfield Opportunity \- GRC modernization at slice is being built from scratch; you define the architecture
* Executive Visibility \- work directly with the CTO, CISO, and CRO; present to board\-level forums
* Rare Domain Combination \- tech TPM skills \+ regulatory fluency \+ executive storytelling in one role
* Visible Impact \- when you build it right, every audit, board review, and regulatory submission runs better



  





  





**Life at slice** 




  





 Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding:
 



  




* Competitive salaries. Period.
* An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees \& their dependents. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise.
* Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule.
* Tailored vacation \& leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life.
* A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here.
* Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding.
* Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”.

**Role Overview**
 The Senior Technical Program Manager will own the planning, coordination, and executionof the strategic programs for Quickbase’s Corporate delivery pod. This is where the systems, data, and AI capabilities that underpin the rest of the business get built: the back\-office platforms and process modernization that IT, Security, HR, and Systems Architecture run on. This role requires a strong operator who can manage technical complexity while also driving alignment across distributed global teams.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who proactively identifies risks before they become issues, creates clarity in ambiguous environments, and keeps teams aligned and moving without creating unnecessary process overhead. The right candidate will be highly organized, technically fluent, execution\-focused, and capable of influencing senior leaders without formal authority.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead highly visible, cross\-functional technical programs from initiation through delivery
* Drive execution across the Corporate pod's core stakeholders — IT, Security, HR, Legal, and Systems Architecture — translating their operational needs into structured, deliverable programs
* Program manage back\-office AI pilots and rollouts end to end from scoped pilot through workforce adoption Ensure Jira hygiene and Plan visibility, roadmap alignment, and execution transparency across programs

* Establish operational rigor across complex initiatives while keeping teams focused on outcomes rather than bureaucracy

* Facilitate executive\-level program reviews and provide concise, data\-driven status reporting
* Drive accountability across multiple organizations and time zones
* Improve program management standards, processes, templates, and operating rhythms across the organization
* Manage stakeholder communication across both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Help teams make decisions quickly by creating clarity, surfacing tradeoffs, and removing blockers

**Required Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or related leadership roles
* Proven experience leading large\-scale cross\-functional technical initiatives in SaaS or enterprise software environments
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile delivery models, and engineering operations
* Experience working closely with Experience corporate functions — IT, Security, HR, Legal — and with data and technical teams.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority
* Experience managing programs involving multiple concurrent workstreams and distributed teams
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and follow\-through
* Advanced experience with Jira, Confluence, and program reporting tools
* Ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights and clear executive updates

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Characteristics of Success**

* Anticipate risks before others see them

 At Quickbase, we view AI as a tool to accelerate how work gets done — not replace it. We encourage thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, and decision\-making, while maintaining strong judgment, accountability, and data integrity.
