45ea1d5e.title: Senior Program Manager
45ea1d5e.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.
   

  

 If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Program Manager** 
 to be part of making this happen.
   

  

**Position Overview And Objective**
 The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead programs to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a subsystem and component of a product or service offering. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including ideation/concept, modifications, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line.
   

  

 The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead strategic programs and initiatives within our cybersecurity software and services organization. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex programs that align with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will drive cross\-functional collaboration, ensure program alignment with company strategy, and manage risks and dependencies to deliver high\-quality security solutions on time and within budget.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Strategic Influence \& Thought Leadership – Guides executive decision\-making on product strategy, technology investments, and long\-term roadmap planning.
* Enterprise\-Wide Program Management – Oversees multiple complex initiatives spanning business units, ensuring strategic objectives are met across products and teams.
* Technical Due Diligence – Leads deep dives into system architecture, performance, and scalability to assess risk and feasibility for high\-impact initiatives.
* Executive \& Stakeholder Alignment – Communicates trade\-offs, investment rationales, and progress updates to C\-suite and board\-level stakeholders.
* Mentorship \& Organization Impact – Develops best practices, frameworks, and coaching initiatives to elevate program management capabilities across the company.
* Lead and manage large\-scale cybersecurity programs from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
* Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination across engineering, product management, marketing, legal, sales and customer success teams.
* Oversee program governance, risk management, and compliance with industry security standards and regulations.
* Define and implement best practices for program execution, tracking, and reporting, ensuring visibility and accountability.
* Serves as the primary point of contact for program stakeholders, facilitating communication and alignment across business units.
* Manage budgets, resource allocation, and vendor relationships to optimize program efficiency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program execution, team collaboration, and customer satisfaction.
* Serves as the central resource with design, process, manufacturing, test, quality, and marketing as the product(s) move to production and distribution.
* Designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life.
* Coordinate activities of supporting project teams and internal and external development partners.
* Track progress against established plan and makes decisions to alter or update schedule and resource allocation to meet product requirements and development schedule.
* Mentor direct and interdisciplinary team members.
* Champion AI \& Automation in Program Management – Identify and implement AI\-driven tools and automation workflows to streamline program planning, status reporting, risk tracking, and cross\-functional coordination, reducing manual overhead and improving program execution speed.
* Drive data\-driven insights by leveraging AI\-powered analytics and dashboards to proactively surface program health metrics, predict delivery risks, and support executive\-level decision\-making with real\-time program intelligence.


**Experience \& Requirements**
* 12\+ years’ experience in a technical or product role managing large\-scale software deployments
* 12\+ years of experience in program / project/ product management, with at least 8 years in software development
* Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business, or related field
* Understanding of project and program management skills and methodologies
* Expertise in program management methodologies (Agile, SAFe, etc.) and tools (JIRA, Confluence, Aha!, etc.).
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, ensuring effective communication between technical and non\-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and change management skills to drive execution and adoption of cybersecurity initiatives.
* Experience communicating and representing work to leadership, framing discussions to gain valuable feedback, and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products.
* Analytical and problem\-solving experience with large\-scale systems
* Proficient in building trust and establishing relationships across multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Aptitude towards establishing and leading teams through multi\-disciplinary relationships including product management and engineering to drive product programs.


**Nice to Have**
* PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification.
* Experience in cybersecurity is a plus.
* Prefer degree in a technical area.
* Experience applying AI tools and automation platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to enhance program management workflows such as meeting summarization, dependency tracking, and automated reporting.
* Demonstrated interest or experience in evaluating and piloting AI/ML\-driven solutions within a program or product management context to improve operational efficiency and team productivity.


**On\-Camera Policy**
 To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

**About Arctic Wolf**
 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
   

  

 We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.
   

  

 We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
   

  

 All
 **India** 
 wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:
   

  

* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* Fertility support and paid parental leave
* Employee Assistance Program


 Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.
   

  

**Security Requirements**
* Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
* Background checks are required for this position.
* This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

* Proven experience as a Database Architect or DBA, with expertise in PostgreSQL.

**Job Title: Java Architect – Integration Engineering**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Team:** 
 Integration Engineering

 Anchanto is a global SaaS technology company powering eCommerce automation and logistics solutions for enterprises and 3PLs. Our Integration Engineering team builds scalable, robust, and high\-performance integrations connecting our products with marketplaces, ERPs, WMS, OMS, and other enterprise systems worldwide.
   

  

 We are looking for a seasoned
 **Java Architect** 
 to lead the design and delivery of our integration framework, guide engineering best practices, and shape the technical vision for integrations that serve businesses across the globe. You will also play a pivotal role in
 **driving AI adoption in our development processes** 
 , leveraging emerging tools and techniques to enhance productivity and code quality.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a
 **Java Architect – Integration Engineering** 
 , you will:
   

  

* Define and enforce integration architecture standards, design patterns, and development best practices for the team.
* Lead the end\-to\-end design and development of integrations with diverse internal and external systems using Spring Boot and modern Java frameworks.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their integration requirements, processes, and business objectives.
* Collaborate with solution team to define, document, and finalize integration design, architecture, and data mapping.
* Champion AI\-driven development practices, integrating tools like Cursor AI and other AI\-assisted coding solutions into the team’s workflow.
* Partner with Product Management, Pre\-Sales, and Implementation teams to translate business needs into scalable technical designs.

* Be hands\-on in building Proof\-of\-Concepts (POCs), solving complex integration challenges, and driving mission\-critical deliveries.
* Collaborate with leadership to shape the roadmap for integration products and platform capabilities.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and oversee the implementation of integration solutions leveraging Spring Boot, REST APIs, messaging, and event\-driven architectures.
* Establish integration design patterns (e.g., EAI, ESB, SOA, pub/sub, ETL) to ensure reusability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers to gather integration requirements and define clear solution blueprints.
* Coordinate with internal solution architects, product managers, and customer success teams to ensure integration feasibility and alignment with business goals.
* Introduce, evaluate, and integrate AI\-powered development tools into the engineering process to improve efficiency, testing, and documentation.
* Promote a culture of AI\-first problem solving in architecture design, code reviews, and automation.
* Set up frameworks and automation to accelerate onboarding of new integrations.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and cloud services (primarily AWS) to optimize integration performance.
* Review solution designs and code to ensure adherence to architectural principles and coding standards.
* Support pre\-sales with architecture diagrams, integration approaches, and technical feasibility assessments.
* Lead technical discussions with external partners, vendors, and enterprise customers.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 15\+ years of software development experience, with at least 3\+ years as an Architect.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Java (Java 8\+), Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
* Solid understanding of integration patterns, enterprise architecture concepts, and middleware solutions.
* Experience with REST APIs, messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and data transformation (JSON, XML, CSV).
* Knowledge of AWS cloud services relevant to integration (API Gateway, Lambda, SQS/SNS, ECS, RDS, etc.).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, branching/merging strategies, and code quality tools.
* Proficiency in Linux environments and shell scripting.
* Experience with building connectors/adapters for ERP, WMS, OMS, CRM, or eCommerce platforms is a plus.
* Exposure to products like TIBCO, Informatica, SnapLogic, WebMethods, or MuleSoft is advantageous.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, ability to think “out\-of\-the\-box”, and adapt to fast\-changing priorities.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence across teams.


**Bonus / Good to Have**
* Experience in AI\-assisted development, particularly using tools like Cursor AI, GitHub Copilot, Tabnine, or similar.
* Knowledge of prompt engineering and integrating AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into developer tooling or backend services.
* Understanding of ML Ops principles and how AI models can be integrated into enterprise applications.
* Track record of evangelizing AI adoption in engineering teams to improve productivity and innovation.


**Why Join Anchanto?**
* Build integrations for a global SaaS platform serving leading retailers, brands, and logistics companies.
* Lead impactful projects with cutting\-edge Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and AI\-assisted development tools.
* Collaborate with a high\-energy, globally distributed product and engineering team.
* Opportunity to innovate and define the future of Anchanto’s integration platform.


 Engage directly with enterprise customers to
 **design real\-world solutions** 
 that power global eCommerce.

Job Purpose and Impact
   

  

* The Cloud Security Engineer will contribute to strengthening the security foundation for Cargill’s modern cloud\-based applications and platforms. In this role, you will apply cybersecurity and cloud security engineering expertise to secure, operate, and scale Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS) environments across AWS and Azure.


 You will contribute to security design, adopt automation\-first approaches, and help ensure security is embedded by design into cloud platforms and engineering workflows. You will also leverage AI\-assisted engineering practices to improve cloud security operations, engineering productivity, and delivery efficiency.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Design, implement, and maintain the security and resiliency of enterprise\-grade cloud services in support of Cargill’s mission.
* Implement and operate cloud security solutions across AWS and Azure.
* Develop and automate security policies, controls, and workflows using Infrastructure as Code, scripting, cloud\-native security services, and AI\-assisted engineering capabilities.
* Partner with Enterprise IT, Cloud platforms, DevSecOps, Software Engineering, and Compliance teams to embed security into cloud architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and migration workflows.
* Support cloud security incident investigations, remediation activities, and continuous security improvements.
* Contribute to cloud security engineering standards, reusable automation, documentation, and operational best practices.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve cloud security engineering and operations through automation and AI\-driven capabilities.


**Required Qualifications**
* 
+ Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.
+ 4–8 years of experience in cloud engineering and cloud security roles.
+ Strong hands\-on experience securing AWS and/or Azure cloud environments.
+ Experience with cloud security services and platforms, including Cloud IAM, Wiz, or equivalent CSPM tools.
+ Strong understanding of AWS networking and security constructs, including security groups, network firewalls, and segmentation.
+ Experience designing and securing container platforms (Kubernetes, EKS, ECS, Docker, etc.).
+ Strong skills in Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform and scripting languages such as Python, Golang, or PowerShell.
+ Good understanding of DevOps and CI/CD practices, application resiliency, and security\-by\-design principles.
+ Ability to analyze cloud security data, metrics, and logs to drive risk reduction and operational improvements.
+ Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams and contribute to technical solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cloud certifications in AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud (Associate, Professional, or Specialty).
* Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GSEC, CEH, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting cloud migrations or enterprise cloud platforms.
* Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, Cursor, etc.) to improve engineering productivity, automation, and software development.
* Good understanding of AI security concepts, including AI governance, AI workload security, prompt injection, data protection, and secure AI adoption in enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute technical solutions and collaborate across teams without direct authority.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Cloud security controls are consistent, automated, and scalable across environments.
* Security risks are addressed early through design, automation, and AI\-assisted engineering practices rather than reactive fixes.
* Cloud security platforms (e.g., Wiz) provide clear, prioritized, and actionable insights.
* Engineering teams move faster with confidence due to strong security foundations and reusable automation.
* AI capabilities are effectively leveraged to improve cloud security engineering, operational efficiency, and security outcomes.

9d988901.title: Senior Google Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
9d988901.description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
 Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward\-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
   

  

 At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior GCP Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to design, implement, and operate enterprise\-grade infrastructure on Google Cloud. The role combines hands\-on engineering with solution ownership — building automation, enforcing governance and security standards, mentoring junior engineers, and contributing to landing zone and platform design with limited supervision.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, deploy, and manage GCP infrastructure at scale — Compute Engine / Managed Instance Groups, persistent disks/File store, Cloud Storage, VPCs, and Cloud Load Balancing — across multiple projects.
* Own Infrastructure\-as\-Code delivery using Terraform (preferred) or Deployment Manager/Config Connector, including reusable modules and CI/CD integration.
* Contribute to landing zone, project vending, and governance design using the GCP resource hierarchy, Organization Policies, and the Cloud Architecture Framework.
* Implement and manage IAM roles/policies, service accounts, Cloud Identity, Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, and VPC Service Controls.
* Design and operate networking — Shared VPC, VPC peering, Cloud VPN/Interconnect, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, and Private Service Connect — within platform service limits.
* Build and maintain monitoring, logging, and observability using the Cloud Operations suite; drive reliability improvements.
* Lead operational activities — patching strategy, backup/DR, capacity planning, cost optimization (FinOps), and resource governance.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, connectivity, and security issues; perform root\-cause analysis.
* Manage GCP quotas and limits, raising increase requests and designing scalable, limit\-aware architectures.
* Mentor junior engineers, review IaaC and designs, and contribute to standards and runbooks.
* Collaborate with architecture, security, networking, and application teams on solution delivery.


**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* 4–6 years of hands\-on GCP infrastructure experience with independent solution delivery.
* Strong command of GCP core services — Compute, Storage, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud KMS, and key managed services.
* Proven Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience (Terraform preferred) with module design and CI/CD integration.
* Solid scripting skills (Python, gcloud CLI; Bash a plus).
* Strong networking knowledge — TCP/IP, DNS, routing, BGP basics, hybrid connectivity (Cloud VPN/Interconnect), and segmentation.
* Working knowledge of GCP governance — resource hierarchy, Organization Policies, Cloud Asset Inventory, labels, and security baselines.
* Understanding of GCP quotas/limits and capacity/cost planning.
* Experience with monitoring, DR/backup, and operational best practices.


**These will help you succeed**
* Exposure to landing zone implementation, multi\-project governance, or security foundations blueprint.
* Familiarity with containers (GKE), and secondary exposure to Azure or AWS.
* Awareness of egress control / SASE tooling (e.g., Zscaler) and zero\-trust networking.
* Certifications: Google Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud Network Engineer, or Associate Cloud Engineer.


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2\-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Bangalore/Coimbatore. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
   

  

 We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

40e1ab50.description:
Job Title: Solution Architect Specialist 2
   

  

 Req ID: 58682
   

  

 Job Function: Software Engineering
   

  

 Posting Start Date: 29/07/2026
   

  

 Posting End Date: 05/08/2026
   

  

 Division: Digital
   

  

 Job Location: IND\-Bengaluru\-RMZ Ecoworld
   

  

 Advertised Salary: Competitive
   

  

**Recruiter: Disha Gupta**
**Hiring Manager: Sajal Goyal**
**Career Grade: D**
**Internal Closing Date: 10\-June\-2026**
**About The Role**
* We are seeking a highly experienced Solution Design Specialist to lead the design of Contract Lifecycle Management (Sirion) and broader procurement technology landscape, with a strong emphasis on SaaS application onboarding, fitment into procurement workstreams, and seamless integration with the SAP ecosystem.
* The role will define a cohesive, scalable, and optimized procurement architecture, ensuring that multiple SaaS tools are effectively aligned to Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes, while maintaining SAP as the transactional backbone and Sirion as the contract system of record.


**What You’ll Be Doing**
* 1\. End\-to\-End Solution Architecture Design integrated CLM and procurement solutions with Sirion as the central CLM platform. Define architecture aligned with:
* SAP S/4HANA (core procurement transactions)
* SAP Ariba (sourcing and supplier collaboration) Establish a target\-state procurement architecture incorporating multiple SaaS applications.
* 2\. Sirion CLM Solution Leadership Own the design and implementation of Sirion CLM, including:
* Contract templates and clause libraries
* Workflow orchestration and approvals
* Obligation and compliance tracking


 Ensure strong linkage between
 **contracts (Sirion)** 
 and
 **execution (SAP systems)** 
 .
   

  

* 3\. SaaS Application Onboarding \& Fitment (Core Capability) Lead evaluation, onboarding, and integration of procurement SaaS applications across:
* Strategic sourcing (RFx), SLM, CLM, spend analytics, P2P


 Conduct fitment analysis by:
   

  

* Mapping tools to processes
* Identifying gaps, overlaps, and dependencies


 Ensure each application has a
 **clearly defined role in the ecosystem.**
* 4\. Procurement Workstream Mapping Align SaaS platforms to procurement streams:
* S2C → Ariba, sourcing tools, Sirion
* CLM → Sirion (system of record)
* P2P → SAP S/4HANA
* SLM → Ariba / external tools


 Ensure
 **seamless data flow and process continuity** 
 with
 **standardized workflows** 
 .
   

  

* 5\. SAP Ecosystem Integration (Critical Requirement) Design integration with:
* SAP S/4HANA → POs, invoices, payments
* SAP Ariba → sourcing, onboarding
* SAP MDG → vendor master governance


 Define integration via APIs, OData, IDocs, middleware (
 **SAP CPI, MuleSoft, Boomi** 
 ).
   

  

 Enable:
   

  

* Real\-time data exchange across systems
* Single source of truth for contracts, suppliers, and transactions
* 6\. Procurement SaaS Rationalization \& Governance Evaluate tools to identify redundancies and consolidation opportunities. Define a rationalized stack:
* Retain → SAP, Sirion
* Replace/Retire → legacy tools


 Establish governance for onboarding, integration, and lifecycle management.
   

  

* 7\. Data Architecture \& Insights Define a unified procurement data model across: contracts, suppliers, transactions. Align with SAP and Sirion frameworks. Enable reporting on:
* Contract compliance \& obligations
* Spend and supplier analytics
* 8\. Innovation \& Future Readiness Drive adoption of:
* Gen AI for contract intelligence (e.g., summarization, clause extraction)
* Workflow automation


 Continuously evaluate emerging tools for
 **improvement** 
 .
   

  

* 9\. Stakeholder \& Delivery Management Collaborate with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and IT leadership. Translate requirements into solution blueprints and architecture artifacts. Act as design authority across the lifecycle (design → build → deploy).


**Essential Skills / Experience**
* Experience 10–15 years in solution design / enterprise architecture 5\+ years in CLM (Sirion preferred) Strong experience in procurement SaaS ecosystems and SAP integration
* Core Expertise Deep understanding of: Contract lifecycle management, Procurement lifecycle (S2C, P2P, SLM) Proven experience in: SaaS onboarding and fitment into enterprise ecosystems, Multi\-system integration design
* Technical Skills Sirion CLM design and configuration SAP ecosystem: S/4HANA, Ariba, MDG Integration technologies: APIs, OData, IDocs Middleware (SAP CPI, MuleSoft, Boomi) Strong knowledge of: Data modelling, Enterprise architecture principles
* Platforms \& Tools CLM: Sirion (mandatory)
* Procurement SaaS: Ariba, Coupa, niche sourcing tools
* ERP: SAP S/4HANA / ECC
* Integration: SAP CPI / enterprise middleware
* Data Platforms: Snowflake, Azure, GCP (preferred)

520d5b07.title: Solutions Architect- IP
520d5b07.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
   

  

 TTEC Digital seeks a
 **Solutions Architect** 
 to join our team. This role is a full\-time and fully remote opportunity!
   

  

**The work:**
 We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early\-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982\.
   

  

 This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
   

  

**Who We Hire — The DNA**
* Self\-starters and do\-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show\-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI\-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed\-systems literate. High\-efficiency, event\-driven, low\-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.


 No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well\-rounded, smart people who move fast.
   

  

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**
* The technical face to enterprise customers — scoping deployments, designing tenant configurations, and getting customers live fast (same\-day with Desktop Intercept).
* You're selling and deploying a platform that combines voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI — technology that changes monthly — so you learn constantly and demo fearlessly.
* Startup environment: the deal, the deployment, and the product are all moving at once, and you thrive in that.


**What you'll own:**
* Pre\-sales and deployment architecture
* Tenant configuration and plugin enablement design
* Customer integration scoping (CCaaS / CRM / SIP)
* live demos that win — show\-me applies to customers too
* The customer's voice back into Product and Engineering
* Your committed go\-live timelines.


**Who you are:**
* A self\-starter with grit and a closer's instinct — you like winning, and a signed customer going live is your scoreboard.
* Show\-me mentality: you'd rather run the live demo than present the slide
* You adapt fast when the product shifts under you (it will, weekly), love new technology, and use AI tools daily — including in your own demo and scoping workflow.
* A do\-er who owns the messy middle instead of escalating it.
* A team player who translates in both directions: business requirements into technical needs for engineering, platform capability into business value for the customer.


**What You Will Bring;**
* 8\+ years of solutions architecture/sales engineering in contact\-center, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS.
* Technical enough to design an integration on a whiteboard and credible enough to own a CTO conversation — you keep the respect of senior engineers on both sides of the table.
* Knows CCaaS / CTI, SIP / RTP, and CRM landscapes cold.
* Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, transcription/translation — deep enough to answer the customer's AI architecture and data\-security questions without phoning home.
* Has taken enterprise customers live and owned the messy middle — network quirks, security reviews, procurement, the works.
* Hands\-on enough to configure a tenant, read an API payload, and debug a customer integration in real time — a troubleshooter, not a talker: when the pilot breaks at 4pm, you isolate it.
* Understands event\-driven platform architecture well enough to scope custom integrations accurately — what's config, what's a connector, what's a feature request.
* Deployment playbook craft — turns every go\-live into a repeatable playbook so the second customer is faster than the first; this is how one SA scales.
* Enterprise security fluency — comfortable in InfoSec reviews (SOC 2, data residency, PII/redaction, AI data\-usage questions); AI deals die here without it.
* Competitive positioning depth — knows the CCaaS/agent\-assist landscape and can architect around a competitor's incumbency.
* POC discipline — scopes pilots with clear success criteria and exit dates, so pilots convert instead of drifting.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

c6ce2943.title: Solution Architect | Thermal Solutions
c6ce2943.description:
**Who We Are**
 Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
   

  

 For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a Solution Architect for Thermal Solutions you will be identifying challenges, constraints, and goals of data center designers, and developing tailored solutions for customers. Defining innovative, scalable, and repeatable thermal management solutions which can be applied to numerous phases, sites, or geographies where data centers may be constructed.
   

  

**How You Will Do It**
 In this role, you will leverage your expertise to:
   

  

* Developing globally applicable reference designs to produce facility water for use in air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid\-cooled or methods of cooling in data center facilities.
* Industry engagement with complimentary thermal system partners and stakeholders to author white papers, case studies, or application guides of the equipment and/or systems needed for facility water production.
* Engage with the infrastructure design community, such as consulting engineers and in\-house mission critical mechanical teams, through industry conferences, expositions and other engagements to design the next generation of cooling architecture for data centers.
* Provide in\-depth technical support and guidance on thermal management (facility water) products internally and externally to the organization.
* Collaborate internally with R\&D, Training, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to ensure market needs are met in alignment with company product strategies. Ensure the necessary design, technical, and marketing tools to support clients with both existing new, and upcoming products.


 You thrive on building relationships and driving business growth. A natural problem solver, you work independently, manage multiple priorities with precision, and remain proactive in engaging customers and stakeholders.
   

  

**What We Look For**
* Minimum 10 years of experience in designing mechanical cooling systems, such as chillers, chilled water pumping and storage systems, or similar industry.
* Minimum 5 years of experience within data center industry, directly responsible for the design of cooling systems of advanced IT equipment
* Strong technical knowledge of mission critical cooling systems, their applications and market trends.
* Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision\-makers at all levels.
* Proven track record of understanding and writing product specifications from, or for, end users, consultants, and installers.
* Experience in strategic planning, marketing, and market research.
* Highly developed prospecting skills—ability to identify key decision\-makers and stakeholders.
* Proactive, self\-motivated approach—able to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams.
* Strong team\-player mindset—cross\-functional collaboration is essential for success.
* Willingness to travel globally as needed.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary
* Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
* Comprehensive benefits package
* On the job/cross training opportunities
* Encouraging and collaborative team environment
* Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

32fb05e2.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
32fb05e2.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
   

  

 Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
   

  

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. **Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services

d1922389.title: Architect II - Enterprise Solutions - SAP FICA
d1922389.description:
**Role description**  

Job Description: Lead SAP FICA \& AR Data Migration Consultant (ECC to S/4HANA) Location: \[Bangalore/Mumbai preferred] Position Type: \[Contract] Experience Required: 10\+ Years Position Overview We are looking for a senior Lead SAP FICA \& AR Data Migration Consultant with 10\+ years of hands\-on experience to lead the Contract Accounts Receivable (FICA) and Accounts Receivable (FI\-AR) data migration stream for our enterprise SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation project. This role requires a deep functional and technical understanding of FICA sub\-ledger architecture, Customer\-Vendor Integration (CVI), and specialized AR data conversion strategies. You will design, execute, and validate the complete migration lifecycle for FICA master data, customer accounts, and complex open\-item balances from legacy ECC environments into S/4HANA. Key Responsibilities FICA \& AR Data Migration Strategy Migration Strategy \& Design: Formulate and document the end\-to\-end data migration architecture for FICA and FI\-AR in an ECC to S/4HANA project (Greenfield, Brownfield, or Selective Data Transition). Master Data Synchronization (CVI): Lead the mapping and conversion of legacy Customer/Debtor accounts and Contract Accounts into S/4HANA Business Partners (BP), ensuring alignment across FICA and FI\-AR configurations. FICA AR Open Item Migration: Design extraction and loading rules for FICA open items, installment plans, security deposits, and credit balances. Manage legacy clearing histories, dunning histories, and collection agency status transfers. Address cross\-subledger migration dependencies between FI\-AR and FICA where applicable. FICA Configurations: Configure core FI\-CA functionalities for implementation projects —such as Payments, Dunning, and Clearing Control—and provide daily BAU support to troubleshoot production issues and ensure operational stability. Technical Execution \& Tooling Migration Execution: Hands\-on development and execution of data conversion using SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit (LTMC / Migrate Your Data), EMIGALL, SAP BODS, BAPIs, and custom ABAP extraction scripts. Mock Migration Cycles: Lead multiple mock data loads, performance optimization runs, and volume testing for large\-scale financial datasets. Data Cleansing \& Readiness: Coordinate with business stakeholders to perform legacy data scrubbing, archiving of obsolete FICA/AR records, and pre\-migration S/4HANA checks. Reconciliation, Auditability \& Cutover Financial Reconciliation: Design and implement stringent pre\- and post\-migration reconciliation frameworks between legacy ECC FICA/FI\-AR sub\-ledgers, GL accounts, and S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA). Cutover Management: Plan, schedule, and execute delta data migrations and final go\-live cutover activities within tight system downtime windows. Defect Resolution: Rapidly diagnose and resolve complex data transformation, validation, and post\-load posting errors. Required Qualifications \& Technical Expertise Experience: 10\+ years of core functional and technical experience in SAP FICA and SAP FI\-AR. Migration Track Record: Proven leadership in at least 2 full lifecycle SAP ECC to S/4HANA migration projects, specifically managing FICA and AR data conversion streams. FICA \& AR Domain Mastery: Deep understanding of FICA sub\-ledger concepts including posting specifications, clearing rules, dunning, payment runs, write\-offs, GL integration, and FI\-AR customer sub\-ledger mapping. Data Migration Tooling: Advanced expertise in SAP Migration Cockpit, EMIGALL, SAP BODS, LSMW, and standard FICA BAPIs/Function Modules. Strong knowledge of Customer\-Vendor Integration (CVI) for converting classic AR customers to S/4HANA Business Partners. Data Structure \& Database Knowledge: Deep technical familiarity with key FICA tables (e.g., DFKKOP, DFKKKO, FKKVKP, DFKKCOLL) and FI\-AR tables (e.g., KNB1, KNVV, BSID, BSAD). Reconciliation Expertise: Demonstrated track record of executing financial tie\-outs and audit\-compliant reconciliations for high\-volume transactional data. Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills Experience in industry\-specific solutions such as Utilities (IS\-U), BRIM / SOM, Telecommunications, or Insurance (FS\-CD). Hands\-on familiarity with Selective Data Transition (SDT) tools (e.g., SNP CrystalBridge/Glue, Natuvion, or SAP DMLT). Ability to read and debug ABAP code to isolate migration errors and work directly with technical developers.

 **Skills**  

Data Validation, ETL, Financial Reconciliation, LSMW

971d307a.description:
**What makes us Qlik?**
 A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 15 years in a row, Qlik transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights, driving strategic business outcomes. Serving over 40,000 global customers, our portfolio leverages pervasive data quality and advanced AI/ML capabilities that lead to better decisions, faster.
   

  

 We excel in integration and governance solutions that work with diverse data sources, and our real\-time analytics uncover hidden patterns, empowering teams to address complex challenges and seize new opportunities.
   

  

**The Principal Solution Architect Role**
 Are you ready to take the lead in shaping the future of data and analytics? As a Senior Solution Architect, you’ll be the go\-to technical expert, guiding some of the largest customers and partners in the India region. You’ll be at the forefront of demonstrating how cutting\-edge data integration and analytics solutions can drive real business transformation.
   

  

 Collaborating closely with a dynamic Presales team in a flexible, agile environment, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your expertise while working with Sales, Marketing, R\&D, Product, Consulting, and Customer Success teams. If you're looking for a role that is engaging, fast\-paced, and full of opportunities to make an impact, this is it.
   

  

**What makes this role interesting?**
* Engage with high\-profile customers and partners: Lead technical discussions and showcase innovative solutions to help organizations unlock the true power of their data.
* Drive business success with cutting\-edge technology: Leverage Qlik’s next\-generation data analytics and data integration platform to solve complex business challenges.
* Be at the forefront of industry trends: Stay ahead of the game by keeping up with the latest advancements in data analytics, as well as the competitive landscape.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams: Work closely with internal teams and experts across Sales, Marketing, R\&D, and Customer Success to build compelling solutions that resonate with customers.
* Flexibility and agility: Thrive in an environment that values adaptability, innovation, and dynamic thinking.


**Here’s How You’ll Be Making An Impact**
* Own the technical sales cycle: Become a trusted advisor by guiding customers through technical evaluations, ensuring a seamless journey from exploration to adoption.
* Showcase innovation through tailored solutions: Deliver compelling presentations and custom demonstrations that address real customer needs and business challenges.
* Prove value through successful Proof\-of\-Concepts: Help customers experience the true power of Qlik’s platform by leading impactful proof\-of\-concept engagements.
* Support business development efforts: Play a key role in driving regional revenue growth by supporting strategic sales initiatives and expanding Qlik’s presence in the market.
* Position solutions for long\-term success: Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from technical teams to senior leadership, ensuring alignment on the value and impact of Qlik’s solutions.

c80d1a93.description:
**Role description**  

Job Title: Data \& Analytics Architect (Microsoft Fabric, Power BI \& Azure) Experience 10\+ Years Employment Type Full\-Time Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Data \& Analytics Architect to lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise\-scale data and analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Microsoft Azure, with a strong background in modern data architectures, business intelligence, data governance, and cloud transformation initiatives. The Architect will collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, analysts, and leadership teams to define scalable analytics strategies and deliver high\-performing data solutions that drive business value. Mandatory Skills Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Data Engineering, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, Real\-Time Analytics) Power BI (Data Modeling, DAX, Performance Tuning, Governance) Microsoft Azure Data Platform Azure Data Factory (ADF) Azure Synapse Analytics Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2\) Azure SQL Database Data Architecture \& Data Modeling ETL/ELT Design and Implementation SQL and Advanced Query Optimization Data Governance and Security Frameworks Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture Design and implement enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric and Azure services. Define end\-to\-end data architecture, including ingestion, transformation, storage, security, and reporting layers. Develop scalable Lakehouse and Data Warehouse architectures aligned with business goals. Establish architecture standards, best practices, and governance frameworks. Data \& Analytics Design and optimize Power BI semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions. Build robust data models supporting self\-service analytics and enterprise reporting. Ensure data quality, consistency, and accessibility across business domains. Drive analytics modernization initiatives leveraging Microsoft Fabric capabilities. Cloud \& Azure Platform Architect cloud\-native solutions using Azure data services. Lead Azure migration and modernization projects. Implement secure, scalable, and cost\-optimized cloud architectures. Define disaster recovery, backup, and high\-availability strategies. Governance \& Security Establish data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and compliance standards. Implement role\-based access control (RBAC), security policies, and data protection measures. Ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements. Leadership \& Stakeholder Management Work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. Provide architectural guidance to development teams. Conduct architecture reviews and solution assessments. Mentor data engineers, BI developers, and technical teams. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field. 10\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics, or Data Architecture. 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric. 5\+ years of experience with Power BI and Azure Data Platform. Strong expertise in SQL, data modeling, and enterprise data warehousing concepts. Experience designing cloud\-based data solutions on Microsoft Azure. Strong understanding of data integration patterns, governance, and security best practices. Preferred Certifications Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP\-600\) Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP\-203\) Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\) Nice\-to\-Have Skills Databricks Azure AI Services Machine Learning Integration Python / PySpark CI/CD using Azure DevOps Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep) Microsoft Purview Real\-Time Analytics and Streaming Solutions Key Competencies Enterprise Architecture Stakeholder Management Strategic Thinking Problem Solving Team Leadership Communication \& Presentation Skills Agile Delivery Methodologies

 **Skills**  

Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, Azure SQL Database, Databricks

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

 The focus of the Domain Solution Architect role is to Make the Market and drive Digital Transformation and Modernization Solutions with deeper focus on the Technology and Service Offerings that are specific to each of the Microsoft Consulting Services Domains. The Architect also plays a key role in driving the entire lifecycle of large and complex projects, early pre\-sales, delivery oversight and also responsible for architectural and technical success for our customers. They will lead in identifying and creatively solving complex customer problems, envisioning and enabling critical processes, and fundamentally helping the customer to achieve their objectives.

 Drive \& Accelerate production\-level Cloud Solutions in line with Customer and Microsoft strategy.
   

  

 Make the Market with innovative Digital Transformation and Modernization projects.
   

  

 Providing customer guidance during envisioning solution \& benefits, defining workloads \& methodology, project scope and sizing.
   

  

 Drive a positive Customer Experience by providing high quality delivery on strategic, complex deals, demonstrate Technical Leadership: Create Clarity, Generate Energy and Deliver Success Playing a vital part in business strategy by providing risk assessment, reviewing proposals, identifying new Services development area based on market trends, and customer expectations.
   

  

 Driving successful solution deployments by ensuring proper business value and customer/partner satisfaction.
   

  

 Technically driving Microsoft and partners team to secure delivery of the solution in the defined scope of work.
   

  

 Growing the business through mentoring, talent pipeline development, and community evangelism and sharing experiences to develop assets within the Azure Community.
   

  

 Growing the Business by transforming Services opportunity to Projects with intentional selling of applicable packaged Microsoft Services Offerings.

 Driving operational excellence and innovation, leveraging new ideas contributing to increase Microsoft value to customers.
   

  

**Experience Required For This Role Includes**
 Engagement / Stakeholder management. Successfully demonstrated leadership in 5\+ years as solution architecture for enterprise class customers. Excellent Communication (up / down/ peers).
   

  

 Proven track level in business domain \& technical conversation.
   

  

 Holistic Infrastructure solution, design and architecture.
   

  

 Proven experience in presales and closing .
   

  

 Previous track record delivering the full project life cycle.

 Deep domain expertise of cloud infrastructure solutions including Subscription Design, Identity and access management, Network topology and connectivity, Storage, Monitoring, Compute.
   

  

 Knowledge on Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well Architecture Framework (WAF), Zero Trust Security Framework.
   

  

 Knowledge on Application Architecture, Migration of Infrastructure services to Azure IaaS / Pass, Greenfield deployment\- optimization of applications, automation using Infrastructure\-as\-Code.
   

  

 Knowledge on Networking fundamentals\- VNet, ExpressRoute, vWAN, Ingress/Egress patterns and services.
   

  

 Knowledge about OSS, Docker Containers, Kubernetes and related architectures.
   

  

 Knowledge On Various DevOps Tools and Technologies: Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub.
   

  

 Knowledge on using integrated development environments \- Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code.
 **Other** 
 Embody our culture and values

**Required/Minimum Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) relevant to Information Technology, Computer Science/Engineering.
   

  

 At least 12 years related IT experience with Solution Architecture having experience in enterprise\-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, database migrations, and technology management.

**The Opportunity:**
 ECI has an exciting opportunity for a Cloud Network Architect position to support several of our client's cloud infrastructure and networking systems. Ensuring client satisfaction is our highest priority, and all available positions are customer\-facing, requiring exceptional communication and interpersonal skills. A professional, strong work ethic, and a positive attitude are essential for success in this role. Candidates must demonstrate fluency in English, both written and verbal, and exhibit the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, client\-friendly solutions.
   

  

 This is
 **Hybrid** 
 position.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Understand business requirements and convert them to technical design for implementation.
* Develop and maintain cloud network architectures that support enterprise applications, services, and workloads across public, private, and hybrid cloud platforms.
* Ensure reliable interconnectivity between on\-premises infrastructure, cloud environments, and third\-party services. Strong communication, analytical, and troubleshoot skills.
* Monitor and enhance network performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through automation and advanced cloud\-native tools.
* Implement robust network security frameworks, including firewalls, VPNs, identity management, and compliance with industry standards.
* Work independently as individual contributor with minimum or no help.
* Lead end\-to\-end cloud network design reviews (HLD/LLD), produce implementation runbooks, and enforce architecture standards and best practices.
* Own cloud network governance: IP addressing strategy, subnetting/VPC design, routing domains, DNS design, tagging/standards, and change control.
* Drive incident/problem management for network issues across cloud and hybrid connectivity, including root\-cause analysis (RCA) and continuous improvement.
* Partner with security, platform, and application teams to integrate network controls (segmentation, egress filtering, private endpoints) and meet regulatory requirements.
* Manage and coordinate third\-party providers (ISPs/carriers, firewall/WAF vendors) for circuits, cloud interconnects, and managed services; validate SLAs and delivery timelines.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure\-as\-Code patterns and CI/CD workflows for network changes (peer review, automated validation, drift detection, and rollback plans).

* Language: Fluency in English, both written and verbal, is mandatory.
* Leadership: Ability to mentor junior engineers, lead technical discussions, and drive architectural decisions.
* Certifications (Preferred): CCNP/CCIE, AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or equivalent cloud/security certifications.

56677b2a.title: Release Manager/ Cloud Engineering
56677b2a.description:
Europe, India
  
  

**Work type:**  

Office/Remote
  
  

**Technical Level:**  

Senior
  
  

**Job Category:**  

Project Management
  
  

**Project:**  

Leading platform for electronic agreements
  
  

Working hours 4am \- 2 pm CET.
  
  

Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use client’s solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people's lives. With this product the client unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents.
  
  

**Role Summary:**  

As a Release Management contractor, you will be a release enabler for client’s core services, coordinating cross\-team release activities across environments and products. You will own the operational lifecycle of releases \- from calendar planning and release readiness through execution, validation, and post\-release follow\-up \- ensuring changes ship safely, predictably, and in compliance with client’s change\-management and audit standards.
  
  

You will partner closely with Engineering, SRE, the Operations Center, Incident Command, Security, and Product to minimize release risk while improving velocity and automation, acting as a primary contact for release status, blockers, and hot\-patch decisioning during your coverage window.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Coordinate release planning and calendars for core products.
  
**Run end\-to\-end release processes and weekly patches:** track builds through environments, ensuring all gates and approvals are met before promotion.
  
Own and facilitate Go/No\-Go processes for major releases occurring within the coverage window: prepare status, verify test results, highlight risks, and record Go/No\-Go outcomes and follow\-ups.
  
Create and manage Release Authorizations (RA) and related artifacts to meet compliance and audit requirements.
  
Partner with the DOC team to sequence and monitor deployments across regions and sites. Ensure pre\-deployment checks are completed, support troubleshooting of failed deployment jobs where RM is accountable.
  
Enforce change\-management and business\-hours policies during off\-hours, including No\-Fly/moratorium periods, emergency change exceptions, and adherence to defined patch and hot\-patch criteria.
  
Drive late\-merge and hot\-patch governance.
  
**Maintain and improve release observability:** partner with Engineering/SRE to evolve RM dashboards, status views, and metrics showing release readiness, deployment progress, and risk across services and environments.
  
Support post\-release quality by coordinating validation evidence.
  
Support root\-cause and post\-mortem work for release\-related incidents and deployment regressions.
  
**Communicate clearly and proactively:** provide concise release status, risk, and impact summaries to engineering leaders, incident commanders, and DOC, and ensure release email updates and stakeholder notifications are timely and accurate.
  
  

**Requirements:**  

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  
3\+ years of experience in Release Management, Program/Project Management, SRE/DevOps, or Technical Operations supporting production software releases.
  
Experience managing multi\-environment release pipelines (e.g., development, demo, production, regulated environments) with formal gates and approvals.
  
Hands\-on experience with Jira (or equivalent) for driving release epics/stories, change records, and cross\-team work tracking.
  
Familiarity with CI/CD and deployment tooling such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GoCD, or equivalent release automation pipelines.
  
Strong understanding of SDLC and change\-management controls (CAB, change types, rollback planning, audit evidence) in a SaaS or enterprise environment.
  
Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders (Engineering, SRE, Security, Product) under time pressure and drive to clear decisions.
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to summarize complex technical risk and status for non\-technical stakeholders.
  
Ability and willingness to work the 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM PST coverage window reliably, acting as the primary Release Management contact during those hours.
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

Experience running releases for large distributed systems or multi\-product platforms.
  
Experience with observability and validation tooling such as Kusto, Grafana or equivalent for data\-driven Go/No\-Go decisions.
  
Background in or close partnership with operations/SRE teams, including exposure to incident response and post\-mortem practices.
  
Experience contributing to or leading release\-process transformation efforts (e.g., increased automation, dashboarding and metrics).
  
Comfort working with SQL/DBA partners and understanding database deployment considerations as part of coordinated releases.
  
  

**We offer\*:**  

Flexible working format \- remote, office\-based or flexible
  
A competitive salary and good compensation package
  
Personalized career growth
  
Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  
Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  
Education reimbursement
  
Memorable anniversary presents
  
Corporate events and team buildings
  
Other location\-specific benefits
  
  

* not applicable for freelancers

96599e7e.description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


Integral role in supporting AIM’s data analysis, system control, and database needs. Provide strategic ideas and thought leadership. Has/can apply solid financial industry data systems knowledge to support decision and strategy problems in key business areas. Demonstrates strong technical/problem solving skills. Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.**Role Summary**


Leads the execution and operationalization of enterprise AI initiatives, ensuring AI strategy is translated into scalable, business\-impacting solutions. Partners across business and technology teams to drive delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes, while maintaining strong alignment to enterprise priorities and governance. Acts as a senior program leader with end\-to\-end accountability for execution, value realization, and executive alignment across priority AI initiatives

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\) Enterprise AI Execution \& Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end\-to\-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

**3\) Cross\-Enterprise Partnership** Partner with Business leaders across functions, Technology, Data \& Analytics team, and Risk, Legal, and Governance teams.Align stakeholders around what gets delivered and how, while shaping execution priorities and ensuring alignment to enterprise AI strategy. Engage senior leaders, including ELT stakeholders, to drive alignment, inform decision\-making, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and outcomes. Act as a clear point of accountability for progress and results.

**4\) Technical \& Solution Leadership:** Provide informed direction on AI/ML and GenAI solutions to ensure fit\-for\-purpose design.Bridge strategy and execution by helping teams define use cases, select appropriate approaches/models, and ensure scalability and integration. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

**6\) Governance \& Responsible AI:** Ensure adherence to enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. Operationalize responsible AI practices (e.g., transparency, fairness, controls). Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

**7\) Matrix Team Leadership:** Lead through influence and build strong execution capability and accountability across a broad cross\-functional team. Create consistency in delivery methodologies and standards. Foster a high\-performance, results\-oriented environment; drive clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* 8–10\+ years in AI, data/analytics, digital, or large\-scale transformation (preferably experience in strategy consulting)
* Demonstrated success in operating with an enterprise mindset and delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives
* Strong understanding of: AI/ML and GenAI applications, data platforms and enterprise technology environments
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and influence across technical and business stakeholders to drive alignment and decisions
* Ability to build strong relationships and lead effectively in a matrixed environment without direct authority. Experience aligning stakeholders on priorities, trade\-offs, and timelines
* Experience driving execution across multiple stakeholder groups
* Ability to translate strategy into clear, actionable plans and delivered outcomes
* Experience driving adoption and change, ensuring solutions are embedded and delivering business value
* Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, make timely decisions, and navigate ambiguity confidently
* Experience leading large\-scale programs or transformation initiatives with clear accountability for outcomes
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to use data to inform decisions and optimize execution

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, Data Science or related field)

* Financial services or regulated industry experience
* Background balancing technical depth with program leadership
