d8dc347a.title: Solutions Architect- IP
d8dc347a.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
   

  

 TTEC Digital seeks a
 **Solutions Architect** 
 to join our team. This role is a full\-time and fully remote opportunity!
   

  

**The work:**
 We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early\-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982\.
   

  

 This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
   

  

**Who We Hire — The DNA**
* Self\-starters and do\-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show\-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI\-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed\-systems literate. High\-efficiency, event\-driven, low\-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.


 No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well\-rounded, smart people who move fast.
   

  

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**
* The technical face to enterprise customers — scoping deployments, designing tenant configurations, and getting customers live fast (same\-day with Desktop Intercept).
* You're selling and deploying a platform that combines voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI — technology that changes monthly — so you learn constantly and demo fearlessly.
* Startup environment: the deal, the deployment, and the product are all moving at once, and you thrive in that.


**What you'll own:**
* Pre\-sales and deployment architecture
* Tenant configuration and plugin enablement design
* Customer integration scoping (CCaaS / CRM / SIP)
* live demos that win — show\-me applies to customers too
* The customer's voice back into Product and Engineering
* Your committed go\-live timelines.


**Who you are:**
* A self\-starter with grit and a closer's instinct — you like winning, and a signed customer going live is your scoreboard.
* Show\-me mentality: you'd rather run the live demo than present the slide
* You adapt fast when the product shifts under you (it will, weekly), love new technology, and use AI tools daily — including in your own demo and scoping workflow.
* A do\-er who owns the messy middle instead of escalating it.
* A team player who translates in both directions: business requirements into technical needs for engineering, platform capability into business value for the customer.


**What You Will Bring;**
* 8\+ years of solutions architecture/sales engineering in contact\-center, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS.
* Technical enough to design an integration on a whiteboard and credible enough to own a CTO conversation — you keep the respect of senior engineers on both sides of the table.
* Knows CCaaS / CTI, SIP / RTP, and CRM landscapes cold.
* Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, transcription/translation — deep enough to answer the customer's AI architecture and data\-security questions without phoning home.
* Has taken enterprise customers live and owned the messy middle — network quirks, security reviews, procurement, the works.
* Hands\-on enough to configure a tenant, read an API payload, and debug a customer integration in real time — a troubleshooter, not a talker: when the pilot breaks at 4pm, you isolate it.
* Understands event\-driven platform architecture well enough to scope custom integrations accurately — what's config, what's a connector, what's a feature request.
* Deployment playbook craft — turns every go\-live into a repeatable playbook so the second customer is faster than the first; this is how one SA scales.
* Enterprise security fluency — comfortable in InfoSec reviews (SOC 2, data residency, PII/redaction, AI data\-usage questions); AI deals die here without it.
* Competitive positioning depth — knows the CCaaS/agent\-assist landscape and can architect around a competitor's incumbency.
* POC discipline — scopes pilots with clear success criteria and exit dates, so pilots convert instead of drifting.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

d386be4f.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
d386be4f.description:
About HavStrategy

HavStrategy is a performance\-driven digital marketing agency partnering with D2C, ecommerce, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands to drive growth through data\-backed marketing strategies.

Role Overview

We're looking for a detail\-oriented Pre\-Sales Consultant to bridge the gap between business development and delivery — understanding prospective clients' needs, crafting tailored solutions, and building compelling proposals and pitches that help HavStrategy win new business among consumer and D2C brands.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner with the business development team to understand prospective client requirements, business goals, and challenges.
* Conduct discovery calls and needs analysis to translate client requirements into tailored service solutions.
* Design and build customized pitch decks, proposals, and scopes of work for performance marketing, social media, SEO, content, and influencer marketing engagements.
* Develop pricing structures and service recommendations in collaboration with strategy and account leadership.
* Respond to RFPs/RFIs with well\-structured, persuasive, and accurate proposals.
* Coordinate with strategy, creative, and performance marketing teams to ensure proposals are feasible, accurate, and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Support the sales team in client\-facing presentations, solution walkthroughs, and pitch meetings.
* Conduct competitor and market research to strengthen proposal positioning and differentiation.
* Maintain a repository of case studies, proposal templates, and reusable pitch content.
* Track proposal status and win/loss data in the CRM to refine future pitches.
* Stay updated on market trends, competitor offerings, and industry developments in the D2C/ecommerce space.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in pre\-sales, solution consulting, business development, or a related client\-facing role (agency/digital marketing background preferred).
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred, not mandatory).
* Solid understanding of digital marketing services and how they apply to D2C/ecommerce brands.
* Proven track record of building proposals or solutions that convert into closed business.

Core Skills Needed

**Pre\-Sales \& Consulting Skills**

* Needs analysis and solution design
* Proposal, SOW, and pitch deck creation
* RFP/RFI response management
* Pricing and commercial structuring support
* Pipeline and CRM tracking (win/loss analysis)

**Communication \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication
* Persuasive presentation and storytelling skills
* Active listening and requirement gathering
* Cross\-functional coordination and relationship\-building

**Industry/Domain Knowledge**

* Understanding of digital marketing channels (SEO, SEM, social media, performance marketing, influencer marketing)
* Familiarity with D2C/ecommerce business models and growth challenges
* Awareness of market trends in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle sectors

**Analytical \& Technical Skills**

* Basic data analysis to identify client needs and shape solutions
* Proficiency with MS Office/Google Workspace (Excel, PowerPoint/Slides for proposals)
* Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce) and proposal/document tools
* Understanding of basic marketing metrics (ROAS, CAC, CTR, conversion rates) to speak credibly with clients

**Soft Skills**

* Self\-motivation and attention to detail
* Resilience and comfort working to deadlines
* Time management and multitasking
* Team collaboration (working closely with sales, creative, and strategy teams)
* Adaptability in a fast\-paced, evolving agency environment

Perks \& Growth

* Fast\-paced, high\-growth work environment
* Exposure to leading consumer and D2C brands
* Strong career growth and learning opportunities
* Direct mentorship from senior sales/marketing leadership
* Pay: ₹25,000\.00 – ₹45,000\.00 per month
* Work Location: In person

ae7ae417.title: Solutions Consultant
ae7ae417.description:
https://www.getclientell.com/careers/solutions\-consultant
 



  





*Services team, Clientell AI \- India Office, HSR Layout, Bangalore (in office, full time)* 




  





 Our clients don’t need another vendor sending status updates. They need someone in the room who understands their business well enough to tell them what they actually need.
 



 About Clientell AI Clientell AI is a San Francisco company. We run Salesforce and revenue operations for enterprises, and we build AI agents that live inside those systems and do the work instead of telling someone what to click. The team that designs, ships, and stands behind that for our largest accounts sits in HSR Layout, Bangalore.
 



 There are two sides to this business. Our product runs inside more than 2,000 organizations. Our services team runs deep, hands\-on engagements for a small number of enterprise accounts: a Fortune 100 pharmaceutical company, a European home improvement retail group, a US commercial fleet safety manufacturer. We’ll name them on the first call.
 



 We’re seventeen people, and about to be more. The next few hires shape what this company becomes, not just what it ships this quarter.
 



 About this role Our services work spans Salesforce, HubSpot, other CRM and ERP systems, and the AI agents we build on top of them. Someone has to sit with the client before anything becomes a ticket, work out what “solved” actually looks like, scope it, and then stay accountable for whether it worked.
 



 That’s this role, and you’re billable from month one. You run discovery, define the solution, write the scope, and keep the engagement honest. Our founder stays the senior relationship on the largest accounts, so nobody is handing you a Fortune 100 CFO in week two. You’re being handed the actual work. As you prove out, more of the relationship comes to you.
 



 What you’ll actually do
 


* Run discovery with client teams. Sit inside their workflow, not their requirements doc, and find the problem behind the ask
* Translate business goals into a scope our engineers and Salesforce consultants can build against, then translate what got built back into language the client’s leadership cares about
* Turn a vague ask like “our sales team doesn’t trust the data” into a scoped plan with a sequence, an owner, and a definition of done
* Own the engagement plan: timelines, dependencies, what’s in scope, what changed, who’s blocked
* Run status conversations that don’t feel like status conversations, catch the problem before the client has to raise it
* Source expansion inside the accounts you run and make the case yourself, you get paid on it
* Write scopes and recaps clean enough that another consultant could pick up the account tomorrow



 What makes you a fit
 


* You can hold a real conversation with a client’s VP and not sound like you’re reading off a deck
* You’ve run a client account, sold something, or led a project where the outcome was actually on you and not a shared grade
* You look at a business’s numbers and workflows and get curious about why they’re built that way, not just what they are
* You’ve worked close enough to a CRM to know what an object, a field, and a workflow are. You don’t need to build it, you need to not be lost when an engineer explains why something is hard
* You write clearly, scopes, recaps, and follow\-ups are most of this job in written form
* Excellent spoken and written English, most of your calls are with US teams
* You don’t wait to be told the next step
* Realistically this fits someone one to three years into a client\-facing role, MBA or not. We’re not fixed on degrees or years. The band fits someone early in their career. If you’re further along and the number still works for you, apply anyway and tell us why



 Use AI like you mean it We don’t care whether you can recite prompt engineering theory. We care whether you already use these tools to get more out of your own day. Bring one thing you automated for yourself with AI, account research, a call\-prep workflow, a proposal draft pipeline, anything real. Two minutes, screen shared. We’ll ask what it gets wrong.
 



 Even better if
 


* You’ve worked as an admin, a developer, or in any application\-level role. Understanding what you’re scoping makes you dramatically better at this
* You’ve touched Salesforce or HubSpot in any capacity
* You’ve built or run something of your own with a P\&L attached to your name
* You’ve worked at a consulting firm, an SI, or an agency, and you know what a real scope document looks like



 What it’s actually like here Some weeks are heavier than others. Go\-lives, demos, and production issues don’t check the calendar, and when that happens everyone shows up. The rest of the time we don’t perform busyness. If you want work that stops moving at 6pm every day regardless of what’s happening on an account, this will annoy you.
 



 What you get in return: real ownership from week one, visibility across the whole company, and direct access to how a services business actually gets built.
 



 How we’re hiring for this We’re also hiring a Salesforce Consultant and a Forward Deployed Engineer right now. One application, one process. The Salesforce Consultant builds inside the org. The Forward Deployed Engineer builds the agents. You define what gets built and stay accountable for whether it worked. After the first call we’ll tell you which role we’re evaluating you for and why.
 



 Interview process
 


1. Thirty minutes with the hiring manager: role fit, your AI demo, your questions
2. A ninety\-minute working session on a real client scenario, you’ll run discovery on us and write the scope
3. A conversation with the founder, we name the accounts, you meet the people you’d work with



 We aim to close this in under two weeks from the first call. If we pass, you’ll hear why.
 


* Compensation and logistics ₹7\-12 LPA fixed, plus up to ₹3L variable tied to expansion revenue on accounts you run. ESOP. Health insurance. First comp review at six months, not twelve. Full time, in office, HSR Layout, Bangalore. Not remote, our delivery model depends on people overhearing each other’s client calls. US client travel is likely, visa dependent.

The Reality of the Work:

We have a dedicated frontend intern, so your focus will be entirely on backend execution and AI system architecture. This includes:

* AI Solutions Architecture: You will design multi agent topologies (orchestrators, specialized councils, worker agents) and map complex business problems into scalable AI workflows. You must be able to architect enterprise hierarchies and multi\-tenant agent systems.
* Asynchronous Python Services: Building high volume event routers, chat platform integrations (Discord/Telegram), and local data pipelines.
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers: Building the bridges that securely connect our LLMs to databases and third\-party APIs.
* Node and TypeScript Architecture: Managing Next.js server side architecarchitecture, headless CMS integrations, and complex webhook processing.
* **Data and State Management: Structuring Prisma ORM schemas, running Supabase (PostgreSQL) migrations, and writing raw SQL.**
* Visual Orchestration: Debugging and extending massive n8n workflows. You must understand visual state management, webhook chaining, and retry logic at scale.
* **Security \& Sandboxing: Managing HashiCorp Vault credential storage and ensuring strict network isolation between execution environments.**
* Qualifications:
* **AI Orchestration \& NLP Routing: Minimum 1 year of production AI experience. You must understand how to build systems that parse natural language, route intent, and hand off execution to isolated skills.**
* **Containerization \& Network Security: You must know Docker deeply. You need to know how to isolate a headless browser worker from a secure credential vault running on a strictly internal Docker network.**
* **Human in the Loop (HITL) Engineering: You must know how to build asynchronous approval flows at the code level. Our systems execute via platforms like Discord and n8n webhooks, forcing human approval before critical actions.**
* Third Party AI Integration: You must be able to chain LLMs (Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenAI), real time web research APIs (Perplexity), and media generation models into cohesive pipelines.
* **Engineering Foundation: Minimum 2 to 3 years of core computer science experience. Before you touch AI, you must understand relational databases, asynchronous Python (FastAPI/aiohttp), Node.js, and API design.**
* Proof of Work: Moral Coding runs on verified skill, not inflated resumes. You must have shipped real projects, and you will pass a sandbox challenge to prove it.
* **Autonomy: We operate with zero micromanagement. You must be able to navigate an active codebase, isolate issues, and deploy fixes independently.**
* **Compensation and The Startup Reality:**
* **This is a fast growing startup, and you must be comfortable with the reality of early stage building.**
* **Initial Period: You must be prepared to build for the first 2 to 3 months without immediate cash compensation.**
* **The Upside: If you stick around and deliver over the first 6 months, we offer early stage equity or a target performance payout between 2 and 6 lakh.**
* **The Disclaimer: We operate on revenue and execution. These payouts are performance targets for builders who help us grow, not guaranteed salaries or legally binding promises. You earn the upside by shipping systems that generate real revenue.**
* **Next Steps: Submit your resume and direct links to the projects you have shipped. Your application will be vetted through Moral Coding. Show us your proof of work.**

cc447711.title: Senior Architect - GCI
cc447711.description:
Senior Solutions Architect — Governance, Compliance, \& Insights
   

  

 Why Join Us?
   

  

 The interesting work in enterprise security has moved inside the organization. AI agents are creating new insider risk and compliance obligations every day. Data is sprawling faster than the controls around it. At Mimecast, our product lines sit where all of that converges.
   

  

 This is an architecture role reporting directly to an Enterprise Architect (EA). You’ll work alongside other Solutions Architects on the team to shape how the product evolves, how it integrates with the rest of Mimecast, and how it stays ahead of where the market is going.
   

  

 The Solutions Architect role at Mimecast sits closer to the product problem. Discovery, shaping, and contract design now drive more of the value than detailed component design. If you primarily want to be a heads\-down individual contributor, this isn’t the right seat. If you want to shape what gets built and own the structural decisions that make a product line move fast with quality, it is.
   

  

 AI\-First Architecture at Mimecast
   

  

 Mimecast is an AI\-First engineering organization. We expect this role to use AI development tools daily — for design exploration, prototyping, documentation, code review, and analysis. This is not optional and it is not bolt\-on; it is how we work.
   

  

 You will also be designing systems that incorporate AI directly. This product line is actively building agent\-aware detections and AI\-driven enrichment, and contributing to Mimecast’s broader AI\-powered risk products. Comfort designing with — and for — LLMs, agents, and modern AI architectures is core to this job, not a side interest.
   

  

 We treat architecture artifacts — ADRs, AGENTS.md files (agent\-readable repo context), and data contracts — as machine\-readable context, not documentation. They’re the substrate that humans and agents both operate inside, and they capture the reasoning behind design decisions — the why, not just the what.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 This is a leadership role shaping the future of Mimecast's Governance, Compliance \& Insight (GCI) suite. GCI helps organizations manage data governance, retention, and compliance at scale. Our products include email \& collaboration archiving, eDiscovery, compliance management, data retention, audit capabilities, and analytics, alongside our new AI\-powered governance and compliance tools.
   

  

 You will be the connective tissue across product management, user experience, and engineering to translate real customer problems into effective, efficient solutions. You will help the team unlock value across Mimecast’s entire portfolio to help customers navigate the human and agentic risks they face every day.
   

  

 We operate with a sense of urgency. Cyber threats don't wait, and neither do we. You'll lead teams that move fast, make decisions with conviction, and deliver results. We expect leaders who thrive in this environment and inspire the same urgency in the teams around you.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Shape problems with product partners: Contribute at the problem\-framing stage, not just after requirements land. Run and facilitate workshops with product managers, engineers, UX designers, and subject matter experts to surface user needs, constraints, and opportunities. Define what “good” looks like in customer and business terms before settling on a technical shape.
* Own integration contracts as product artifacts: Help define how the product line touches the rest of the Mimecast platform. You’ll own the durable interfaces — APIs, events, and data contracts. You’ll also do the coordination work that makes integrations actually land.
* Build the architectural context engineering teams operate inside: ADRs, data contracts, and service interaction patterns. These are how architecture decisions get propagated and enforced at scale across humans and agents — they’re part of the build system, not the wiki.
* Set NFR and evaluability targets: Performance, availability, security, cost — help define the targets with real numbers. For AI features, extend that to eval coverage, agent boundary safety, and prompt/data\-contract stability.
* Coordinate across teams and organizations: A lot of the impact in this role comes from getting the right people in the room, gathering stakeholder buy\-in, and shepherding decisions to closure.
* Engage Enterprise Architecture bidirectionally: Bring cross\-product and platform\-level decisions to the EA for alignment. Pull EA\-level constraints into product shaping early. Push back when standards don’t fit your situation, with a clear case.
* Estimate and monitor cost and unit economics: Provide cost projections for new architecture work; flag unexpected spend and propose remediation. Reason about cost per outcome — per protected user, per investigated incident, per inference — not just AWS spend.
* Wear a technical\-architect hat when it adds value: Default mode is solution and product shaping. Drop into detailed technical design when the problem warrants it or when you’re unblocking a team — and know when to step back out. With agentic engineering practices in place, more of the detailed implementation work is carried by engineers with AI assistance.
* Propose technical debt work: Identify and prioritize debt reduction with Product Management partners.


 What You’ll Bring
   

  

* Architecture experience at scale: 8\+ years building and operating production systems, and engaging with product early in the cycle. Time as a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or equivalent. Comfortable owning architecture across multiple teams.
* Cloud\-native depth: Strong working knowledge of AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, IAM, VPC), Kafka, and the ability to reason about distributed systems at high volume. You don’t need deeper AWS internals knowledge than the senior engineers — you need to reason about system shape and trade\-offs.
* Contract\-first integration thinking: A track record of designing clean contracts between systems and teams — async messaging, event streaming, REST/gRPC APIs, data contracts — and a clear point of view on when to reach for which.
* Product partnership: Comfortable working with PMs on problem definition, customer research synthesis, jobs\-to\-be\-done framing, and outcome hypotheses. You have a point of view on what makes a good product bet, not just a good technical bet.
* AI\-First working style: You actively use AI development tools day\-to\-day and have a real opinion on where they help and where they don’t. You’re comfortable designing systems that include LLMs, agents, retrieval, or related components — or you’re hungry to get there fast.
* Strong written and verbal communication: Can write a one\-page ADR that lands, draft a solution brief that holds up under EA review, and lead a whiteboard session that produces a decision. Equally comfortable with engineers, PMs, and designers.
* Stakeholder navigation: Good at building consensus across teams and organizations. Comfortable with ambiguity.
* Self\-direction: Driven, accountable, and able to identify the right problems to work on without being told. The team is small and senior — you’ll be expected to lead, not wait for direction.
* Bonus points: Background in security, compliance, eDiscovery, identity, observability, or data platforms. Familiarity with agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or LLM application architecture. Experience with eval design for AI systems, product discovery practices, or data contract / data mesh approaches (e.g., ODCS).


 What We Offer
   

  

* Impact: Your architecture decisions will shape one of Mimecast’s fastest\-evolving product lines and protect data inside thousands of enterprises.
* Voice: Direct working relationship with senior architecture leadership and a real say in technology direction across the product line — and beyond, as opportunities present themselves.
* Modern stack and modern ways of working: AWS managed services, Kafka, modern Java and Kotlin services, a growing AI tooling footprint, and a team that defaults to ship\-and\-iterate over review\-and\-gate.
* Senior peers: A small architecture team where everyone is operating at a high level and trust runs deep.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of professional software engineering and architecture experience, with at least 2 years in a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or similar role with significant product\-shaping responsibility.
* Willingness and drive to use AI development tools in a professional setting.


**Belonging at Mimecast**
 Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
   

  

 We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
   

  

 We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
   

  

*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

* Strong expertise in Solution Architecture, including designing scalable, secure, and resilient AI\-driven enterprise solutions.

* Hands\-on background in Software Development, preferably in modern web technologies, APIs, microservices, and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Position:** PrArchitect – Hands\-on  
**Initial Location:** Bangalore  
**Initial Work Duration:** Approximately 6 months in Bangalore  
**Subsequent Location:** Germany  
**Experience Required:** 8\+ years  
**Bangalore Annual CTC:** Up to ₹50 LPA , depending on the candidate’s profile, relevant experience and technical expertise

Location and Relocation Requirement

The selected candidate will initially work from the Bangalore office for approximately **six months**. This period will focus on onboarding, integration with the product and engineering teams, understanding the company’s architecture, platforms, development standards and business requirements.

**Candidates must therefore be open to working in Bangalore during the initial six\-month period and subsequently relocating to Germany.**

The compensation mentioned above applies to the Bangalore market. Upon successful transition, the selected candidate will receive an **employment contract from the Germany entity with a German CTC structure**. This German employment contract will be the primary basis for the relocation and visa process.

Relocation and Transition Support

The company will provide the following support for the candidate’s relocation from Bangalore to Germany:

* Visa processing support
* Visa sponsorship for the selected employee
* Flight ticket from Bangalore to Germany
* Settling\-in allowance
* Temporary accommodation upon arrival in Germany
* German\-side employment contract with the applicable German CTC

Please note that the visa sponsorship and relocation support are provided for the **employee only**. Family or dependent visa sponsorship, relocation expenses or related benefits are not included.

Apart from the benefits mentioned above, no additional relocation benefits will be provided.

Social Security and Payroll in Germany

Employees working in Germany will be covered under the applicable **statutory German social security system**.

The employer will pay the required statutory employer contributions. The employee’s statutory contribution will be deducted from the gross salary through the payroll system. This will apply across all employment levels in accordance with German statutory requirements.

**Role Overview**

As a hands\-on Architect, you will play an active role in shaping and advancing modern, secure and scalable SaaS products. You will take functional and technical ownership of key product components while working closely with development, product and engineering teams.

This is not a pure governance, advisory or documentation\-based architecture position. The organisation is looking for an architect who can actively design, build, review, troubleshoot and optimise production\-grade systems.

The selected candidate will be expected to balance strategic architectural decision\-making with hands\-on software engineering and implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture and System Design**

* Define, develop and continuously evolve the overall architecture of the company’s products and associated platform services.
* Design highly scalable, resilient, secure and cloud\-native SaaS architectures.
* Lead the architectural design and development of multi\-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Design and build Identity and Access Management solutions.
* Architect distributed systems and microservices\-based platforms.
* Develop API\-first platforms that support secure and scalable integrations.
* Design event\-driven architectures for modern enterprise applications.
* Establish architectural standards, design patterns, engineering principles and development best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide guidance on system design, scalability, maintainability and security.
* Evaluate new technologies, tools and frameworks based on technical and business requirements.
* Drive the technical roadmap in alignment with product strategy and organisational objectives.
* Identify architectural risks and recommend practical and sustainable solutions.
* Ensure consistency across product components, platform services and engineering teams.

**Hands\-on Engineering**

* Actively contribute to the design and development of core platform components.
* Build, enhance and optimise backend services using **Golang**.
* Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable RESTful APIs.
* Develop event\-driven integrations and services.
* Design and optimise data models using **MongoDB** and modern **NoSQL** architecture patterns.
* Participate directly in coding, debugging and troubleshooting activities.
* Conduct performance analysis, application optimisation and root\-cause analysis.
* Review code and provide technical guidance to engineering teams.
* Promote clean code, automated testing, continuous integration and development automation.
* Ensure that architectural decisions are practical and effectively implemented within production systems.
* Work closely with developers to resolve complex technical challenges.
* Support the delivery of reliable, scalable and production\-ready software solutions.

**Security and Identity \& Access Management**

The following capabilities are considered highly desirable:

* Design secure\-by\-default application and platform architectures.
* Drive the adoption of Identity and Access Management standards and security best practices.
* Work with authentication and authorisation frameworks and protocols.
* Apply strong knowledge of **OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect and SAML**.
* Implement Zero Trust principles within application and cloud architectures.
* Ensure that products comply with applicable security, privacy and regulatory requirements.
* Identify security vulnerabilities and recommend architectural improvements.
* Collaborate with engineering and security teams to ensure secure implementation across the product lifecycle.

**Required Technical Experience**

* Minimum **8 years of software engineering experience**, with strong exposure to software and solution architecture.
* Proven experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Principal Engineer, Lead Architect or in a similar technical leadership role.
* Prior experience working with SaaS product companies.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in **Golang** and backend platform engineering.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building distributed systems.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture and implementation.
* Hands\-on experience with **MongoDB** and NoSQL database architecture.
* Experience designing scalable and secure APIs and backend services.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native architecture principles.
* Experience with modern frontend technologies such as **Angular, React or similar frameworks**.
* Experience working with multi\-tenant SaaS applications.
* Knowledge of API\-first and event\-driven platform architecture.
* Ability to contribute directly to software development while taking ownership of architectural decisions.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Identity and Access Management or Customer Identity and Access Management products.
* Knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML and Zero Trust architecture.
* Experience building secure, scalable and highly available SaaS platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, privacy and regulatory compliance.
* Experience with performance engineering, system optimisation and root\-cause analysis.
* Exposure to automation, testing frameworks and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience working with international and cross\-functional product engineering teams.

**Competencies Required**

* Strong systems\-thinking ability and an architectural mindset.
* Passion for solving complex technical and engineering challenges.
* Ability to balance long\-term architectural strategy with hands\-on implementation.
* Strong product mindset and ownership\-driven approach.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex architectural concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to influence and guide engineering teams through technical leadership rather than organisational hierarchy.
* Commitment to engineering excellence, scalability, security, reliability and maintainability.
* Ability to work effectively with international and multicultural teams.
* Willingness and readiness to relocate from Bangalore to Germany following successful integration.

Pay: ₹3,500,000\.00 \- ₹4,500,000\.00 per year

* Provident Fund

Client Engagement Manager

8e25ec6f.title: Senior Manager, Success Architecture
8e25ec6f.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Senior Manager, Success Architects — Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead the Success Architect team, a group of experienced ICs spanning AMER, EMEA, and APAC who serve as the technical backbone of Salesforce''s most strategic enterprise customer relationships. This role exists to make that team exceptional at scale: setting the vision, building the people, and ensuring Salesforce is deployed correctly and valuably in even the most complex enterprise environments.
   

  

 This is a role for a technical leader who understands the craft deeply enough to coach it, and has the customer\-facing pedigree to elevate the team's impact across complex, global enterprise environments. You should have a proven track record leading technical customer\-facing teams and possess deep expertise in the Salesforce platform.
   

  

****What We Do****
 Our Success Architect team delivers expert\-led, technical engagements that help Salesforce's largest enterprise customers deploy, integrate, and scale Salesforce as mission\-critical infrastructure. Through deep product expertise and hands\-on advisory, Success Architects guide customers through complex technical environments, from identity and security architecture to AI enablement, workflow automation, and platform extensibility, ensuring every customer can move from challenge to deployable solution at pace with Salesforce.
   

  

****What You Will Be Doing****
 You will lead your team to serve a portfolio of Salesforce's largest and most strategic customers, ensuring those customers successfully adopt, deeply integrate, and continuously derive business value from Salesforce. You will develop the strategy, programs, and operational cadences to effectively leverage your team's technical depth and deliver best\-in\-class engagements across customer segments. As a member of our Customer Success leadership team, you will advocate for your customers and your team by driving alignment across Account Success, Product, and Support. You will build and develop a high\-performing team that lives Salesforce's values, empowering your Success Architects to be the definitive technical resource for enterprise customers, guiding them through complex engagements and positioning Salesforce as mission\-critical infrastructure. As a technical leader, you will directly influence customer health, retention, and expansion outcomes by ensuring your team delivers high\-quality engagements across the full Success Architect portfolio, including identity management, Enterprise Mobility Management, Salesforce AI, migrations, workflow automations, and platform extensibility. You will contribute to Salesforce's Customer Success vision and strategy, and deliver team targets and key metrics through operational excellence and disciplined execution. This role calls for a hands\-on, "get it done" leadership approach. You will engage in account strategy for key and at\-risk customers, model technical best practices for your team, and develop case studies and references that showcase the value of Salesforce at scale. You will align the full Salesforce ecosystem to customer needs and foster a vibrant, inclusive team culture that inspires people to do their best work.
   

  

****What You Should Have****
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related field.
   

  

 14\+ years of relevant work experience in Enterprise Architecture, Technology Consulting, Customer Success, Technology Solutions Development, or Technical/Solutions Architecture.
   

  

 Experience leading a technical team in the enterprise software space, with direct oversight of engagement deliverables and customer executive alignment. A track record of building and growing a high\-performing team through talent acquisition, onboarding, and development, characterized by strong productivity and excellent morale.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with the Salesforce platform, including its extensibility, APIs, integration ecosystem, and enterprise deployment patterns, with strong familiarity across identity (SAML, SSO, SCIM), eDiscovery and DLP, and key SaaS integrations.
   

  

 Proven ability to navigate, escalate, and resolve complex customer challenges across large\-scale, distributed enterprise environments.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence credibly at all levels of the organization, including executive and C\-level.
   

  

 Track record of delivering against targets and KPIs, with proven success establishing a clear vision and driving change within a customer\-facing organization.
   

  

****What Will Set You Apart****
 Experience building and scaling a globally distributed technical team, with a track record of developing talent across time zones and cultures while keeping the team technically sharp as the platform evolves beneath them.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Salesforce APIs, workflow automation, or custom Salesforce application development is a strong plus.
   

  

 Interest, educational background, or delivery expertise in Generative AI technologies.
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage deeply with technical stakeholders or articulate core capabilities to a business audience.
   

  

 Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through complex customer issues.
   

  

 Experience influencing across Technical and Go\-To\-Market teams without direct authority.
   

  

 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

997d88ad.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, WW Prime Core Services
997d88ad.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you interested in driving highly visible initiatives for Amazon’s Prime program? Do you enjoy the challenge and ownership that come from managing complex, cross\-functional and cross\-organizational projects? Do you enjoy working in an entrepreneurial environment solving complex technical problems and delivering innovative solutions?
  

The Prime Team is seeking an exceptional Technical Program Manager for a challenging, high\-value, high\-visibility program. As a TPM for Amazon Prime, you will be responsible for delivering projects with huge strategic impact. You will work with various software and business teams around the company to identify and drive innovative solutions that achieve business goals. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the next generation of Amazon Prime! This role will give you an opportunity to work with many different teams and learn a range of new systems, leveraging the deep collection of technologies throughout the company and extending them to allow us to boldly go where no retail system has gone before.
  

The Prime program is experiencing explosive growth and as a result our team is looking to expand its top\-notch management talent. If you want to work on one of Amazon's most impactful program and are passionate about implementing solutions that impact millions of people every day, we want to hear from you!
  

This role requires working closely with the product management team and key software development teams across the company to define strategy and requirements, and lead development design through delivery and subsequent operation. This position requires regular communication with executive management on status, risks and product strategy. Excellent listening, writing skills and strong technical competency are essential. You should have experience managing multiple complete product development cycles, possesses superior analytical abilities and expert product judgment. A successful candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent analytical and problem solving skills, and great project management and communication skills.
  

Responsibilities:
  

* Be a guardian of world\-class customer experience for your deliverables: continually raise the bar on functionality, flow, consistency, usability, and simplicity
* Be the interface between the product owners and the development team, thoroughly understanding the product, helping define user stories, and driving the evaluation of appropriate technical solutions to meet the business requirements.
* Own engagement with the partners, work to decompose requirements into technical execution plans with multiple development teams, track progress towards goals, and report status to product, business development, and technical leadership.
* Help make the right feature trade\-offs to ship software without compromising customer experience and business relevance
* Engage with many other teams in the company, evangelizing the team and your project, building relationships and helping identify existing components and technologies that can be leveraged to deliver on our goals
* Represent the technical team to senior leadership across the company
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

333fd934.title: Program Manager II, Amazon Books
333fd934.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about using technology, automation, and data to solve complex business problems at scale? The Books Risk Management (BRM) Automation team is seeking a Program Manager II to drive automation programs that improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and enhance the customer experience across Amazon's Books business.  

  

In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, drive automation adoption, and deliver measurable business impact. You will lead high\-visibility initiatives, investigate complex operational challenges, influence technical roadmaps, and ensure automation systems continue to operate effectively as the business scales. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, ownership, and the ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Partner with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Application Engineers, and Risk teams to define requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and operational scalability through automation and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Use data and metrics to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and prioritize investments.
* Lead deep dives into operational issues, quality defects, and high\-severity escalations, driving root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor automation performance, adoption, accuracy, and business impact through scalable reporting mechanisms.
* Build business cases, define success metrics, and measure realized benefits including productivity gains, quality improvements, and operational leverage.
* Translate business requirements into actionable technical requirements and work closely with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Drive end\-to\-end execution of automation and process improvement programs supporting Books Risk Management workflows.
* Communicate program updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders across multiple organizations.
* Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and automation opportunities to improve risk detection, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.

  

A day in the life  

You may start your day reviewing operational metrics and automation performance, investigating a production issue impacting a critical workflow, partnering with engineers on a new automation launch, conducting a deep dive into quality trends, or presenting program updates to senior leaders. You will regularly work across business, product, and technical teams to solve complex problems, prioritize opportunities, and deliver scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.  

  

About the team  

The BRM Automation team is responsible for driving automation, AI adoption, and process transformation across Books Risk Management. Our mission is to improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and protect customer trust by building scalable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and enable the organization to scale effectively. We operate at the intersection of business, risk, and technology, partnering closely with engineering and product teams to solve some of the most complex challenges in the Books ecosystem.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
 



 We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
 



 Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world.
 



  





  





**Role Overview and What You Will Do** 




  




* As a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, you will work closely with members of multiple business \& Engineering teams to help define, streamline, design and analysis data to build business requirements and then work with engineering teams to articulate requirements, further perform functional \& technical data \& system analysis, drive engineering to implementation via all phases of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* In addition, the ideal candidate must possess a high degree of collaborative skills, and the ability to communicate effectively on many levels.



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Strong functional \& technical analytical \& design capability to understand Common \& shared platforms, web, \& services API with underlying data.
* Should be able to dive deep to come up with new Platform scenarios that help solving systems bigger problems by simplifying our services \& cloud platform and help increase productivity \& efficiency or every Engineer \& system in the company.
* Solid Platform, Web services, API technologies experience.
* Strong blend of technical, business, and program management experience that enables seamless communication across teams, project execution and great customer reach.
* Own, manage and deliver multiple large scale, complex programs across organizations with ease of simplicity, taking teams along to the path of success.
* Own and Manage implementation E2E from Project charter, roadmap, plan, design, design, build, execute, deliver and monitor performance \& adoption.
* Creates, evolves, and communicates specifications for feature areas that enable cohesive, compatible, iterable scenarios that span multiple feature teams and enable a durable multi\-year vision.
* Should be able to come up with scenarios and business requirements by analyzing data and business needs.
* Excellent cross\-group collaboration and communication skillsStrong problem\-solving skills, analytical capabilities, and attention to detail
* Strong cultural change management experience
* Identify, Propose and Implement ongoing data strategy and drive data quality improvements
* Establishes, enables and improves systems to manage product feedback from customers to resolve issues.



  





  





**Basic Qualifications** 




  




* Minimum of 12 Years of Engineering Program Management experience in managing feature teams and designing large\-scale or complex technical initiatives on shared Platform for Web \& Web services, API, Data analytics
* Minimum of 5 Years in Platform, Web design, API that are used by internal \& external teams.

You will represent the company in technical discussions, communicate with enterprise clients, handle critical customer conversations, prepare technical proposals, respond to RFPs, and ensure customer expectations are managed professionally without overcommitting.

f1b99657.title: Principal Architect
f1b99657.description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India Sales Ref ID: JR\-019621  

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. This role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business\-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this senior role you will lead, direct, and advise cross\-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory\-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.


Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.


Core Focus Areas


The Principal Architect is expected to be generally familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. The ideal candidate for this role will have deep technical knowledge of and hands\-on experience with security operations or incident response.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:**


* Establish and maintain executive\-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.
* Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.
* Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.
* Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.
* Conduct high\-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

**Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:**


* Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.
* Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

**Internal Partnership and Development:**


* Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.
* Maintain continuous self\-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)
* Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

**Qualifications**

**Requirements and Qualifications**


* Experience: 10\+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.
* Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.
* Architectural Knowledge:


	+ Must have deep knowledge of network security and SASE/Zero Trust. Preferred experience in security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, incident response, cloud security, identity management, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI is a plus.
	+ Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.
	+ Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.
* Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).
* Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.
* Drive and Problem Solving:


	+ A "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.
	+ Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.
* Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%\+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.
* Organisational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.


Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.


Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship?: Yes

6a50edc6.title: Senior Manager, Solutions Consulting India
6a50edc6.description:
**Meet Our Team**
 As Sr. Manager to Solutions Consulting team for India, you will lead a team of Solutions Consultants covering Pega’s Global Clients and / or Partners and their clients with presence in India. You will also collaborate cross\-functionally with sales leadership, solution consulting leadership, account executives, consulting, partners, business officers, and other stakeholders to define and execute on the sales strategy, secure revenue targets and drive adoption of Pega AI Blueprint and Pega's AI\-powered workflow and decisioning capabilities. The team is customer\-centric, technical, business/value outcome driven, and focused on transforming clients through Pega's solutions. This is a player / coach role where you will work on an account alongside providing guidance to the team.
   

  

**Picture Yourself At Pega**
 This must be one of the most exciting roles in the industry. You will lead a top performing and highly talented team and work with award winning solutions. Pega’s Customers are transforming with speed, Pega's tools and solutions are right there to help them.
   

  

 You play a critical role driving Pega's strategy using Pega AI Blueprint and Predictable AI. Blueprint changes the way we interact and work with our customers dramatically, reducing time it takes to drive customers' outcomes and value. As the Solutions Consulting leader, you're at the forefront of this change, being a true Blueprint advocate and leader. This role provides a great opportunity to build on the foundations of the team through introducing the Solution Designer approach, turning customer ideas/needs into solutions in weeks.
   

  

 Reporting to the Director Solution Consulting and DemoX, you are the technical representative at executive level. being a partner for our most strategic customers. You're an energetic team player with a passion for driving value for customers, who will act as a thought leader, and represent Pega's core technology to the outside world. Your vision, ambition, and leadership will be critical as we continue to grow our revenue and rapidly expand our presence in 2026 and beyond.
   

  

 At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
   

  

 We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
   

  

**What You'll Do At Pega**
**Technical Sales Strategy and Execution**
* Use Pega AI Blueprint and Predictable AI to help our customers across Financial Services, Insurance, Communications, Healthcare and Manufacturing to drive outcomes, innovate, reduce costs and modernize their legacy estate.
* As a Player / Coach, lead the team in Qualification, Solution Design and development of best practice technical solutions that leverage Pega's solutions.
* Proactively support and work with the Solutions Consulting and Sales teams in Designing Solutions, present and demonstrate and share best practice to "raise the bar".
* Engage and develop relationships with client and partner executives acting as a counterpart for our most strategic CIO’s/CTO’s.
* Be a recognized thought leader and domain expert in Pega solutions, representing Pega to the outside world and at events
* Lead the team with the Solution Design approach.
* You will play a player / coach role where you will work on an account alongside providing guidance to the team.


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Lead the team in execution of Pega Sales strategy with focus on Blueprint and the Solution Designer approach.
* Secure execution and compliance with Solutions Consulting tasks and goals (Spending time with and at our customers, Blueprint adoption, Training and use of Pega's sales automation system).
* Drive and support the innovation and adoption of initiatives, reusable assets, selling programs, enablement, to scale the success of Pega's core technologies.
* Collaborate and foster strong partnerships with internal leaders in Specialists, Product Development, Product Marketing, Alliances, Industry Business Units, and other peer Specialist organizations globally at Pega.


**People Development**
* Lead the team towards the best Solution Designers in the industry.
* Cultivate your team of direct reports through coaching, goal\-setting, and performance management, with a focus on developing expertise in their chosen domain or the client they support
* Develop and maintain cutting\-edge Solutions Consultant knowledge of Pega AI Blueprint, Pega Platform, GenAI capabilities, and other core Pega technologies in partnership with the Product teams.


 Oversee the Solutions Consultants to ensure accurate planning and coordination of all requests for resources from the sales field to ensure a balanced workload across the team.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* An ambitious leader, coach and someone who will roll up sleeves to work on their own account with an understanding and background in one or more of the following domains \- Financial Services, Insurance, Communications, Healthcare and Manufacturing
* Passionate about people, Pega AI Blueprint, technology, and the transformative potential of workflow and Predictable AI.
* Enjoy being hands\-on in the field, coaching and leading by example to secure results on critical engagements with enterprise clients.
* You're a strategic thinker with experience and excitement for managing a driven, successful Solutions Consulting team focused on helping the account team achieve their Revenue goals
* You proactively develop relationships with prospects by understanding, anticipating and showcasing AI\-powered solutions that meet the unique business needs customers in these fields
* Willing to travel throughout the region to support the business.
* You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
* You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


**What You've Accomplished**
* Demonstrated leadership and initiative to build scale, and driven growth.
* Experience advising and managing a team of Solutions Consultants with a focus driving adoption and evangelization and consulting on proof solutions to help sell an enterprise grade SaaS product
* 6\+ years managing pre\-sales teams with a successful track record working with enterprise clients through enterprise\-like sales engagements in any of the following domains: Financial Services, insurance, Telecom, Healthcare, Manufacturing
* 6\+ years of working as an independent solutions consultant in a presales team
* Deep technical acumen with strong preference for CRM, BPM, and AI experience
* Delivered POCs and custom demonstrations that showcase how Pega's AI capabilities solve specific challenges in any of the domains listed above
* Provided thought leadership in technology with an emphasis on how AI is transforming customer operations in Financial Services


**Pega Offers You**
* A fun and dynamic work environment in which you will have an amazing opportunity to make a big impact.
* Gartner/Forester Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products including Pega Platform, Customer Decision Hub, and Intelligent Automation.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities in core Pega technologies and AI\-driven solutions.
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, and structured work environment.
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field.
