 2025\-13610
 **Date posted** 
 04/05/2026
 **Location** 
 Bengaluru, India
 **Category** 
 IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you looking for an exciting new chance to build on your experience working on business\-led change initiatives? Arm is changing the future of computing across multiple sectors from mobile clients and automotive through to Hyperscalers and embedded devices. And we're doing this together with our broad ecosystem of partners and for the benefit of everyone!
   

  

 You will be part of Arm’s Enterprise IT Business Applications Architecture practice and work across the portfolio of projects to provide architectural guidance and solutions to business challenges that are aligned to strategy and EIT roadmaps. You will also be responsible for technical leadership and direction to development and delivery teams, ensuring delivery of your designs is adequately stewarded and also collaborating across teams to find opportunities for new technologies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Interpret Business Needs**
* Collaborate with senior leaders to identify future technology innovations and evolutions that have potential to address business ambitions
* Develop solutions designs (HLD) and roadmaps aligned to the Domain target
* Maintain mapping between Capabilities, Applications and Data


**Assess and Apply Technology**
* Be creative in the use of existing technologies
* Work with members of the technical communities to develop and establish reference patterns for Platforms and Solutions
* Look ahead for opportunities with new technologies and applications


**Technical leadership**
* Supports change initiatives and technical communities, guiding and helping teams and partners to align with the overall enterprise architecture
* Ownership of solution pattern and approach, responsible for sign\-off on High\-Level designs and ensuring alignment to target and roadmaps
* Ensure quality of Architecture design artefacts and present at governance forums


**Practice Development**
* Develop and evolve Architecture principles, governance, materials and ways of working
* Guide and mentor teams on architecture principles, governance, and standard practices
* Drive innovation by researching and evaluating emerging technologies that align with business needs


**Required Skills And Experience**
* At least 8 years of experience in a Solution Architect role.
* Strong experience with Salesforce, SAP, and integration platforms (e.g., Mulesoft, event\-driven architectures, MS Power Platform, Automation Anywhere).
* Good knowledge of LoB applications (e.g., ServiceNow, HCM, CMS, CLM) in commercial and operational domains.
* Expertise in cloud services (multi\-provider, AI, cloud\-native development).
* Experience with DevSecOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices.
* Ability to balance long\-term vision with short\-term needs and define multiple solution options.
* Familiarity with Business Analysis, Programme Management, and application development methodologies.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies
* Demonstrable experience in project governance, leadership, and architecture team development.


**“Nice To Have” Skills And Experience**
* Formal qualifications in development languages or application platforms
* Experience of the semi\-conductor industry or other Engineering based organisations!


**In Return**
* This is a new team, and there is plenty of opportunity to shape its future, and your own growth and progression.


**Accommodations at Arm**
 At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email
   

  

**Hybrid Working at Arm**
 Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.
   

  

**Equal Opportunities at Arm**
 Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

c6b47602.title: Architect (ATC)
c6b47602.description:
The Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations D365 F\&O Solution Architect serves as the senior technical and functional leader responsible for the overall health, stability, and continuous improvement of ConnectAmerica's Microsoft Dynamics Finance \& Operations platform. This role provides architectural oversight, production support leadership, and strategic guidance for application managed services while ensuring the platform aligns with business objectives, Microsoft best practices, and enterprise architecture standards. The architect serves as the highest technical escalation point for complex production issues, major enhancements, integrations, and solution design. The role works closely with business stakeholders, IT leadership, Microsoft, third party vendors
   

  

 The Solution Architect owns the end to end architecture of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations platform and designs scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions that support business processes. The role reviews and approves solution designs, customizations, integrations, and extensions while ensuring all enhancements align with Microsoft's extensibility framework and One Version upgrade strategy. Responsibilities also include developing architecture roadmaps, leading production support including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Procurement and Sourcing, Fixed Assets, Cash and Bank Management, Budgeting, Financial Reporting, Security and Role Based Access, Workflow, Electronic Reporting, Batch Processing, and Master Data Management. It also includes designing and governing integrations using Azure Integration Services, Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Data Management Framework, OData, Dual Write, Power Platform, APIs, and middleware solutions
   

  

 The ideal candidate has more than 10 years of Microsoft Dynamics ERP experience, including at least 5 years as a Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations Solution Architect supporting enterprise scale production environments. Strong expertise in Application Managed Services, Microsoft Lifecycle Services, Azure cloud services, Azure DevOps, CI/CD practices, X\+\+, extensions, data entities, integration patterns, and stakeholder management is essential. Preferred qualifications include Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate, Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant Associate

48f69577.title: SECURITY ARCHITECT L1
48f69577.description:
**Job Title:** SECURITY ARCHITECT L1
  
**City:** Hyderabad
  
**State/Province:** Telangana
  
**Posting Start Date:** 7/30/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Network Security Consultant
  
  

Designing, Architect, Implementing and Maintaining an organization's network security infrastructure solutions like Firewalls, IDPS, Proxy, Load Balancers, VPN, WAF etc., align with the organization's strategies, policies, and standards.
  
Design and manage firewall policies, network access controls, AAA mechanisms, MFA, IAM solutions, RBAC, Privilege Management etc.,
  
In\-depth understanding of cloud network security, different network architectures (e.g., LAN, WAN, DMZ) and topologies, network protocols, routing, switching, and subnetting.
  
Ensure network security measures are aligned with relevant compliance standards and regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS). Conduct regular security audits and assessments to identify and address compliance gaps.
  
Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks like NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, and CIS Critical Security Controls.
  
Familiarity with the use of standard security technology solutions and processes such as user provisioning, directory, SIEM, vulnerability management, Cloud Security (OCI/Azure/AWS), Web Security, Email Security, Logging and Monitoring, General PKI and Cryptography.
  
Evaluate and recommend security technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance network security posture. Monitor network traffic for unusual activities and potential security breaches.
  
Work closely with IT teams, including network engineers, system administrators, and application developers, to ensure a holistic approach to security.
  
Communicate complex security concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and executives.
  
Technical background with experience in solution delivery including SDLC, security tools and technologies, and Agile framework.
  
Provide training and guidance to staff members on network security best practices
  
Maintain accurate documentation of network security configurations, processes, and procedures.
  
Minimum 5 years’ Experience as a Security consultant, Security Architect or equivalent.
  
  

Hold any Certification like Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, F5, CompTIA, Zscaler, Azure, AWS, CISSP, CCSP, ISSAP, ITIL etc
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** Checkpoint Firewalls and VPN .
  
  

**Experience:** 8\-10 Years .
  
  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

317429ad.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
317429ad.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Platform Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Designs, builds, tests, and deploys cloud application solutions that integrate cloud and non\-cloud infrastructure. Can deploy infrastructure and platform environments, creates a proof of architecture to test architecture viability, security and performance.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 JBOSS Administration
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Apache HTTP Server, Websphere Portal Server Administration
   

  

**Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Cloud Platform Engineer, a typical day involves designing and constructing cloud\-based application solutions that seamlessly integrate both cloud and traditional infrastructure components. The role includes building and testing these solutions to ensure they meet performance and security standards. Additionally, the engineer deploys infrastructure and platform environments and develops proof of architecture models to validate the feasibility and robustness of the proposed designs. Collaboration with various teams to align architecture with business needs and continuous evaluation of system performance are also key aspects of the daily routine.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth deployment and integration of cloud solutions.
* Monitor and optimize cloud platform performance to maintain high availability and reliability.
* Document architecture designs and deployment processes to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.
* Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support in understanding cloud platform operations.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in JBOSS Administration.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Apache HTTP Server, Websphere Portal Server Administration.
* Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure components and their integration with on\-premises systems.
* Experience in deploying and managing platform environments in cloud settings.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud application deployments.
* Familiarity with security best practices and performance tuning in cloud environments.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in JBOSS Administration.
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

* 12\+ years of progressive infrastructure experience, with 5\+ years in cloud architecture roles.
* Deep expertise in cloud infrastructure design and operations (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP).
* Strong knowledge of networking, security, identity, and hybrid cloud integration.
* Hands\-on experience with IaC and automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, ARM, etc.).

* Strong knowledge of governance, compliance, and FinOps principles in cloud.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* This role involves rotational shifts, including night shifts, to provide 24/7 application support.
* Flexibility to work weekends and public holidays as per shift schedule.
* Ability to handle responsibilities independently during off\-hours.

bc347111.title: Cloud Migration Engineer
bc347111.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Migration Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high\-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next\-generation business outcomes.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Cloud Automation DevOps
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Cloud Infrastructure
   

  

**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current systems and infrastructure to determine the best approach for transitioning to cloud environments. This role includes planning and executing the migration of applications and data, ensuring that the solutions implemented are scalable and deliver high performance. The position requires coordinating with various stakeholders to align migration strategies with business goals, while leveraging both private and public cloud technologies to support innovative and efficient outcomes.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of migration strategies that align with organizational objectives.
* Facilitate communication and coordination between cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth migration processes.
* Mentor junior team members to support their growth and enhance team capabilities.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Cloud Automation DevOps.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Cloud Infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of cloud migration methodologies and best practices.
* Ability to design and implement automation scripts and tools to streamline cloud operations.
* Experience with cloud service providers and their respective management consoles.
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Cloud Automation DevOps.
* This position is based at our DDC5E \- SEZ location.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

7c59e804.title: Kubernetes Platform Architect (India, Bangalore, Remote))
7c59e804.description:
**Job Description:**
 The VKS Application Engineering team is responsible for enabling enterprise success with VMware Kubernetes Service (VKS) as part of VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). Our mission is to accelerate adoption of VKS as the enterprise\-grade Kubernetes platform for modern applications in private cloud.
   

  

 As a VKS Application Engineer, you will be on the front lines with enterprise customers, driving the successful adoption of VMware Kubernetes Service (vKS) on VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role focused on designing and validating solutions, running proof\-of\-concepts, and guiding customers through their modernization journey.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Act as a trusted advisor for enterprise customers, guiding them through the design, validation, and deployment of vKS solutions on VCF.
* Collaborate closely with field account teams to align solution architecture with customer priorities and drive successful engagement outcomes.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and proof\-of\-concepts to validate vKS architectures and demonstrate business value.
* Partner with sales to jointly develop customer proposals that address modernization goals, workload placement, and operational transformation.
* Provide prescriptive guidance on Kubernetes adoption, DevOps/CI\-CD integration, and enterprise requirements such as scalability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Build and share reference architectures, deployment patterns, and technical assets to accelerate customer adoption of VKS.
* Deliver clear, compelling technical presentations to diverse audiences, from architects to executive decision makers.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor offerings, and evolving enterprise requirements to position VKS effectively.
* Collaborate with product management and engineering to provide field feedback that influences roadmap direction.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Experience in application engineering or technical sales for enterprise IT, cloud, or application platforms.
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes, containers, and VMware Cloud Foundation (vSphere, vSAN, NSX as foundation).
* 10\+ years in technology\-related roles, with depth in enterprise IT architecture, application modernization, or cloud\-native platforms.
* Demonstrated success working directly with enterprise customers to deliver technical solutions and drive platform adoption.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and business leaders.
* Strong collaboration skills, able to work hand\-in\-hand with sales teams to advance customer opportunities.
* Proven ability to identify challenges, design solutions, and articulate value in business terms.
* Enthusiastic self\-starter with curiosity, drive, and the ability to thrive in dynamic environments.
* Ability to travel up to 50% of the time


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field; or equivalent experience.
* Deep knowledge of VMware Cloud Foundation and Kubernetes platforms.
* Certifications in cloud\-native or public cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, Red Hat OpenShift, etc.) are highly desirable.

174295d6.title: Solution Architect, IT/ITES Vertical
174295d6.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.
   

  

 Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non\-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.
   

  

 In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.
   

  

 You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.
   

  

 Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our emerging customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best\-practice cloud architectures in line with their long\-term business needs.
* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long\-term business goals.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT\& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
* 3\+ years experience working in or with Global Captive Centers (GCC)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Delhi

60baac96.title: Sr. Program Manager, Buyer Abuse
60baac96.description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Buyer Abuse Prevention (BAP) team sits within the broader Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) organization — a centralized technology and program team whose mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online. Buyer abuse is defined as the risk associated with customers repeatedly violating Amazon's policies and affecting the profitability, brand, and reputation of Amazon or its Selling Partners.
   

  

 BAP sits at the intersection of technology, policy, and operations to detect, investigate, and prevent abusive behaviors across Amazon. Our work directly impacts Amazon's bottom line, protecting hundreds of millions of dollars in concession losses annually while preserving the customer and seller experience.
   

  

 BAP is seeking an innovative, results\-oriented, and customer\-centric Program Manager to own and drive the Automation program across the Buyer Abuse Prevention organization. In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Amazon's ability to investigate and act on risky orders and concessions at billions\-of\-transactions scale — without relying on manual effort. You will define the automation strategy, manage a portfolio of automation initiatives, and balance the dual mandate of maximizing automation rate while carefully managing enforcement quality through leakage (under\-enforcement) and customer experience (over\-enforcement) metrics.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer focused, team oriented, and have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. He or she will have a proven track record in taking on end\-to\-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced and dynamic business environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end Automation program strategy, roadmap, and execution across BAP, including setting goals, success metrics, and mechanisms to track progress against automation rate targets.
* Balance the core automation tradeoff: maximizing automation rate while managing leakage (under\-enforcement risk) and customer experience metrics (over\-enforcement risk), ensuring precision thresholds are maintained across all deployed models and workflows.
* Define and manage key success metrics for the Automation program, including automation rate, task coverage, precision, leakage rate, false positive rate, and customer\-facing impact metrics.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, and Data Science teams to design, test, and launch new automation capabilities — including LLM\-powered enforcement, model\-based auto\-decisions, and workflow automation.
* Interact with key stakeholders to define the metrics, measurements, and tools to quantify automation program goals and communicate results to Senior Leaders across Amazon.
* Conduct in\-depth reviews of automation performance data to identify patterns, gaps, and opportunities; develop reports and narratives for leadership and partner teams.
* Communicate (both verbally and in writing) program successes, failures, lessons learned, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Champion on behalf of Amazon and our Customers and help uncover issues currently impacting our Customer Experience as a result of automation decisions.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

You will define the automation strategy, manage a portfolio of automation initiatives, and balance the dual mandate of maximizing automation rate while carefully managing enforcement quality through leakage (under\-enforcement) and customer experience (over\-enforcement) metrics.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer focused, team oriented, and have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. He or she will have a proven track record in taking on end\-to\-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced and dynamic business environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end Automation program strategy, roadmap, and execution across BAP, including setting goals, success metrics, and mechanisms to track progress against automation rate targets.
* Balance the core automation tradeoff: maximizing automation rate while managing leakage (under\-enforcement risk) and customer experience metrics (over\-enforcement risk), ensuring precision thresholds are maintained across all deployed models and workflows.
* Define and manage key success metrics for the Automation program, including automation rate, task coverage, precision, leakage rate, false positive rate, and customer\-facing impact metrics.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, and Data Science teams to design, test, and launch new automation capabilities — including LLM\-powered enforcement, model\-based auto\-decisions, and workflow automation.
* Interact with key stakeholders to define the metrics, measurements, and tools to quantify automation program goals and communicate results to Senior Leaders across Amazon.
* Conduct in\-depth reviews of automation performance data to identify patterns, gaps, and opportunities; develop reports and narratives for leadership and partner teams.
* Communicate (both verbally and in writing) program successes, failures, lessons learned, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Champion on behalf of Amazon and our Customers and help uncover issues currently impacting our Customer Experience as a result of automation decisions.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

Define and govern the enterprise architecture for Artificial Intelligence, enabling AI capabilities to be adopted, governed and scaled securely across Computacenter. Shape AI roadmaps, principles, controls and transformation plan that align emerging AI capabilities with business outcomes, customer value and organisational change. Work across executive leadership, product teams, technology functions and business stakeholders to integrate AI across platforms including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP and Genesys.  

**What You'll Do**
**Core Accountabilities**
* You will influence business and technology stakeholders to make informed decisions on AI adoption, balancing innovation, risk, cost, speed of execution and measurable value. You will stay current with AI, data, platform, security and regulatory trends, helping leaders understand both the opportunities and risks associated with AI\-enabled transformation.


**AI Enterprise Architecture**
* Define strategic architecture for generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, knowledge management, customer experience and digital workplace transformation.
* Create and evolve AI roadmaps, architecture principles, governance frameworks, standards and guardrails that support secure, ethical, scalable and commercially sustainable AI adoption.
* Work closely with product teams, Solution Architecture and delivery teams to ensure AI\-enabled solutions are viable, secure by design, aligned with enterprise architecture principles and able to deliver required business outcomes.
* Support business\-led transformation programmes by translating AI strategy into practical platform choices, operating model changes, investment priorities and delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure AI capabilities are integrated effectively across key enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP, Genesys, Fabric and Power Platform.
* Lead architecture governance and assurance for AI\-related change, ensuring controls, data usage, security, ethical considerations and risk decisions are appropriate and aligned with enterprise risk appetite.
* Act as the bridge between business strategy and delivery teams, providing thought leadership, architectural decision\-making and practical guidance on responsible AI adoption.
* Contribute actively to CTO practice development, including EA tooling, reusable AI patterns, reference architectures and decision artefacts that support effective portfolio, platform and transformation planning.


**Critical Success Factors**
* Clear alignment of AI architecture decisions with business strategy, customer outcomes, technology strategy, risk appetite and value delivery.
* Quality AI roadmaps, principles, governance artefacts, reusable patterns and controls that guide portfolio and investment decisions.
* Responsible, secure and ethical AI adoption embedded into business and technology change through practical standards and assurance.
* Effective integration of AI capabilities across enterprise platforms including Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP and Genesys.
* Trusted relationships with executive leadership, product teams, technology functions, data, security and business stakeholders.
* Ability to help programmes balance innovation, risk, cost and speed of execution while scaling sustainable AI capability.
* Continuous learning and education, keeping pace with emerging AI technologies, regulations, market trends and enterprise architecture practices.

  

  

**What You'll Need**
**Essential**
* Proven enterprise architecture experience across business capability modelling, roadmaps, principles, standards, governance and technology strategy.
* Deep understanding of AI and data\-driven architectures, including generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, intelligent automation and knowledge management.
* Experience shaping AI roadmaps, governance frameworks, controls and transformation plans aligned to business outcomes and risk appetite.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft’s AI ecosystem, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Fabric and Power Platform.
* Practical experience integrating AI capabilities across enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Genesys.
* Knowledge of frameworks and methods including TOGAF, ArchiMate, SAFe, ITIL, FinOps, DevSecOps, Responsible AI principles, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001 and ISO 27001\.
* Experience with enterprise architecture and modelling tools such as LeanIX, Ardoq, Bizzdesign, ArchiMate or Sparx EA.
* Relevant professional accreditations desirable, such as TOGAF, CISSP, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Microsoft Applied Skills for Azure AI and Copilot technologies, SAFe and major cloud architecture certifications.
* Ability to translate complex technical AI concepts into clear business outcomes for senior leaders and delivery teams.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, influencing and commercial awareness.


**Leadership Requirements**
* Operates confidently from delivery teams through to CXO\-level stakeholders, translating AI strategy, platform choices and risk considerations into clear business outcomes.
* Combines strategic vision with pragmatic delivery capability, ensuring AI strategies can be turned into executable roadmaps and governed change.
* Demonstrates strong influencing, coaching and facilitation skills across business, technology, product, data, security and vendor teams.
* Shows intellectual curiosity, technology breadth, commercial awareness and credibility to engage directly with senior leaders and technical specialists.
* Maintains a balanced view of innovation, risk, cost and speed of execution so that AI adoption delivers measurable and sustainable value.
* Builds confidence across business and technology communities, helping the organisation navigate ambiguity and organisational change.

  


**About us**

Computacenter is a leading independent provider of IT infrastructure services, with about 21,000 employees worldwide. We work at the heart of digitisation, advising organisations on IT strategy, implementing the most appropriate technology and managing our customers’ infrastructures.  



We offer a friendly, open working environment without too much fuss about hierarchy. We are looking for professionals with diverse competencies, personalities and strengths who want to live our shared value of teamwork and performance.  



Interested in joining a company with a strong sense of community?  



We’re growing. We’re hiring. We encourage. We empower. We support.  

\#winningtogether \#peoplematter

6ab9c90a.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 



**The Senior Alliance Solutions Engineer Opportunity** 




 Okta believes in Partners and, together with our technology, will help take Identity mainstream and consolidate our position as a Leader in the market.  Partner Solutions Engineers are dedicated to growing Okta business through the Channel, working closely with Regional Alliance Managers, Sales Representatives, Marketing and Partner Enablement.  As a Partner Solutions Engineer at Okta, you will have an opportunity to be a well\-respected technical expert, building strong, long standing relationships with key Partners and Global System Integrators, supporting both global and India markets.  You will become your partners’ trusted advisor for anything Identity and Access Management related and will help them understand how Okta can best fit in their Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Strategy, integrate with their current offerings, help evangelize partner solutions within the Okta field teams and lead our partners in building Okta practices that deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
 



*\*This role requires in\-person onboarding and travel to our San Francisco, CA HQ office during the first week of employment.* 




**What you’ll be doing** 



* Build and manage technical relationships with assigned Partners and team with the assigned Okta Partner Account Team
* Drive incremental revenue through increased Okta solution sales with the support of Strategic Partners and their GTM strategies.
* Develop domain expertise and thought leadership regarding the Partners’ current areas of focus as well as in new areas for expansion
* Gather, track, and translate partner feedback to help steer the Okta product roadmap
* Deliver technical training sessions for Partners (leading workshops, demoing Okta features, explaining best practices and competitive differentiators)
* Field technical questions, inquiries and Request for Information from the Partners through in\-person, virtual and office hours and provide support for building Partner COEs
* Establish and maintain technical expertise on current and developing Okta products and technology
* Provide oversight, guidance, and assistance during the Partners sales process (including RFP responses) to ensure mutual success
* Up to 25% travel in support of Partner, Okta and industry events



**How you’ll be measured** 



* Direct and influenced revenue growth
* Partner developed and driven GTM Solution Offering driven into the market / their customer base
* Partner enablement and resource certification growth



**What you’ll bring to the role** 



* 5\+ years pre\-sales engineering experience.
* Experience with implementing Okta, Auth0 or both
* An understanding of IAM / IDaaS competitive landscape
* Experience supporting or enabling partner ecosystems or alliances in cloud security, identity, or cybersecurity
* Strong presentation and communication skills at a technical level
* A passion to serve the partner as our customer and ensure their success within their customer bases.
* Experience with at least one standard network security protocol. (OAuth, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP, OIDC)
* Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: web (Javascript, HTML, frontend frameworks) development, mobile (iOS, Android) development, backend (Java, C\#, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby) development, IP\-based real\-time communications
* Hands\-on experience in cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Confident dispensing knowledge to a highly skilled and experienced audience.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS or a comparable field is preferred.



 \#P21909\_3132202
 







**The Okta Experience** 



* Supporting Your Well\-Being
* Driving Social Impact
* Developing Talent and Fostering Connection \+ Community



 We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in\-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

e96a68a2.title: AI Infrastructure Architect
e96a68a2.description:
**Project Role :** 
 AI Infrastructure Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Architect and build custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure/hardware solutions. Optimize AI infrastructure/hardware performance, power consumption, cost and scalability of computational stack. Advise on AI infrastructure technology and vendor evaluation, selection and full stack integration.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 AI Agents \& Workflow Integration
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Amazon Web Services (AWS)
   

  

**Minimum 18 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

 As an Technical Architect in AI Infrastructure Architecture, you will act as a senior technical authority for AWS\-based AI/ML compute infrastructure, shaping the technical vision, reference architecture, standards and implementation strategy for large\-scale AI systems. You will evaluate complex choices across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security and cost optimization, while guiding senior and lead architects/Technical Architects to deliver resilient, scalable and production\-ready AI infrastructure. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, compliance, reliability, FinOps and platform modernization to help clients translate AI infrastructure trade\-offs into measurable business value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Set the overarching AWS AI infrastructure vision, strategy and reference architecture for large\-scale AI/ML systems, including compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving and observability.
   

  

 Own complex architectural decisions across AWS services such as EC2, EKS, SageMaker, S3, FSx/EFS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch and related DevOps/security tooling, rationalizing options against client standards and business objectives.
   

  

 Architect and prototype cost\-optimized GPU/accelerated compute and distributed training environments, building benchmarks, proof\-of\-concepts and reusable implementation patterns.
   

  

 Define architecture standards, reusable infrastructure\-as\-code patterns, CI/CD approaches, model deployment patterns, monitoring strategy, SLAs/SLOs and cost/performance governance for production AI/ML systems.
   

  

 Lead architecture assessments and design reviews validate findings through hands\-on implementation, profiling, performance tuning and troubleshooting across the AI infrastructure stack.
   

  

 Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies, accelerators, interconnects, managed AI services and ecosystem tools, and recommend where they belong in enterprise solutions.
   

  

 Provide executive and client\-level technical advisory, translating cloud infrastructure trade\-offs into clear, defensible recommendations connected to business outcomes.
   

  

 Mentor architects and Technical Architects, build community best practices and represent the practice in internal and external technical forums.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Technical Architecting, Information Technology or a related Technical Architecting field.
   

  

 Minimum 6 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large\-scale Technical Architecting solutions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the compute, infrastructure, orchestration and deployment foundations required to run production AI systems.
   

  

 Minimum 6 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent Technical Architecting languages.
   

  

 Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform\-native workflow tooling.
   

  

 Proven experience leading AI infrastructure projects and teams, including technical direction, design reviews, delivery governance and stakeholder alignment.
   

  

 Strong project management, communication, problem\-solving and cross\-functional collaboration skills in fast\-paced client or enterprise environments.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, reference architectures and platform services for production solutions.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Expert\-level hands\-on architecture experience with AWS AI infrastructure services including EC2, EKS, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch and automation/DevOps services.
   

  

 Deep knowledge of GPU/accelerated compute, distributed training, model serving, container platforms, storage design, network design, observability and resilience Technical Architecting.
   

  

 Strong experience with Terraform/CloudFormation, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, security guardrails, monitoring and infrastructure cost optimization.
   

  

 Ability to evaluate multiple AWS architecture options and produce standards, patterns, decision records, benchmarks and executive\-ready recommendations.
   

  

 Experience applying MLOps/InfraOps practices for experiment tracking, model registry, deployment automation, monitoring, incident response and rollback strategies.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Technical Architect Professional or Machine Learning specialty/associate credentials.
   

  

 Industry experience designing AI infrastructure for BFSI, healthcare, retail/e\-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments with compliance, security and reliability constraints.
   

  

 Exposure to LLM infrastructure, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, GPU scheduling, model optimization, high\-performance storage and low\-latency model serving.
   

  

 Experience with enterprise architecture governance, technology roadmaps, vendor/partner management, FinOps and production support operating models.
   

  

 , 15 years full time education

2c1e1efb.title: Principal IT Solution Architect
2c1e1efb.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------


Are you looking for an exciting new chance to build on your experience working on business\-led change initiatives? Arm is changing the future of computing across multiple sectors from mobile clients and automotive through to Hyperscalers and embedded devices. And we're doing this together with our broad ecosystem of partners and for the benefit of everyone!
You will be part of Arm’s Enterprise IT Business Applications Architecture practice and work across the portfolio of projects to provide architectural guidance and solutions to business challenges that are aligned to strategy and EIT roadmaps. You will also be responsible for technical leadership and direction to development and delivery teams, ensuring delivery of your designs is adequately stewarded and also collaborating across teams to find opportunities for new technologies.
**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


**Interpret Business Needs**
* Collaborate with senior leaders to identify future technology innovations and evolutions that have potential to address business ambitions
* Develop solutions designs (HLD) and roadmaps aligned to the Domain target
* Maintain mapping between Capabilities, Applications and Data

**Assess and Apply Technology**
-------------------------------


* Be creative in the use of existing technologies
* Work with members of the technical communities to develop and establish reference patterns for Platforms and Solutions
* Look ahead for opportunities with new technologies and applications

**Technical leadership**
------------------------


* Supports change initiatives and technical communities, guiding and helping teams and partners to align with the overall enterprise architecture
* Ownership of solution pattern and approach, responsible for sign\-off on High\-Level designs and ensuring alignment to target and roadmaps
* Ensure quality of Architecture design artefacts and present at governance forums

**Practice Development**
------------------------


* Develop and evolve Architecture principles, governance, materials and ways of working
* Guide and mentor teams on architecture principles, governance, and standard practices
* Drive innovation by researching and evaluating emerging technologies that align with business needs

**Required Skills and Experience:**
-----------------------------------


* At least 8 years of experience in a Solution Architect role.
* Strong experience with Salesforce, SAP, and integration platforms (e.g., Mulesoft, event\-driven architectures, MS Power Platform, Automation Anywhere).
* Good knowledge of LoB applications (e.g., ServiceNow, HCM, CMS, CLM) in commercial and operational domains.
* Expertise in cloud services (multi\-provider, AI, cloud\-native development).
* Experience with DevSecOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices.
* Ability to balance long\-term vision with short\-term needs and define multiple solution options.
* Familiarity with Business Analysis, Programme Management, and application development methodologies.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies
* Demonstrable experience in project governance, leadership, and architecture team development.

**“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:**
-----------------------------------------


* Formal qualifications in development languages or application platforms
* Experience of the semi\-conductor industry or other Engineering based organisations!

**In Return:**
--------------


* This is a new team, and there is plenty of opportunity to shape its future, and your own growth and progression.

**Our 10x Mindset**
-------------------


At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x\-mindset


**Use of AI in Your Application**
---------------------------------


At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI\-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.


**Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations**
----------------------------------------------


At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.


**Hybrid Working**
------------------


Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.


**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------


Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

* Senior Architect / Lead\-Principal AI Architect for AI LLM Technology Architecture, serving as the accountable architecture authority for enterprise AI solutions on Azure.
* Own the complete, end\-to\-end architecture of advanced AI platforms and solutions spanning classical machine learning, generative AI, LLM applications, agentic systems, context engineering, model platforms, inference, AI operations and enterprise integration.
* Operate at executive level with CIOs, CTOs, senior business leaders and practice leadership to shape AI strategy, define transformation roadmaps and ensure investments are purposeful, sequenced and aligned to business outcomes.
* Bring strong industry experience in banking, insurance, healthcare, public sector, retail or energy to ensure the AI architecture addresses domain workflows, regulatory expectations, risk controls, data realities, adoption considerations and measurable value delivery.
* Lead multiple domain architects and senior SMEs across agentic application design, AI security and trust, AI operations and observability, data and knowledge engineering, model platforms and inference to create a cohesive enterprise\-ready architecture.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with client executives and business leaders to define the enterprise AI strategy, target\-state architecture and investment roadmap across platforms, data, models, applications and operating model.
* Lead enterprise AI assessments, technology comparisons, platform selection, reference architecture definition, modernization opportunities and implementation sequencing for complex transformations.
* For Azure, set the Azure enterprise AI/LLM platform strategy define Foundry and Azure OpenAI architecture for agentic workflows, RAG, tool integration, context assembly and enterprise knowledge grounding establish integration patterns using API Management, Logic Apps and Functions define identity, private networking, responsible AI, evaluation and operational governance across solution domains.
* Own the complete end\-to\-end technical solution for complex AI platforms, ensuring every domain is designed cohesively against business objectives, enterprise standards and non\-functional requirements.
* Translate governing architecture principles into a concrete, defensible technical solution that platform, data, AI/ML and application engineering teams can build against.
* Set architectural direction for model\- and tool\-agnostic multi\-agent systems, including orchestration, memory, tool/skill use, agent registry, AI gateway/control plane, risk scoring and certification gates.
* Define the enterprise context layer architecture across knowledge graphs, ontologies, vector search, semantic retrieval, prompt/context assembly, conversational state and reusable memory services.
* Establish identity, authorization, layered guardrails, prompt\-injection defense, PII protection, audit logging, lineage and defense\-in\-depth controls for AI agents, tools, data and models.
* Mandate productized evaluation and observability practices covering accuracy, relevance, groundedness, model quality, latency, cost, safety, reliability, production support and continuous improvement.
* Establish FinOps as a first\-class AI concern, including usage labelling, token budgets, gateway\-enforced budgets, cost\-per\-archetype planning, threshold alerts and optimization levers.
* Produce and steward authoritative architecture assets including enterprise AI blueprints, ADRs, sequence diagrams, solution patterns, interface specifications, reference architectures and governance playbooks.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Information Technology or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 15\+ years of overall experience across software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering, cloud architecture, enterprise architecture or technology leadership.
* Minimum 8\+ years of experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade advanced AI, data, analytics or cloud\-native solutions using at least one cloud vendor.
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience in LLM and generative AI solution architecture, including agentic systems, RAG, prompt engineering, model integration and evaluation patterns.
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience architecting and operationalizing LLM\-driven application architecture patterns in enterprise\-scale or production environments.
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience in engineering, machine learning, deep learning, NLP solutions, data engineering or large\-scale analytical engineering applications.
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience as a machine learning / data / AI architect designing large\-scale analytical engineering solutions in industry contexts such as banking, insurance, healthcare, public sector, retail or energy.


**Required Skills/ Experience**
* Deep architecture and hands\-on engineering experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI models, Azure AI Search, Prompt Flow, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Event Grid, Microsoft Fabric, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
* Strong expertise in enterprise AI platform architecture covering RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, context engineering, model routing, agent orchestration, memory, tool calling, AI gateways and model evaluation.
* Ability to set enterprise NFRs and architectural controls for performance, scalability, security, privacy, reliability, governance, observability, resiliency, cost optimization and operational readiness.
* Experience making definitive, evidence\-based decisions on design patterns, reference architectures, frameworks, technology selections, foundation models and deployment approaches.
* Experience establishing agent registry and certification models, AI control planes, access models, guardrails, production evaluation stacks, model risk controls and cross\-platform governance.
* Strong executive communication, architecture governance and thought leadership skills with ability to influence business, technology, security, product and delivery leadership teams.


 Good to Have Skills
   

  

* Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer Associate or Azure Developer certification experience with Microsoft Fabric, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow, private endpoints, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Responsible AI governance and enterprise integration patterns.
* Exposure to open\-source AI and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Haystack, Semantic Kernel, MLflow, FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with responsible AI, model risk management, AI governance boards, red\-teaming, synthetic data, human\-in\-the\-loop review, A/B testing and GenAI FinOps.
* Recognized thought leadership through enterprise reference architectures, internal capability building, client advisory, platform accelerators, publications, whitepapers, conference sessions or industry forums.


 , 15 years full time education

2f0e70d1.title: Operations and Delivery Manager
2f0e70d1.description:
Operations \& Delivery Manager — Dharwad Dada
 
**Location:** 
 Dharwad, Karnataka
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Food, FMCG, D2C and E\-commerce
 



**Travel:** 
 Regular local travel across Dharwad–Hubballi
 



**Preferred Joining:** 
 Immediate or early joiners
 


 About Dharwad Dada
 
 Dharwad Dada is building a premium D2C brand around Dharwad’s famous pedha. Our promise is simple: authentic taste, premium packaging and reliable delivery—so customers across India can experience
 **“The Peda That Melts in Your Mouth.”** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Operations \& Delivery Manager** 
 to manage the complete journey from pedha preparation to final dispatch.
 


 Role Overview
 
 This is a field\-oriented operations role—not a desk\-only position.
 



 You will coordinate closely with our pedha makers, packaging team, suppliers and delivery partners to ensure every order is prepared, packed and shipped correctly and on time.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong local knowledge of Dharwad–Hubballi, be comfortable working directly with traditional sweet makers and take complete ownership of quality and daily dispatch operations.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesProduction Coordination
 * Coordinate daily production requirements with pedha makers.
* Communicate expected order quantities and dispatch deadlines.
* Ensure pedhas are prepared according to agreed taste, quality, hygiene and consistency standards.
* Monitor batch readiness and resolve production delays.
* Maintain simple daily production and wastage records.


 Quality and Hygiene
 * Inspect pedhas before packing for freshness, appearance, weight and consistency.
* Ensure safe food\-handling and hygiene practices are followed.
* Identify damaged, inconsistent or unsuitable products before dispatch.
* Coordinate corrective action with the production team.
* Help establish repeatable quality\-control checklists.


 Packaging Operations
 * Train and supervise workers on the approved packaging process.
* Ensure every box contains the correct number of individually packed pedhas.
* Verify seals, wrappers, labels, batch information and final presentation.
* Ensure shipping cartons provide adequate protection during transit.
* Monitor the availability of boxes, wrappers, labels and other packaging materials.
* Prevent incorrect, damaged or incomplete orders from being shipped.


 Order Fulfilment and Dispatch
 * Review daily orders and prepare an accurate dispatch plan.
* Match every package with the correct customer and delivery details.
* Coordinate pickups with Delhivery and other logistics partners.
* Ensure orders are handed over within the promised timeline.
* Record AWB and tracking details accurately.
* Follow up on delayed pickups, undelivered shipments, returns and damaged parcels.


 Inventory and Vendor Coordination
 * Maintain stock records for pedhas, packaging materials and complimentary products.
* Estimate upcoming material requirements and prevent stock shortages.
* Coordinate with packaging vendors and other local suppliers.
* Track wastage, damages and operational discrepancies.
* Help control fulfilment and delivery costs without compromising quality.


 Reporting and Improvement
 * Provide a daily update covering production, packing, dispatches, delays and issues.
* Track order accuracy, on\-time dispatch, damages, returns and wastage.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements.
* Build reliable processes that can support increasing daily order volumes.


 Candidate Requirements
 * 2–6 years of experience in operations, fulfilment, logistics, food production, FMCG, retail, warehouse management or a related field.
* Strong familiarity with Dharwad and Hubballi.
* Candidates currently residing in or having strong roots and working knowledge of the Dharwad–Hubballi region will be preferred.
* Willingness to travel regularly within Dharwad and nearby areas.
* Comfortable working directly with sweet makers, packers, suppliers and delivery personnel.
* Ability to train workers and enforce packaging and quality standards.
* Strong ownership, discipline and problem\-solving ability.
* Basic working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Comfortable using order dashboards, courier portals, WhatsApp and email.
* Ability to communicate effectively in Kannada; working knowledge of Hindi and English is preferred.
* Two\-wheeler and a valid driving licence are strongly preferred.


 What Success Looks Like
 * Orders are prepared and dispatched on time.
* Every box meets the approved quality and packaging standards.
* Order errors, damage, wastage and delays remain minimal.
* Packaging materials are always available when required.
* Courier pickups and tracking updates happen reliably.
* Production and fulfilment can scale without compromising the customer experience.


 Who Should Apply?
 
 You may be a strong fit if you:
 


* Know the Dharwad–Hubballi area well.
* Enjoy fieldwork and hands\-on operational responsibility.
* Can work respectfully with traditional food makers while implementing professional standards.
* Notice small quality and packaging issues before customers do.
* Take personal ownership of getting every order shipped properly and on time.


 How to Apply
 
 Apply through LinkedIn or Naukri with your updated résumé.
 



 Please include the following in your application:
 


* Current location
* Relevant operations or logistics experience
* Current and expected compensation
* Notice period
* Availability for regular local travel
* Whether you own a two\-wheeler
* Languages spoken
* **Subject/Headline:** 
 Application — Operations \& Delivery Manager, Dharwad Dada

91345011.title: Technical Program Manager
91345011.description:
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud\-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a technically fluent program leader who ensures problems are deeply understood before they are resolved.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Technical Program Manager owns Armor’s problem\-management program and the analytical work that drives down the volume of issues customers experience. This is a program and analysis role, not a day\-to\-day ticket\-resolution role: rather than working individual customer tickets, the Technical Program Manager digs into the data behind them to find the systemic problems that generate recurring work, and drives those to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework. That work is grounded in understanding how data flows into Armor’s systems—the connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines behind platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender—so root causes and data\-quality issues can be identified, not guessed. The role partners closely with Engineering, SRE, and support delivery teams and thinks in terms of measurable, repeatable outcomes rather than one\-off fixes—an approach that matters deeply for a cybersecurity company where recurring problems carry real customer risk. Based in Pune, India, the role works primarily on India business hours and carries the flexibility to overlap with US Central hours as needed to collaborate with Armor’s Dallas\-based Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams. It reports to and takes strategic direction from the Head of Global Support.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Analyze incident and ticket data toidentifythe systemic drivers of ticket volume, and target measurable reductions in recurring work and customer\-impacting incidents.
* Investigate how data flows into Armor’s systems—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines from Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Qualys/VMDR, log/SIEM sources, and Azure and cloud telemetry—to surface data\-quality issues and the root causes behind recurring problems.
* Work through ambiguity: develop hypotheses about recurring and systemic prob lems, valid ate root cause with data, and ensure problems are genuinely understood before solutions are pursued.
* Consolidaterecurring incidents and service requests into managed problem recordsand drive them to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework—without taking over day\-to\-day ticket execution, which is owned by dedicated delivery teams.
* Build the queries, dashboards, and reports that surface trends and quantify customer and business impact (e.g., KQL over Sentinel/Defender, SQL, Power BI, and Jira reporting).
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major and recurring problems; document root causes, workarounds, and known errors so delivery teams resolve recurrences consistently.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams to land systemic fixes, and coordinate permanent fixes that require change through Armor’s change process.
* Define and report the metrics that matter—reduction in recurring customer\-impacting incidents and ticket volume as the headline, with operational signals (recurring\-problem count, MTTR, RCA compliance, and SLA adherence) as supporting measures.
* Run problem\-review cadences,maintainand drive down a prioritized problem backl og, and t rack held known errors so workarounds do not quietly become permanent technical debt.
* Identifyautomation and process\-improvement opportunities and program\-manage their delivery to reduce manual, repetitive work.
* Maintain authoritative documentation and a known\-error knowledge base in Confluence, and provide clear, executive\-level status, risks, and escalations.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\-12years of experience in technical program management, security or IT operations, data and analytics, or service/problem management; Bachelor’s degree in Computer Scienc e , Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven ability to manage cross\-functional programs and drive outcomes across multiple teams without direct authority.
* Hands\-on data analysis: able to query operational and security data using KQL (Microsoft Sentinel/Defender) and SQL, and to build reports and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Jira) that surface trends and quantify impact.
* Working understanding of data integrations—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines—and how security telemetry reaches a SIEM or analytics platform (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender).
* Solid grounding in problem management and root cause analysis, aligned to ITIL (Problem, Incident, and Service Management).
* Familiarity (conceptual, not hands\-on delivery) with the security domains Armor operates: vulnerability management (Qualys/VMDR), endpoint and EDR (Microsoft Defender), and cloud and identity (Azure, Okta/Entra).
* Ability to read incident and ticket data and translate it into prioritized, measurable action.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management in English, including executive\-level reporting and clear RCAs and resolution frameworks.
* Proficiencywith Jira and Confluence.
* Strategic, systemic thinker with a bias for repeatable, automation\-assisted solutions over one\-off fixes.
* Self\-directed, taking strategic direction and prioritization from the Head of Support.


 Alignment to Armor Core Values
   

  

* COMMITMENT TO GROWTH
* INTEGRITY ALWAYS
* EMPATHY IN ACTION
* IMMEDIATE IMPACT
* FOLLOW\-THROUGH


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Depth in KQL/Kusto, Power BI, or Power Automate, or exposure to data engineering and pipeline troubleshooting.
* Experience building or troubleshooting API\-based integrations and data connectors.
* PMP, ITIL v4, or Microsoft security/Azure certifications.
* Experience in a cybersecurity or managed\-security services (MSSP) environment.


 WORK ENVIRONMENT
   

  

 This role is based in Armor’s Pune, India office and works primarily on India business hours. Because sev eral p artner teams are based in Dallas, the role calls for flexibility to shift part of the working day into US Central time as needed to collaborate with Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams and to run problem reviews and escalations. As a program role rather than a customer\-facing ticket role, it does not require continuous late\-night coverage; the emphasis is on dependable overlap and responsiveness. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate, and the environment may be an office setting, the company’s data center , or remote. Occasional extended or off\-hours work may be required during major incidents.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer \- It is the policy of the company to comply with all employment laws and to afford equal employment opportunity to individuals in all aspects of employment, including in selection for job opportunities, without regard to race, color , religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.
